quests.title: Combat
quests.description:
Combat is an important part of all Survival Minecraft. 

If you want difficulties or not it all matters to your Combat. 

Enchanting is entirely different (and better) with Mods like Apotheosis changing how we do it. Plus other Mods adding even more Enchantments. 

Some Mods give little Relics or Artifacts which you can Wear and Hold to get Effects!

quests.title: Magic
quests.description:
How do I define a Magic Mod? 

They all start differently, they all have different purposes, and end games... 

Well... they're all around Magic! 

Some about accessing the Magic through Nature like Nature's Aura and Reliquary. Others with Rituals like Forbidden & Arcanus or Occultism!

quests.title: "Simple" Technology
quests.description:
The only reason I say "simple" is due to how the Machines get Power and Items. 

All Items and Energy can be Piped in like normal. 

Oritech, Mekanism, and Industrial Foregoing are all unique Technology Mods. 

Oritech focuses on designing Multiblocks and processing Items through them. 

Mekanism focuses on processing Items to the limit with multiple different Machines and combinations. 

Industrial Foregoing gives us Machines each with different ways to interact with the World.

quests.title: Exploration
quests.description:
There's soooo many different Mods to explore! 

From ones in the Overworld like Repurposed Structures to Cataclysm. 
There's even more in their own Dimensions, like Twilight Forest, Undergarden, Bumblezone, and Eternal Starlight. 

All of these Mods require Collecting new Blocks, Fighting unique Mobs, and best part is the awesome Weapons!

quests.title: "Complicated" Technology
quests.description:
These Mods use their own unique ways of Power and Item Logistics! 

Create is focused on Rotational Power. You'll need Generators like Windmills or Waterwheels to create some in order to Power Machines. 

PneumaticCraft uses Air Pressure for most Machines and Processing. Items move around normally, just all need Air Pressure to work. 

Immersive Engineering is another Multiblock Mod. Just these Multiblocks are powered by Wires and Connectors instead of Pipes or just putting 2 Blocks close to each other.

quests.title: Barely even Technology
quests.description:
Are Draconic Evolution and Just Dire Things even Technology Mods? 

Draconic Evolution uses Machines and... Magic? To merge and upgrade different Blocks. It is all based on The End. 

Just Dire Things revolves around using Goo, to convert and create new Blocks and Items. To make new Machines and even Tools!

quests.title: Iron Furnaces
quests.description:
Iron Furnaces is a Mod that improves Furnaces. 

With Modded Minecraft you're going to be Smelting a ton! To save time (and TPS) use better Furnaces instead of more. 

The better the Furnace the faster they Smelt and more they Smelt. 

They also have Augments which can change everything from Fuel to Energy, to what they Smelt, to Efficiency.

quests.title: Exploration, Combat, and Magic
quests.description:
These are 3 whole Categories of Mods! How did I put them all in just a few Quests? 

By barely scraping the barrel of what they all have to offer! 

You've got to find the rest.

quests.title: Steel
quests.description:
Steel is entirely Modded. Not at all Vanilla, just made from the Vanilla Items of Iron and Coal. 

How do we make it? Just pick a Mod! 

Metallurgic Infuser - Mekanism 
Alloy Smelter - EnderIO 
Alloy Kin or Blast Furnace - Immersive Engineering 
Foundry - Oritech 
The Foundry - Productive Metalworks 
Blast Furnace - RailCraft Reborn 

All of these work!

quests.title: Crafting, but on a Stick
quests.description:
Personally, I hate having to run to a block just to craft. That's where the Crafting Table on a Stick comes in!

This item works as a Portable Crafting Table!

Tip: You can also put this in your Curios slot and set a Keybind to open it!

quests.title: Furnace
quests.description:
The Furnace is the 2nd most important Block in Minecraft. The Crafting Table is more important duhhh. 

The Furnace can Smelt Items to make new (usually better) Items! It can Cook Food, turn Ores to Ingots, and make whole new Blocks. 

The Furnace needs Fuel in its Bottom Slot. Stuff like Wood, Coal, Crops, and even Wooden Swords.

quests.title: The End
quests.description:
The Eyes of Ender can be thrown and followed to find the Stronghold! 

Strongholds are Structures below the ground, labyrinths of prison cells, library, and the portal room. 

The portal room holds the End Portal. Once you put Eyes of Ender into every End Portal Frame, the Portal will be ready. 

Just jump on in!

quests.title: Ender Dragon
quests.description:
In The End, you'll find the final boss of Vanilla Minecraft: The Ender Dragon. 

The Ender Dragon has 150 Hearts. Plus it Regenerates Health from the End Crystals on top of each Obsidian Pillar. Break them while she's Healing from them to deal a ton of Damage. 

The Dragon has 2 modes. Flying and Perching. 

When Flying, she will Shoot Dragon Fire Balls at you. When they Hit something, they will Spawn Dragon's Breath on that spot. She might also ram into you to toss you far far away! 

When Perching she will sit above her Bedrock Nest. Here she is invulnerable to Projectiles so Arrows won't do Damage, only Melee Attacks! She might also spew Dragon's Breath in front of her when Perching. 

Once slain, the Dragon Egg will Spawn above her Nest! Strange things happen when you Right Click it and have it Drop onto a non-full Block.

quests.title: Getting Netherite
quests.description:
Netherite is unique for all the Minecraft Ores. 

First, Mine Ancient Debris. These spawn all over The Nether, but it is safest to Mine deep below the surface because of Lava Lakes. 

Then, Smelt Ancient Debris to get Ancient Scrap. Combine 4 Ancient Scraps with 4 Gold Ingots to make a Netherite Ingot! 

Wait, our job isn't done yet. We need the Netherite Upgrade Template. These spawn in Chests in Piglin Bastions...

quests.title: Minecraft
quests.description:
AllTheMons is an ATM Modpack based around Cobblemon! 

The goal will still be the ATM Star like usual, but this time you'll need to play through Cobblemon. 

Since Cobblemon (and its Addons) is such a big and important Mod, it gets its own Chapter! 

If you need to learn how to go through Cobblemon then check out that Chapter, this one will lead you through everything else. From Vanilla to the ATM Star!

quests.title: Putting the Craft in Minecraft
quests.description: I'm going to assume you've been Crafting, right? It is MineCRAFT after all.\n\nSure, you could craft in your Inventory using the 2x2 Crafting Grid, but that won't get you far. We need to upgrade by making a Crafting Table!

quests.title: Our First Pick
quests.description: Whether you are an experienced modded player, or a complete noob to MC, everyone has to make a Wooden Pickaxe.\n\nPickaxes allow you to break most Stone and Metal blocks. This Wooden one won't last long, so make sure to gather some Cobblestone with it!

quests.title: Cobblestone
quests.description:
With our Wooden Pick we'll need to Mine some Stone! 

Yeah, we're going to immediately replace our Wooden Pickaxe... 

I'd recommend collecting 18 Cobble with it before you ditch it. That's enough to make a Furance, Sword, Axe, Pickaxe, and Hoe!

quests.title: Mining
quests.description:
It's in the name. 

Tons of Items are found underground, we'll need to Mine them to Collect them! 

Each Item needs a certain Pickaxe Tier to Mine. Cobblestone needs atleast a Wooden Pickaxe. Iron needs atleast a Stone Pickaxe. 

Basic Tools explains this in more depth, but you can look at the top of your screen when viewing a Block to know what Pickaxe Tier you need to Mine it!

quests.title: Iron Age
quests.description:
What does Iron make? 

Armor, more Tools like Buckets and Shears, new Blocks like Hoppers and Cauldrons. 

Iron is pretty important. What you should go for first is an Iron Pickaxe though, in order to Mine Diamonds!

quests.title: A Player's Bestfriend
quests.description:
Diamonds, the heart and soul of Minecraft. 

Found below Y Level 16, most common right above Bedrock! 

You'll need an Iron Pickaxe (preferably with Fortune) to Mine them. Then, you can make even better Tools and Armor! 

These used to be the best in Vanilla, now that's Netherite. And now that there's Mods, there is even better than Netherite.

quests.title: Diamond Tools and Gear
quests.description: With Diamonds we can make a Diamond Pickaxe! This can Mine all Vanilla Blocks, including Obsidian and Ancient Debris. \n\nYou can also Craft Armor and Weapons... those too.

quests.title: The Nether
Nether Fortress
quests.description:
The Nether Fortress is a Structure obviously in The Nether. 

It is the only natural Spawn for Wither Skeletons and Blazes. 

We'll need the Blazes to make Blaze Powder for Eyes of Ender. 

The Wither Skeletons we need to summon The Wither with their Skulls.

quests.title: The Wither
quests.description:
The Wither is one of the hardest bosses to kill in Minecraft. Mainly because it flies. And explodes. And is fast. You get the picture. 

To summon it, place down the 4 Soul Sand in the shape of a T. Place the 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls on the top of the 'T' and the Wither will spawn. 

He'll have 300 Hearts at full Health, which then he'll start Flying and Shooting Wither Skulls at you! 

If you get him down to half Health, he'll become invulnerable to Projectiles like the Ender Dragon. Here you'll need to start Hitting him. 

When you Kill him he'll Drop a Nether Star! 

(P.S. If The Wither Kills a Mob, they'll Drop a Wither Rose!)

quests.title: Netherite Tools and Gear
quests.description:
Once we have the Ingot and Template, use a Smithing Table to combine the Ingot and Template with a piece of Diamond Gear to upgrade it to Netherite. 

Netherite has the most Damage, Durability, and Protection of all Minecraft Gear! It is also entirely Fireproof (it won't make you Fire Resistant, just the Items won't burn in Lava). 

We'll need the strength Netherite gives in order to have a chance in the...

quests.title: Item Storage
quests.description:
Storing Items is important. Please don't just leave them on the ground! 

Instead place Items into Chests! Not enough room? Make Iron Chests or Drawers! 

Prefer to have all your Items accessible in one Storage Network? Use AE2! 

If you need Items on the go, don't look for Shulkers. Instead use Backpacks or Pocket Storage.

quests.title: Copper Age
quests.description:
Copper is an Ore like Iron. Just cheaper and more Common! 

You'll need a Stone Pickaxe to Mine it. 

I only put it here instead of after the Stone Pickaxe for aesthetic purposes.

quests.title: Deep Dark Biome
quests.description:
The Deep Dark is the most dangerous Biome in Minecraft. It spawns deep under Deepslate, usually below Mountains and Hills. 

What makes a Biome so dangerous? Sculk. 

Sculk comes with Sculk Sensors and Shriekers. Sensors pick up any Sound within a certain area. Mining Blocks, Shooting Arrows, Eating Food all make Sound. 

If a Sensor picks up a Sound it will alert nearby Sculk Shriekers. If Sculk Shriekers go off 3 times in a row they will Spawn...

quests.title: Warden
quests.description:
The Warden. The strongest Boss of Minecraft. You know the one the creators explicitly stated you aren't meant to Kill? 

The Warden has 500 Hearts. He can two shot Players in full Netherite Armor. 

If Players are near him, he'll simply crush them with his arms. If detected much farther he'll Shoot them with his Sonic Beam. 

Thankfully he is nerfed by being Blind (unlike Daredevil). He works solely off Sound and Smell. Yeah, if you're too close he'll always be able to find you. 

If you make Sounds he can hear them and go to where you made Sound. Even with Sculk Sensors if they go off he can find you! If he hears a noise far away he may sink into Sculk to teleport closer to the Sound! 

So how do we Kill him? You can always try Building 23 Blocks above him and Hitting him with Arrows. 23 Blocks up is too far for his Sonic Beam! 

If you can Kill him he'll Drop a bunch of Sculk and Deeper and Darker Items!

quests.title: Material Farming
quests.description: Modded Minecraft isn't cheap, you're going to need LOTS of Items. \n\nSo let's learn how to Farm Items!

quests.title: Power
quests.description:
Now with Redstone we gain access to Energy! 

Just about every Machine in Modded Minecraft needs Energy. Most is in the form of FE (Forge Energy). 

Some are in similar forms like AE, these can work with FE or be translated to AE. Other Mods use their own form of Energy which is unique to theirs.

quests.title: Archeology
quests.description:
Archeology is still important, even in AllTheMons. 

Craft a Brush with a Stick, Feather, and Copper Ingot! 

With the Brush you can Hold Right Click with it on an Item to Brush the Item. When done on certain Suspicious Blocks, Items will come out.

quests.title: Early Generators
quests.description:
Energy creation starts with something very simple. 

Usually a Generator that uses Coal or Lava to make FE. 

All of these Generators do exactly that!

quests.title: Hostile Neural Networks
quests.description:
Hostile Neural Networks is a perfect Mod for those who need to easily Farm Mob Drops. 

It starts out with a Deep Learner and Model Frameworks. The Model Framework needs to be set to a Mob by Right Clicking the Mob with it. 

Then, put the set Framework into the Deep Learner and start Killing!

quests.title: Energy Storage
quests.description:
There are many ways to store power! 

We got Powah Energy Cells. 
Mekanism Energy Cubes. 
Integrated Dynamics Energy Batteries. 
AE2 Energy Cells. 

Each of these can be upgraded to hold even more Energy! 

If these aren't enough check out Mekanism or Draconic Evolution for Multiblock Energy Storage.

quests.title: Mystical Agriculture
quests.description:
Now this is Material "Farming"! 

Underground you can find Inferium Essence. These are the backbone of Mystical Agriculture. So you'll need billion of them. 

With Inferium Essence and other Items, we can make Seeds. Seeds that Grow what? Practically everything!

quests.title: Productive Bees
quests.description:
A whole 6 update versions ago and Bees still barely do anything! 

Unless you use Productive Bees, then they do everything! 

From making Honey Combs, to free AllTheModium, to duplicating Logs and Stone. These little Bee buddies do whatever you need them to. 

All they need is the Flowering Block and a Hive. The Upgrades and Genes are optional.

quests.title: Energy Cables
quests.description:
Not every Mod is like Mekanism where Machines just share Energy. Some will need you to move it instead! 

Pipez, Cables, Condiuts it doesn't matter all can move Energy from one Machine to another. 

Each Machine and Pipe has their own Configurations for where Energy goes in and out of. To change it for Energy Pipes you'll need some sort of Wrench on each end to change which Pushes and which Pulls.

quests.title: Mining Dimension
quests.description:
The Mining Dimension is a Superflat world with absolutely nothing on the surface. 

Below the surface is almost every single Ore. 

The Mining Dimension has no Caves, no Mob Spawns, and nothing to get in your way. It's just Stone types and Ores! 

Ore spawns differ for the Y Level and layer in the Mining Dimension.

I recommend setting up a Quarry.

quests.title: Quarried
quests.description:
Before Quarries in the Mining Dimension used to mine everything but leave Allthemodium Ore. 

Now it will Mine Allthemodium but Void the drops... might want to be careful with your Quarries now! 

I recommend Mining with Ore Sight Potions if you are looking strictly for Allthemodium!

quests.title: 762581CAE5F5DDC1
quests.description:
A Magic Mod how fancy! Ars Nouveau is the Mod we'll be using to craft together Unobtainium and Allthemodium! 

The Enchanting Apparatus is a multiblock which is used for many recipes here currently. Start with an Arcane Core then put the Enchanting Apparatus ontop of it. Next, place Pedestals around the Enchanting Apparatus at the same Y Level. 

Then you can place the Items onto the Pedestals in any order, have Source nearby, and place the Source Gem in the Apparatus it will start! Then you will have crafted your Unobtainium-Allthemodium Alloy Ingot!

{ "text": "ARS NOUVEAU QUESTLINE", "color": "#55FF55", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "6AEDA2F9BEB57759" } }

quests.title: Allthemodium Tools
quests.description: Can't craft these anymore now you need to upgrade Netherite to it always. \nYes, it saves Enchantments and Repairs it!

quests.title: Overworld
quests.description: Place the Teleport Pad in the Overworld to go to the Mining Dimension.

quests.title: Unobtainium - Allthemodium Alloy Ingot
quests.description: Unobtainium combined with Allthemodium!

quests.title: 552F0B9B00F4F914
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Allthemodium Mace
quests.description:
Vanilla couldn't have all the fun with Maces! So of course there is an Allthemodium upgrade to them! 

Upgrade a Mace with an Allthemodium Block to get the Allthemodium Mace. 

It does more base damage, more falling damage, and same Enchantments!

quests.title: Allthemodium Smithing Template
quests.description:
Another Item you can only find in Ancient Cities is the Allthemodium Smithing Template.

To get it you'll need to Brush suspicious Clay.

You can find it in the floors of the Ancient City.

{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_clay.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Vibranium Smithing Template
Unobtainium Smithing Template
quests.description:
Another Smithing Template?!?!?!

Well atleast you don't need Archeology for it!

You'll have to earn these by beating the Trial Spawners which are found in the Dungeon structure in The Other. More specifically the Library Rooms!

{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_library.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Allthemodium Alloy Sword
quests.description: Second in damage of all Swords. The first in damage does Infinite, and there's no competing with Infinite.

quests.title: Allthemodium Alloy Axe
quests.description: Does a ton of damage, and chops down trees! What more do you need?

quests.title: Allthemodium
quests.description:
Obviously now that you are in Chapter 2, you have beaten Vanilla Minecraft! 

By now you should have Netherite and have killed all the bosses Minecraft has. So what's next? 

Allthemodium is what's next! In order to start getting Allthemodium though you will need Netherite. Let's start there!

quests.title: Ancient City
quests.description:
Only the hardest Structure in Vanilla Minecraft. So of course that's where you'll have to look for Allthemodium!

You can find the Ore in the walls of Caves around the Ancient Cities, it's Glowing so it'll be easy to spot just very rare!

 You will also be able to locate it in any Deep Dark Biome.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_city.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Teleport Pad
quests.description:
For 4 Allthemodium Nuggets and an Ender Pearl you get a Teleport Pad. 

Place it down in one of the Minecraft dimensions to teleport to a different dimension. 

To teleport you need to shift right click with your main and offhand empty! That is important, read it! 

BOTH hands need to be EMPTY!

quests.title: The Nether
quests.description: Place the Teleport Pad in The Nether to go to The Other.

quests.title: The Other
quests.description:
The Other has seen dozens of changes over the years but always it has been a realm for adventures! 

There's dozens of new biomes, blocks, and of course structures! 

The Structures are: Piglin Village, Ancient Pyramid, and Dungeon. All containing amazing loot with some things being unique to their structure! 

You can also mine for Vibranium (and other ores!) or find it and better in the structures! 

You can't set up Quarries or many blocks in The Other though, no cheesing anything here.

quests.title: Ancient Pyramid
quests.description:
The Ancient Pyramid is one of the 3 Structures in The Other. 

Clearly it is a Pyramid and no this one doesn't have a basement! 

Instead it has the Piglichu! 

You heard me right, here it is no longer the Piglich, they have been transformed into a Pokemon named Piglichu. 

You can Fight and Catch them just like any other Pokemon! 

{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_pyramid.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Piglichu Hearts?
quests.description:
You might want to Catch them because that is the way to get Piglich Hearts in AllTheMons! 

Simply let your Piglichu wander around freely with a Pasture and they'll start Dropping Piglich Hearts. 

They just randomly Drop them on the ground unless you have a Chest nearby then they'll put the Hearts there.

quests.title: 7CC96CE9901F25BB
quests.description:
Forbidden and Arcanus is another magic mod, this one revolving around the Multiblock structure called, the Hephaestus Forge.

To make it follow the instructions in the forge's tooltip! Once made you can feed it the 4 Materials to power Rituals: Aureal, Souls, Blood, and Experience.

You'll also need to upgrade the Forge via Rituals (all these you can find in JEI).

quests.title: 766EEB89C6DF3575
quests.description:
Eternal Stella can be used to either make an Item Unbreakable by combining it with the Item in a Smithing Table. Or you can use it to craft Alloy Tools! 

First, you'll need a Tier 3 Forge with plenty Materials in it. 

Then, you'll need 3 Xpetrified Orbs. Which you need to feed a Black Hole Items to get. 

Plus, a Stellarite Piece which you need to Mine for! And Allthemodium Ingot which is the same.

quests.title: Allthemodium Alloy Paxel
quests.description: Only the greatest Tool in history! Like a swiss army knife but better! \n\nHighest Mining Tier, chops down Trees like butter, makes pathways, and of course hits a lot to be hit by!

quests.title: Vibranium - Allthemodium Alloy Ingot
quests.description: Vibranium combined with Allthemodium!

quests.title: 7B3613C01F0B1373
quests.description:
To combine Vibranium and Allthemodium we'll need to venture into Powah! 

Place the Energizing Orb down then put Energizing Rods facing it. The Energizing Rods need to be placed on a Power Source and will send Energy into the Orb. The amount each holds and sends is determined by the Tier. 

Place the Ingots, 2 Piglich Hearts, and a Compressed Block of Nitro Crystals X1 into the Orb (order doesn't matter). Then once 1 Billion FE is put into the Orb through the Rods it'll be ready!

{ "text": "POWAH QUESTLINE", "color": "#55FF55", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "2A6EBEEBAB882679" } }

quests.title: Allthemodium Ingot
quests.description:
To mine Allthemodium you'll need a Pickaxe that is Netherite Tier or higher! 

Once you finally get the Ore (first I recommend processing it either with Fortune, Occultism, or Mekanism to get more) then you can get a few choices of what to do with it. 

I recommend making 2 Teleport Pads with the Nuggets! You can use those to get to the Mining Dimension to find more Allthemodium or The Other to find other adventures. 

After that I recommend upgrading your Pickaxe so you can Mine Vibranium. The rest is all up to you!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_1.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Vibranium Ingot
quests.description:
Vibranium is the next ore after Allthemodium, so of course it requires Allthemodium Pickaxe (or the same tier) to mine it.

You can find it rarely in The Nether or abundantly in The Other.

It is also recommend to Ore Process it to get more.

Sadly, while it's a cool colored ATM ore, it has the least uses for different Items.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_2.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Unobtainium Ingot
quests.description:
No it isn't found in The Beyond. 

You can find Unobtainium Ore very rarely in End Highlands Biomes. Those are usually where End Cities spawn as well! 

You'll need a Vibranium Pickaxe (or same Tier) to Mine the Ore. 

Do I need to still tell you to Ore process it?
{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_3.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Allthemodium Alloy Pick
quests.description: A very fast pickaxe.

quests.title: Allthemodium Alloy Shovel
quests.description: Yes it can make pathways don't worry!

quests.title: Allthemodium Armor
quests.description:
Direct upgrade from Netherite Armor, because of this it will keep the Enchants. 

The full AllTheModium set has 24 Armor Points, 20 Armor Toughness, and 50% Knockback Resistance. 

What you think that's all they give? 

Helmets: Water Breathings, Immunity to Warden Darkness Effect, and no Elytra Damage. 
Chestplate: 50% Magic Damage Resistance and Fire Resistance. 
Leggings: Depth Strider and Immunity to Wither. 
Boots: Resist Fall Damage, let you walk on Powdered Snow and Lava.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_armor_all.png width:100 height:175 align:center}

quests.title: Vibranium Armor
quests.description:
The Vibranium Armor is an upgrade to AllTheModium Armor. 

We get upgrades for every stat! Now getting 32 Armor Points, 36 Armor Toughness, and 80% Knockback Resistance. 

Unfortunately we don't get new effects and abilities... but we get more Magic Damage Resistance! Now at 75%!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_armor_vib.png width:100 height:175 align:center}

quests.title: Unobtainium Armor
quests.description:
Unobtainium Armor is the best we can get from AllTheModium! We'll need it for the real best Armors! 

Unobtainium Armor gives 40 Armor Points, 60 Armor Toughness, plus 100% Knockback Resistance. You ain't going anywhere! 

Now, along with the other effects given by the previous Armors, we'll get 90% Magic Damage Resistance.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_armor_uno.png width:100 height:175 align:center}

quests.title: The End
quests.description: Place the Teleport Pad in The End to go to The Beyond.

quests.title: Unobtainium - Vibranium Alloy Ingot
quests.description: Vibranium combined with Unobtainium!

quests.title: Allthemodium Arcanist Armor
quests.description:
Similar stats as normal Allthemodium Armor but this comes with it's own set Mana Boosts, Regen, and Spell Power for Ars Spells!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_armor_allarcane.png width:100 height:175 align:center}

quests.title: Vibranium Arcanist Armor
quests.description: {image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_armor_vibarcane.png width:100 height:175 align:center}

quests.title: Unobtainium Arcanist Armor
quests.description: {image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_armor_unoarcane.png width:100 height:175 align:center}

quests.title: 15DC6770B112EE69
quests.description:
The Dissolution Chamber is a Machine added by Industrial Foregoing. It's also how we'll combine Vibranium and Unobtainium. 

You'll need Pink Slime which you get from the Mob Slaughter Factory which is another Machine added by IF. 

You'll also need Soul Lava which is found in The Other, common in the Piglin Village. 

After those you'll need to put your Ingots and Piglich Hearts in the exact order, power it, and it'll be done!

{ "text": "INDUSTRIAL FOREGOING QUESTLINE", "color": "#55FF55", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "193F91842D2ED7D9" } }

quests.title: The Beyond
quests.description:
Welcome to The Beyond! 

There's nothing here! 

You might want an Angel Block.

quests.title: Allthemodium
quests.description:
Allthemodium is a mod added specifically by the AllTheMods Team to add more content after Netherite! 

You'll need to adventure through it to get some Items needed for the ATM Star. 

There is a Quest page now that you can follow for it!

quests.title: Piglich Heart Block
quests.description:
Piglich is a Boss added by Allthemodium which lives in the Ancient Pyramid in The Other. 

On death he'll drop 1 of his Hearts! You'll need 9 of them dead to make a Block of it... 

Thankfully there are ways to farm them!

quests.title: Apothic Mods
quests.description: The Apothic mods have multiple cores, each changing different parts of Minecraft.\n\nThe Attributes and Enchanting mods are what you'll need to follow to get the ATM Star!

quests.title: Zygarde Cube
quests.description: It's a cube, as all things should be.

quests.title: Steve's Carts
quests.description:
Steve's Carts is all about upgrading... well your Carts! 

What sort of upgrades? Pretty much everything but the kitchen sink! 

From Drills, to guns, to arcade machines! What more could you want with your Carts?

quests.title: Galadorian Drills
quests.description:
Galadorian Drills are the greatest Drills we can attach to our Carts. 

Because of its greatness, that also means crafting it will be more difficult... 
Let's just say you'll need a lot of Stabilized Metal! Follow the recipes!

quests.title: 4D7D4C718837BCA5
quests.description:
The main part of the recipe for the Miniature Nether Portal is the Hellshelf of Masterful Sight. Usually it is used to see what Enchantments you'll get but we're here for the ATM Star not for Enchantments. 

You'll only need to enchant to an Infused Hellshelf which you can get from just a few Shelves. Then you need to craft with it to upgrade it even more! 

After that you can craft the Miniature Nether Portal, which no you can't walk through you're too big!

quests.title: 103834774B57D611
quests.description:
The Mini End Portal will need quite a few Endshelves. These are the last tiers of Shelves you'll get from Apotheosis. You'll need Infused Dragon's Breath to craft them. 

After that you'll just need Eyes of Ender which you'll need to have made them in order to actually get the Endshelves. 

If you somehow got to The End and got the Shelves without Eyes of Ender then I'm impressed!

quests.title: Applied Energistics
quests.description: Applied Energistics isn't a Storage Mod, it is THE Storage Mod. \n\nI personally don't know much about the Mod but the Quest page should help you learn it!

quests.title: Infused Dragon's Breath
quests.description:
Infused Dragon's Breath is obtained by... well Infusing Dragon's Breath. 

You can use 2 Soul-Touched Sculkshelves, 3 Heart-Forged Seashelves, 8 Normal Bookshelves, and 1 Geode-Encased Bookshelf of Stability. 

It'll also be needed for other recipes but we don't talk about that!

quests.title: 3F8AEBB994716318
quests.description: Wither is an Effect in Vanilla so of course we need our own way of using and abusing it! \n\nYou can Brew an Awkward Potion with a Wither Skeleton Skull to create it. Then you can craft Arrows with it!

quests.title: 2D64EF8D803AF9DA
quests.description:
The most expensive Portal we can make. First for Dragon Eggs you don't have to keep milking the Dragon you can use HNN or MA to get them or an Extrator to make more! 

Then, you'll need Infused Dragon's Breath from Enchanting. 

There you'll need Soul-Touched Sculkshelves to Enchant it and to make the Portal. 

If you are wondering why the Portal won't work, it's because you are already in the Overworld! Just kidding you can't use it!

quests.title: Roots Classic
quests.description:
Roots Classic may look small in JEI but I can promise you there's so much to it! 

Roots is all about using nature's gifts to make rituals.

Trust me you'll find these items everywhere!

quests.title: Singularity
quests.description:
A Singularity is a theorized point of ultimate density. Scientists believe the Universe we live in once was a Singularity. Every molecule in our Universe, in a single point smaller than a grain of sand. 

Of course with AE2 drifting along the line of theoritical sciences they have their own Singularity. 

There's 2 ways of crafting it but each require condensing a multitude of Items into one point!

quests.title: 256M Portable Item Cell
quests.description:
Incase you have to bring 256 Million Items on an Adventure with you! 

You'll need a few simple Items like MEGA Item Cell Housing, ME Chest, and a Dense Energy Cell. 

And we'll then need the 256M MEGA Storage Component... this one is much harder to make. 

If repetitive Crafting makes you hate Minecraft, then you might want to Craft the Blastproof Casing! 

We'll need either 2 256M Portable Item Cells, 2 Blastproof Casings, or a mix of both to Craft the Improbable Probability Device.

quests.title: 038812A14456236C
quests.description: By combining some Processors, an Energy Cell, and any Dense Cable we get the ME Quantum Ring. \n\nUsually we'd use it to connect our ME system across Dimensions but we only care about the ATM Star!

quests.title: Ars Nouveau
quests.description: Ars Nouveau is all about using Glyphs in Spellbooks to be able to cast them as Spells!

quests.title: Powah
quests.description: Powah is about power! Generating Power like FE to use Machines from other Mods like Mekanism or Industrial Foregoing! \n\nThere's different Tiers you'll have to craft up to and of course we'll need the last one for the Star!

quests.title: Productive Bees
quests.description: Minecraft Bees are adorable but the limited things Honey gives us isn't enough to justify the work to get it. \n\nWell unless you can get just about anything from the Bees, then that'd be different!

quests.title: Productive Trees
quests.description:
Guys I think you didn't hear me right I said Productive Bees! Oh wait there's another Mod! 

This one is related to Productive Bees as you'll need them for breeding Trees. 

No, Trees do not use Wheat to breed, they use Bees. 

The Trees and the Bees.

quests.title: Quantum Computer Multi-Threader
quests.description: When working on Computers, especially Quantum ones, the Hammers and Pliers on the Crafting Table won't be able to craft us what we need, we'll need a Crystal Assembler. \n\nFor this one we'll need a whole bunch of Singularities!

quests.title: Universal Wireless Terminal
quests.description: The recipe may look confusing but trust me it is pretty easy. Craft any Wireless Terminals then craft them together to make the Universal Wireless Terminal. \n\nIt will also keep whatever you had on the Terminal like Extended Patterns, that is very helpful for using AE2 but doesn't matter for the ATM Star!

quests.title: 601C719C8FD513F0
quests.description:
3 Netherite Ingots, 3 Wireless Boosters, and a bunch of fancy Gears we can get an Infinity Range Booster! 

The most confusing parts are the Gears. We can't make the Ingots directly we need to mix Dusts together then Smelt the result to get the Ingots.

This doesn't work across Dimensions sorry!

quests.title: Glyph of Wither
quests.description: Throw a few Wither Skeleton Skulls and an Abjuration Essence to make a Wither Glyph! \n\nIf it didn't work you might need more EXP.

quests.title: Cataclysm
quests.description:
Cataclysm is an adventure Mod that is all about adding new Bosses! And everything from and around them! 

You'll find the Structures all around the Overworld, The Nether, and The End. 

Within will be new Mobs, Minibosses, and very difficult Bosses. You can kill them all to get new Weapons, Armor, and Items!

quests.title: Create
quests.description:
Finally! Create has been updated and it is definitely worth the wait! 

Create is all about rotating and using Rotational Power... well for practically everything! Crafting, crushing, mixing, brewing, ETC. 

If it has been so long that you don't remember how to use Create, you can use Modern Industrialization to Craft the ATM Star.

quests.title: Deeper and Darker
quests.description: If only that giant portal in the Ancient City did something! Oh wait with Deeper and Darker it can! \n\nYou only need a...

quests.title: Nitro Player Transmitter
quests.description: The Player Transmitter will supply energy to anyone with the Binded Card. That includes energy to all armor, tools, and items in their inventory. \n\nThe Nitro Tier is needed for the Star, which is of course the last and hardest one to get.

quests.title: Soul Lava Bee Spawn Egg
quests.description:
Soul Lava is a part of Allthemodium. It can be found in The Other very rarely underground, or common in Piglich Villages!

We'll need to take a Bucket of Soul Lava and pour it over a Ghostly Bee egg to make a Soul Lava Bee egg.

Then, you'll need to squish them or poke them for it's DNA to make a Spawn Egg!

{image:atm:textures/questpics/soul_lava_process.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Withered Comb Block
quests.description: When your Hives are vacant and in the dark you may find a little Bee visitor, the Skeletal Bee. \n\nYou can then feed your new visitor a Wither Rose to make them a Withered Bee.

quests.title: Socotra Dragon Sapling
quests.description:
To get the Socotra Dragon Sapling you'll need to Breed Wenge with Cocobolo. 

To get Wenge you'll need to Breed Cocobolo with Balsa. 

To get Cocobolo you'll need to Breed Balsa with Dark Oak. 

To get Balsa you'll need to Breed Acacia with Teak. 

To get Teak you can Breed Jungle and Dark Oak.

quests.title: 2D474F8075E9DBD0
quests.description:
First you need to place down the Casting Altar and Standing Stones in the pattern specified in JEI. 

Then, you'll need to put a Diamond Block, a Stick, and Blaze Powder into the Altar. 

After that, place down 4 Incense Blaziers around the Altar, put the Block of Coal in one, Acacia Bark in another, Verdant Bark in the third, and Birch Bark in the last. And light them all up with a Flint and Steel! 

Then Shift Right Click the Altar to start the Ritual! If it didn't work check the pattern the Standing Stones are in.

quests.title: Dragon Soul
quests.subtitle: Essence of the most powerful beings.

quests.title: Pulsating Black Hole
quests.subtitle: The unknown but yet it is everything we do know.

quests.title: Void Forge
quests.description:
Now this ones hard to get... we'll need to kill 2 Bosses and a Miniboss to get everything for the Void Forge. 

First, we'll need a Mechanical Fusion Anvil. To get it, visit the Ancient Factory which lies beneath the Overworld. 

Then, feed The Harbringer a Nether Star to power it up and kill it! The Harbringer will drop Witherite which can Craft the Mechanical Fusion Anvil. 

Next, we'll need the Infernal Forge. That is a Drop from the Netherite Monstrosity. 

Go to The Nether to find the Soul Blacksmith structure. Then, fight and kill the Netherite Monstrosity to get your Infernal Forge! 

Last and probably easiest is the Void Core. Thankfully it isn't dropped from a Boss, instead it is a Miniboss! 

Visit The End to find a Ruined Citadel, within you'll find the Ender Golem. This one will drop us our Void Core. 

Once you have everything, use the Mechanical Fusion Anvil to combine the Infernal Forge and Void Core to create the Void Forge.

quests.title: Abyssal Sacrifice
quests.description:
The easiest Item we'll need for the ATM Star from Cataclysm is the Abyssal Sacrifice. 

The most basic Items needed is the Blocks of Ingots and Amethyst which are just Vanilla Items. 

Then, you'll need a Nautilus Shell and a Heart of the Sea. These are Vanilla Items which are rare to get... unless you kill Deeplings which can drop them! 

You'll also need an Athame which is a weapon used by Deepling Warlocks and Priests and dropped by them on death. 
The last part gives us a choice, either Crystallized Coral or Coral Chunk. Both are drops from Coral Golem and Coralssus.

quests.title: Meat Shredder
quests.description:
The Meat Shredder is made from Witherite, which is a Drop from The Harbringer. 

You'll need to find the Ancient Factory which lies deep underground in the Overworld. 

Then you'll find the powered down Harbringer, to power it up we'll need to feed it a Nether Star! 

Then, after a very difficult and long boss fight, you can Craft the Meat Shredder!

quests.title: Blaze Burner
quests.description:
The Blaze Burner is actually probably one of the easiest Star Ingrediants! 

First, we'll need an Empty Blaze Burner. These are just 4 Iron Plates and a single Netherrack. 

Then, take your Empty Blaze Burner and find a Blaze. You should know where they spawn but incase you don't: Blazes spawn in Structures in The Nether. Just Right Click the Blaze with the Empty Blaze Burner to capture it! 

Once captured, it can be used in exchange for the Uranium Quad Fuel Rods to make the Philosopher's Fuel.

quests.title: Mechanical Arm
quests.description:
The Mechanical Arm is a very confusing but also very helpful Machine from Create. Thank God, I don't need to explain how to use them, only how to Craft them! 

First, and simplest is the Andesite Alloy. That is just 2 Andesite Blocks and 2 Zinc/Iron Nuggets. 

Next, is the Brass Plates and Casing. Both obviously require Brass which is an Alloy made of Copper and Zinc! 

Last, is definitely the most difficult of these, the Precision Mechanism. You'll need a whole set up of Deployers and Belts to keep moving our Gold Plate to add more Items to it. 

1st step: is using the Deployer to add a Cogwheel to our Gold Plate. 2nd: is using similar to add a Large Cogwheel to it. 3rd step: has us adding an Iron Nugget with the Deployer. 

We'll need to repeat this 5 times to hopefully get our Precision Mechanism! Yep, there is an 20% you won't get the Item in the end! 

Hey, if you don't like all this work, you can always Craft the Large Advanced Motor.

quests.title: Heart of the Deep
quests.description:
When a Warden dies it has a chance to drop a Heart of the Deep. 

This can be used for the ATM Star, or to activate the Portal in the Ancient City! 

There can't be anything in the Portal to activate it, that includes Sculk!

quests.title: Pocket Storage
quests.description:
Pocket Storage is a mod that adds simple handheld storage. 

Right Click to open it and you can put Items in. They will have a max count that it can hold, and anymore Items put in past it will be voided. It will also vacuum up Items on the ground that are the same as in it. 

There's also ways you can dump it into Chests or take out of Chests quickly. 

The different Tiers the higher the Slots and Max Items will be.

quests.title: 6877F33323910716
quests.description: Tier 4 Pocket Storage has 64 Slots for Items and each hold 1,048,575 Items. That's 67,108,800 Items total. Move over Backpacks you've been replaced! \n\nIt only costs a few Nether Stars which in Modded honestly isn't expensive for what you get!

quests.title: Aerial Interface
quests.description: Aerial Interface works as a link between it's own internal storage and your Inventory. Basically whatever goes in it, goes to you. \n\nYou'll need a whole assembly line to craft it, the Quests should help you!

quests.title: Improbable Probability Device
quests.subtitle: Lack of wisdom is a thing of the past with this.

quests.title: Chain of Souls
quests.description:
The Chain of Souls works similar to a Grappling Hook. 

You can Right Click for it to send a Chain which will drag you toward the Block you shot it at. You can Right Click again to release it. Plus it has a Range of 90 Blocks give or take a few. 

To make it you'll need a Trapped Soul, 2 Tenacious Vines, and a Tenacious Petal. 

The first two you can get as drops from a Tangled Hatred while the last you'll need to kill a Lunar Monstrocity.

quests.title: Eternal Starlight
quests.description: Around the Overworld you can find Eternal Starlight Portal Ruins. There you can challenge the Gatekeeper to a fight! \n\nIf you win he'll give you some Items and with them you can enter the Portal to a whole new world to explore!

quests.title: Micromissiles
quests.description: You can craft these?!?!?! I've always just looted for them. \n\nYou can change if they home in on targets or fly straight. When homing you can change between the settings of Speed, Damage, and Turn Speed.

quests.title: Empty Soul Gem
quests.description:
Through Strigeor's Higher Binding we can make an Empty Soul Gem. 

These can be used to transport Mobs safely, or make the Dragon Soul. 

Personally I think we should do both!

quests.title: ATM Star
quests.subtitle: Does this mean you win?
quests.description:
It does. 

You have created the ATM Star, that means you have beat the modpack!

So what's next?

quests.title: Blaze Burner
quests.description:
To make the Philospher's Fuel we get a choice of whether we want to use Blaze Burners or Uranium Quad Fuel Rods. 

Whichever you find easier to Craft! 

(AKA the Blaze Burner!)

quests.title: Oblivion Shard
quests.subtitle: Power and destruction like no other!

quests.title: PneumaticCraft
quests.description: No pressure! Well actually you'll need a lot of Pressure with using PneumaticCraft. \n\nThat's kinda what it's all about...

quests.title: Dragon Familiar Spawn Egg
quests.description:
Another Ritual of course, this one being Ihagan's Enthrallment. (BTW in order to sacrifice a Horse you need it nearby while doing the ritual) 

Once done you will be given a Spawn Egg for a Dragon Familiar. These can either be used in crafting to get the ATM Star, or you can spawn the Familiar. 

This one will follow you around and can be pet by using Shift Right Click on it.

quests.title: Stable Wormhole
quests.description: Through the ritual of Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion we can combine a Wormhole Frame, 2 Quartz, and an Enderpearl to get our Wormhole!

quests.title: Insanite Blocks
quests.description:
To get Insanite Blocks you'll need 8 Insanite Ingots and 1 Block of Inanite. Yes, I know it's confusing with only a single letter difference. 

To get Insanite Ingots you'll need to reprocess Benitoite with Rossinite in a Reprocessor. 

Benitoite needs to be Mined in The Nether. 

Inanite Blocks are made by combining 8 Inanite Ingots with a Block of Netherite! Inanite not Insanite. 

To get Inanite Ingots you will need to reprocess Ridiculite with Rossinite in a Reprocessor. 

Ridiculite is another chain of recipes that quite frankly I'm tired of looking at!

quests.title: Dimensional Seed
quests.subtitle: Garden of Eden in just a single Seed.

quests.title: Occultism
quests.description: I think this Mod is unrealistic. I don't care what Books or Items you have, I don't think the Demonic will follow your every command and work as a slave for you. \n\nRegardless you can follow the Quests to do so.

quests.title: Patrick Star
quests.subtitle: Too bad SpongeBob isn't a Star.

quests.title: Extreme Reactors
quests.description:
Nuclear Reactors can be pretty scary to some especially with the dangerous effects of them! 

Luckily the only thing scary about Extreme Reactors is how confusing it can be to follow the recipes! 

Not the explody part they don't do that.

quests.title: Awakened Supremium Ingot Block
quests.description: Awakening is a relatively new addition to Mystical Agriculture. Through the Awakening Ritual you can make Awakened Essence. \n\nThen you can combine those with Ingots to get this Block!

quests.title: Insanium Coal Block
quests.description: You can combine the Essences from Mystical Agriculture to make... Coal. \n\nObviously it works as an amazing Fuel source but Insanium Coal seems a little too insane for me.

quests.title: 4 Insanium Blocks
quests.description: For Creative Essence you'll need 4 Insanium Essence Blocks. Each Block is 9 Essence now let me do the math... \n\nYou'll need 9,216 Inferium Essence to get just one of these Blocks. So you'll need 36,864 Inferium Essence total!

quests.title: Master Infusion Crystal
quests.description:
Like its inferior brother, the Infusion Crystal, the Master Infusion Crystal does everything the former can as well. 

This one just has Infinite Uses and can upgrade 4 Blocks of Essence to the next one in Block form! 

It does require Supremium to make it, but trust me it's worth it!

quests.title: The Star's Casing
quests.description: The ATM Star needs a few Blocks to hold together the different Items, and make its star shape! \n\nThe first Blocks are Unobtainium - Allthemodium Alloy Blocks. You need to use an Enchanting Apparatus from Ars Nouveau to make them!

quests.title: Smelter Prism
quests.description:
To get later recipes you'll most likely need a Smelter Prism and don't worry we only need a Tier 1 Forge to get it! 

You can check how much of each Stat in the Forge you need in JEI! Plus you'll need 4 Blaze Powder, 2 Coal, and an Arcane Crystal. 

Lastly, you'll need Elementarium which can be found in Jungle Temples, Desert Pyramids, and Underwater Ruins!

quests.title: Mystical Agriculture
quests.description:
Mystical Agriculture is a mod about agriculture, but what are you farming for?

Pretty much anything, from Honey to Steel to Wither Skeletons.

You'll need to do a lot of farming with this mod to make the ATM Star!

quests.title: 57F107892FFA1F52
quests.description: To grow Nether Star Seeds you'll need a Crux below the Farmland. Yes growing Nether Stars needed to be made more expensive! \n\nTo make the Nether Star Crux you'll need Withering Souls which have a 1/3 chance drop from Withers.

quests.title: Witherproof Bricks
quests.description:
The Wither has a tendency to break and blow up Blocks. 

Most players do not enjoy this, so the Witherproof Bricks are just what you are looking for! 

They are just like Witherproof Blocks, just with a better design!

quests.title: 4 Insanium Gemstone Blocks
quests.description: Each Insanium Gemstone is 2 Insanium Essence. So each Gemstone Block is 18 Insanium Essence. \n\nThat means we can take our 9,216 Inferium Essence for the Insanium Blocks and double it to get 18,432 Inferium Essence for just the 4 Insanium Gemstone Blocks.

quests.title: 2 Rainbow Furnaces
quests.description:
The Rainbow Furnaces will smelt a stack of Items at a time! 

To craft it you will need a Rainbow Core which needs 2 Netherite Furnaces and all the colors of the rainbow in Glass! 

Then, you'll need Rainbow Plating which you get from combining almost every other Furnace in the mod. You'll need 2 of them to craft the Improbable Probablility Device.

quests.title: Rainbow Coal
quests.description: Rainbow Coal is obtained by blowing up a Rainbow Furnace.

quests.title: Eternal Stella
quests.description:
The Eternal Stella is quite expensive. You'll need a Tier 3 Forge first! 

Then, you'll need Stellarite Piece which you can mine for. And you have to get 3 Xpetried Orbs which you can no longer mine for. Instead you'll have to feed a Black Hole EXP to get it! 

Finally, you'll need an AllTheModium Ingot to get the Eternal Stella. It makes sense why it is so expensive as it can be combined with any Tool to make it Invincibile!

quests.title: Forbidden & Arcanus
quests.description: Forbidden & Arcanus is all about using the Arcane to do rituals with the Forge to become stronger! \n\nOr what most know it for, Eternal Stella. There's more to the Mod you know!

quests.title: Iron Furnaces
quests.description:
Furnaces just aren't fast enough in normal Minecraft, so how do you think they're going to fair in Modded!?

Thankfully Iron Furnaces helps speed them up by a lot! 

It also has a Quest page it is just rooming together with Generator Galore.

quests.title: Wither Builder
quests.description:
The Wither Builder is one of the greatest Machines you can get from Industrial Foregoing, and because of that it's expensive. 

First you will need the parts that make a Wither and a drop from the Wither. 

Then, you'll need a Supreme Machine Frame which you need Ether Gas to make. Guess what you need for Ether Gas? That's right! A Wither! You'll need a Laser Drill working on a Wither to get it. 

Withers like to leave and kill things so a Stasis Chamber would make milking them easier!

quests.title: 64x Magmatic Generator
quests.description: This one can either eat Lava like no other, or be used for the Star. \n\nThis one's a hard one, I like seeing Lava disappear instead of my stuff disappearing into Lava.

quests.title: Paradox Machine
quests.description: The Paradox Machine can, for a price of a lot of Power and Time Fluid, will take a Snapshot of blocks and entities in the designated area; then it can duplicate it. \n\nLots of Blocks and Entities are blacklisted by configs so no duplicating Bees!

quests.title: Industrial Foregoing
quests.description: Industrial Foregoing is a Tech Mod with tons of Machines and Tools. All following the same Color Code! \n\nYou'll need to start with Rubber and yes there is a Quest page for it!

quests.title: Explosive Mycelial Generator
quests.description: The Explosive Mycelial Generator does an amazing job at soaking up Explosions. \n\nWe could use that for a Pulsating Black Hole!

quests.title: Tesla Coil
quests.description:
The recipe for the Tesla Coil might seem complicated, especially in a recipe tree, but we can break it down to be simpler!

The Aluminum Plates are very simple, just needing to use a Hammer on Ingots or the Metal Press Multiblock.

The Iron Mechanical Component is simple as well, just a few Iron Plates and a Copper Ingot.

Electrum Coil Block will need a bunch of Electrum Ingots cut up into Wires. Electrum is an alloy of Gold and Silver.

The Advanced Electronic Component is a whole array of using the Engineers Workbench and Blueprints. It's Duroplast Sheet requires a lot of refining and fermenting with Multiblock Machines!

The last item, the HV Accumulator needs some simple Items like Steel, Aluminum Plate, Redstone Acid, and Treated Wood. It also needs a more complicated Item called HOP Graphite Ingot.

quests.title: Ender Generator
quests.description:
You can upgrade your Obsidian Generator into an Ender Generator. 

Then, it can use Ender Pearls or Eyes of Ender to make Energy! 

Or make the Star, your choice.

quests.title: Generator Galore
quests.description:
Generator Galore gives us tons of helpful and simple Power Generators! 

Some can even be combined with each other to be more powerful. 

There is a Quest page for them it's just roomates with Iron Furnaces.

quests.title: 31B0267C47DB9D98
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: 2 Antimatter Pellets
quests.description:
Late Game Mekanism is just insane. For 1 Antimatter Pellet you need to crystallize 1,000mb Antimatter. 

For 1mb of Antimatter you need to power 1,000mb of Polonium through the SPS. 

To get 1mb of Polonium you'll need to activate the Neutrons of 5mb of Nuclear Waste. 

And Nuclear Waste you get from processing Fissile Fuel through a Fission Reactor!

quests.title: 77F2271C45DB49BA
quests.description: This Module, when put into the MekaSuit Chestplate, will give you Creative Flight. \nYou only need some of the most expensive Items in the game to craft it!

quests.title: 4CB488E5CF10F3A4
quests.description: Only the most powerful and expensive Generator from Generator Galore. \n\nYou'll need an Echo Shard, a Conduit, and a ton of Netherstar Generators!

quests.title: Ender Dragon Data Model
quests.description:
By Right Clicking an Ender Dragon with an empty Data Model, you can make the Ender Dragon Data Model. 

The Quest needs any version of it, but the Dragon Soul needs the Data Model to be Self Aware. 

In order to get it Self Aware you need to keep killing the Dragon or make a crap-ton of Predictions!

quests.title: Just Dire Things
quests.description: Direwolf is a name synonymous with Modded Minecraft and Just Dire Things is one of his babies. \n\nIt revolves around Goo, yeah I know sounds enticing!

quests.title: Immersive Engineering
quests.description: Immersive Engineering is all about Multiblock Machines, fun Tools, and of course engineering. \n\nDon't worry you won't need 4 years of college for this! But a Manual might help you get started.

quests.title: Mekanism
quests.description:
Mekanism is one of the most popular Machine and Technology Mods. Quite frankly I have a hard time summarizing it as it has so much in it! 

It has so much we even had to make 2 Quest Pages for it! 

The stuff we need for the ATM Star is in the Reactors page but you'll need to get through the Mekanism page to get there.

quests.title: Hostile Neural Networks
quests.description: Hostile Neural Networks is all about simulating Mobs for farming their Loot! \n\nNot much else to it.

quests.title: Patrick Star... Bee?
quests.description:
In order to automate ATM Star crafting, we'll need Star Shards. In order to get Star Shards we'll need Starry Bees. 

And of course, to get Starry Bees we'll need Patrick Bees! You can rarely get Patrick Bees by fishing in Warm Oceans! 
If you don't wish to convert them, you can also farm Patrick Stars with them.

quests.title: Starry Bee!
quests.description:
By Right Clicking a Patrick Bee with an ATM Star Block, you'll get a Starry Bee! 

You'll need another ATM Star Block for them to pollinate... I probably should have told you that before... 

The Starry Bees will make Starry Combs which can then be used in a Centrifuge to rarely get Star Shards!

quests.title: 635BA2C17458E9E6
quests.description:
For such a simple recipe you actually get a pretty darn useful Machine! 

Simply place it down, (how you place it changes where it aims like a dispenser!) give it some Power, and set how it works with a Redstone Torch. 

If it's set to deactivate that means it will deactivate when a Redstone Signal is sent to it. On Pusle that means it will activate whenever a Redstone Signal is given to it. 

We are just looking to automate the Star so I won't go too in depth, we'll start with a Lens!

quests.title: Soul Binding Crystal
quests.description:
The Soul Binding Crystal is the most difficult one to craft. 
Ender Pearl Fragments can be crafted from Ender Pearls which can be farmed from Endermen. You can use an Extractor to get infinite Amethyst. Quartz can be farmed from MA. 

Now we need to focus on the Souls. To start we need normal Souls! Which we usually use a Soul Extractor on Soul Sand to take the Soul out of it. 

But that's from using an Item, and it changes the Soul Sand... First, we can replace ourselves by using a Clicker from Just Dire Things! 

Now we just need to replace the Souless Sand with Soul Sand, which can be used with Block Breakers and Placers, also from Just Dire Things. 

Now we can combine Souls with Corrupti Dust and Trapped Souls (farmed Items from Lunar Guardian) to get Corrupt Souls. 

Finally, combine Souls with Liquid Aureal and the Holy Hand Grenade to make Enchanted Souls. The Holy Hand Grenade is from a line of recipes from Reliquary.

quests.title: But why?
quests.description:
Technically you can also use the Crusher to make the ATM Star into 5 Star Shards... 

But you'll need 262 to make a new Star... 

So why would you?

quests.title: Runic Enchanter
Terrastomp Prism
quests.description:
This ones a little more expensive but also a little more fun! 

Diamonds can be gotten through practically any Mod. 

Flint can be obtained through many different ways of processing Gravel: Squeezing, Crushing, Enriching...? 

Dripstone and Dripstone Blocks (which are just 4 Dripstones) can be created from Extrators or Mixers, both do need original Dripstones to make more though.

quests.title: Whirlwind Prism
quests.description:
This one I'd argue is the easiest to automate. 

Phantom Membranes, Feathers, and Wool can be automated via HNN. 

Only the Bat Wing is more difficult needing to be farmed via spawners!

quests.title: Lens of Certain Death
quests.description:
Drop a Lens Item infront of the Atomic Reconstructor and when it activates it'll transform into a Lens of Color. 

Drop a Lens of Color infront of it, and when it goes it will make a Lens of Detonation. 

Keep doing this until you get Lens of Certain Death.

quests.title: Star Shards
quests.description: Now that you got Star Shards, you can start making the different parts to remake our Stars! \n\nYou'll need 262 Star Shards total to remake 1 Star... hope you've got a good Bee set up!

quests.title: 4A6B585C2394A89A
quests.description:
The two Items we need via Runic Enchanter is Infused Dragon's Breath and Mending Books. 

Infused Dragon's Breath is pretty simple, just Fluid XP, Source, and Dragon's Breath! 

Dragon's Breath can be farmed pretty easily with HNN or even better, an Extractor from XyCraft. 

Mending Books can be automated with Fluid XP, Source, Lapis Lazuli, Supremium Enchanting Base, and the hardest part the Experience Rod. 

Lapis can be from MA, Bees, or even just Quarries. 

Experience Rod will need two alloys from EnderIO: Soularium and Energetic Alloy. Both can be made from Alloy Smelter. 

The Supremium Enchanting Base is a new Item made for the Runic Enchanter, you'll need to use tons of EXP Essence and Tiered Essences to get from a Book and Quill (which can be automated via HNN) to the Supremium Enchanting Base!

quests.title: Sea Prism
quests.description: Honestly just use MA for this one. It is the easiest way to get all of them. \n\nPlease don't make mass Turtle breeders and mass Guardian slaughter farms. TPS is important!

quests.title: Smelter Prism
quests.description:
Very simple recipe, only needing Coal, Blaze Powder, and an Arcane Crystal Block. 

Coal and Arcane Crystal can be obtained via Quarries, Bees, or MA. 

Blaze Powder can be gotten from the last two Mods mentioned, or Farms and HNN. There's too many ways of getting Blaze Powder.

quests.title: Lens of the Killer
quests.description:
Don't worry there's no more dropping at this stage! 

Now we just need to craft! Craft the Lens of Certain Death, with a Diamond Sword, and Enchanted Book of Sharpness V. 

You can get the Enchanted Books from the Runic Enchanter! Which you can learn more in another Quest!

quests.title: Infused Patrick Star
quests.description:
In order to remake the ATM Star we'll need an Infused Patrick Star, which also needs a Patrick Star for it. Both are made via Runic Star Altar. 

The other items needed to make Infused Patrick Star are the 4 Mending Books and Infused Dragon's Breath which are obtained through Runic Enchanting. 

Star Shards which we get from our Bees! 

And Alloy Ingots: Vibranium-Allthemodium, Unobtainium-Allthemodium, and Unobtainium-Vibranium Ingots. 

All three are crafted in their own unique ways described in the Allthemodium chapter! 

Throw all of these into a Runic Star Altar, plus 85MFE, and we'll get our Infused Patrick Star!

quests.title: Automatic Hepheastus Forge
Arcane Crystals
quests.description:
You can get Mundabitur Dust in many different ways so I'll just give you a quick introduction to Arcane Crystals! 

Which yes are a crafting ingrediant if you want to craft it. 

You'll have to mine for Arcane Crystals first; then, you can use MA or Bees to make more!

quests.title: Mundabitur Dust
quests.description:
1. You'll most likely just loot End Cities for it. 

2. To automate it you'll need to get all the items. 

Bonemeal, Gunpowder, Redstone, Blaze Powder, and Phantom Membrane can all be automated with HNN or MA. 

Arcane Crystals will need either Bees or MA for it then smelt it into Dust.

quests.title: Corrupti Dust
quests.description:
Most of the Corrupti Dust is easily automated. 

Nether Wart can be made with any auto-farm. Blaze Powder and Enderpearl Fragments can be made from HNN. And Arcane Crystals are shown in another Quest. 

Just Obsidiansteel will need to be automated from the Runic Crucible.

quests.title: Runic Crucible
Fully Automated ATM Star
quests.description: With the Infused Patrick Star, 5 Star Fragments, Corrupti Dust, Mundabitur Dust, and the Lens of the Killer we can rebuild ATM Stars, 100% automated! \n\nNow these Creative Items will be a breeze to craft!

quests.title: Creative Locomotive
quests.description:
Apparently this one didn't have a recipe by default! It's like the Mod Dev didn't want you using your Creative Locomotives in Survival. 

I didn't think they were too OP so enjoy your Trains! 

They work like normal Locomotives just without needing Fuel or Energy! Just need Rails.

quests.title: Energy Cell (Creative)
quests.subtitle: Unlimited Powah!
quests.description:
For this Creative Energy Cell, not to be confused with the other Creative Energy Cell, you'll need 4 Nitro Cells. 

Each Nitro Cell needs 2 Spirited Cells, and each Spirited Cell needs 2 Niotic Cells. This goes on for awhile... 

I'm not doing this math, get a Recipe Tree, I got more important things to do!

quests.title: Creative Energy Cube
quests.description:
Don't be confused there is a full and empty Creative Energy Cube. 

Empty Cubes work as an Energy Trash Can, voiding any Energy coming into it. 

Full Cubes work as an infinite energy storage. You'll need empty Energy Cubes to make it though... and those are expensive! 

Energizing 4 empty Energy Cubes with an ATM Star you can get the full one.

quests.title: Creative Compressed Iron Blocks
quests.description:
For 8 Stacks of Compressed Iron Blocks and an ATM Star you can get the Creative Compressed Iron Block! 

This can be set to any temperature you want it to be set to, which can then be used in your Machines. 

8 Stacks of Compressed Iron Blocks equals 4,608 Compressed Iron Ingots... good luck!

quests.title: Creative Compressor
quests.description:
The Creative Compressor allows you to choose any Bar Pressure you want! Positive, Negative, even 0! It can be used within Machines. 

You'll need 4 stacks of Advanced Pressure Tubes, Advanced Liquid Compressor, Advanced Air Compressor, Electrostatic Compressor, and a Flux Compressor. 

I don't know what's harder getting the Star or remembering all the Items you need to make this!

quests.title: Creative Jetpack
quests.description:
Don't you hate when you run out of Energy in your Jetpack? Well you'll neever need to worry about that again! 

You might need to make every Jetpack before it, an ATM Star, plus more expensive Items but hey it is worth it! 

Just put it on and use it as normal, just with less charging.

quests.title: Creative Energy Cell
quests.description:
This one works like normal infinite energy storage, just this one can connect to your system though! Never have to worry about if your System has enough Power! And that includes the Quantum Armor. 

You'll need 4 Superdense Cells and an ATM Star. Each Superdense Cell needs 8 Dense Cells, each Dense Cell needs 8 Energy Cells. 

256 Energy Cells... plus a lotta energy!

quests.title: Creative Energy Battery
quests.description: The easiest infinite Energy storage, only needing 4 Energy Batteries (from ID) and a Star! \n\nYou'll need to energize them all with... well as much Energy as Minecraft can handle... Quite literally the integer limit!

quests.title: Creative Source Jar
quests.subtitle: Get this first!
quests.description: Currently a pretty simple recipe, only needing 4 Source Jars, 4 Source Gem Blocks, and a Star. Don't worry this will be changed to be even harder! \n\nThis jar is always full of Source and can be linked to anything needing Source. Including the ATM Star multiblocks.

quests.title: Creative Spellbook
quests.description:
This one might be a bit confusing, there is quite a few Creative Spellbooks! But the one we want is from AllTheArcanist Gear. 

To make this one we need to craft the one from Ars Nouveau. That Spellbook needs an Archmage Spellbook, ATM Star, and a few extra Items. 

It has the same configs as an Unobtainium Spellbook but has infinite Mana and all Glyphs unlocked! 

All the Spell Power BWAHAHAHAHA!

quests.title: Pasture Block
quests.description:
The Pasture Block works hand in hand with the PC. Just this one lets your Pokemon wander around a certain area! 

You can move up to 16 Pokemon to a Pasture. They will then walk around the area around the Pasture. 

Pokemon wandering will Attack Hostile Mobs or Mobs you Hit. 

If a Pokemon Faints, they will return to the PC.

quests.title: Revive
quests.description:
Toasting a Revival Herb will give us Healing Powder. 

This Powder will take away all Effects from your Pokemon. Like Paralyze! This will take away Friendship though... 

Or we can Craft it into Revive. This is an Item which will Revive a Fainted Pokemon and give them half of their Health back. 

You can make a more powerful Revive with 3 of them or make some Machines!

quests.title: 7217BEFB0088A442
quests.description:
Revival Herbs are grown in Lush Caves and can be Farmed in Farmland. 

Mature Revival Herbs will also Drop Pep Up Flowers! 

You can use a Revival Herb on a Pokemon that Fainted to Revive them... but they'll remember that and not in a good way. AKA you'll lose Friendship. 

How about we Smelt it to get Healing Powder or use that to Craft a better Revive.

quests.title: AllTheMons
quests.description:
Welcome to AllTheMons! 

Nope that wasn't a typo! This is a Cobblemon centered Modpack made by yours truly, the ATM Team. 

To get started you'll need a Starter Pokemon. To get it, Default is (M) 

Each Region has 3 Starters: Grass, Water, and Fire. You can Click the Icons or move the Arrows to choose. 

The Grass type has a Green Background with a Leaf Icon. Water type has a Blue Background with a Water Drop Icon. Fire has the Orange Background with a Flame Icon. 

Each Pokemon will have their Name and Description above them. Once you find one you like, hit the "I choose you!" Button! 

(Mudkip is my favorite!)

quests.title: Pokemon Center
quests.description:
Pokemon Centers are now their own Structures, outside of Villages. 

Well if you weren't playing before Public Release you wouldn't know that... 

They are big buildings made mostly out of White Concrete. Once you see the Glass Pokeball on top you'll recognize them! 

Pokemon Centers spawn all throughout your World. In it will be Villagers and plenty of Machines, like...

quests.title: Healing Machine
quests.description:
The Healing Machine will restore any Pokemon's Health and Attack Points when placed inside. It will also Revive Pokemon that Fainted. 

It can hold 6 Pokemon at a time and has a Charge. 

Everytime it is used it takes a bit of Charge. It gains Charge over time, obviously when not in use. 

You won't be able to take the ones from Pokemon Centers, instead you have to Craft one! 

Anti-theft policy...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/pokemon/poke_heal.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Pokemon Breeding
quests.subtitle: The Delibirds and Beedrills
quests.description:
Hey, Pokemon got to come from somewhere! 

If 2 Pokemon are roaming in a Pasture, they can Breed. But, there are many requirements before they can. 

First, we'll need a Male and Female in order to Breed. The Baby Pokemon will come from a Pokemon Egg, it will be the same Species as the Mother. 

Both Pokemons will need to be in the same "Egg Group". Use the Wiki, I'm not listing every single Pokemon! 

Lastly there are some Attributes and Pokemon themselves, which can't Breed... 

If you meet all the Requirements, then the Female Pokemon will lay an Egg every once in awhile!

quests.title: Ditto Breeding
quests.description:
Ditto is a true casanova, everyone loves him! 

Ditto can be used to Breed with any Pokemon that can Breed, as a substitute for a missing Pokemon. He can even Breed with some Pokemon that can't normally Breed! 

When you use a Ditto, the Egg will be the same Species as the Pokemon the Ditto bred with.

quests.title: PC
quests.description:
The PC is a Machine for Storing Pokemon. 

It has 30 Boxes each which can fit 30 Pokemon. You can Drag Pokemon from your Team into the PC or vice versa. 

When hovering over any Pokemon in the Menu you can see their Name, Species, Type, Nature, Ability, Held Items, and Moves. 

If you move a Pokemon over toward your Team there will be a Release Button. Press it with a Pokemon and that Pokemon will be released into the Wild! 

So no longer in your Pokeball or being your Pokemon at all.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/pokemon/poke_pc.png width:100 height:175 align:center}

quests.title: Medicinal Brew
quests.description:
Medicinal Brew! 

These can be Crafted or Brewed into Consumables. 

Ones that Boost Stats, ones that take away Effects, even ones that give Effects! 

Can you Brew them all?

quests.title: 1A609549BBCFFFAE
quests.description: Medical Leaks grow in the Waters of Rivers, Ponds, and Swamps. Basically anything but Saltwater. \n\nGet a Brewing Stand, fill some Bottles with Water, then Brew the Leaks into them to get a...

quests.title: 2EEF25FE72F8E4A3
quests.subtitle: Putting sticks on things
quests.description: If you're a busy trainer on the move a lot, you can craft a PC on a Stick and use it on the road just like you would a crafting table on a stick.\n\nIt comes in a Healing Station variation too.

quests.title: 0287136D3E986317
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.
