By default they have a top slot which only allows Input, but any side can be changed with the Engineer's Hammer to Input, Output, or Neither.

quests.title: Transformers
quests.subtitle: Directed by Michael Bay
quests.description:
Transformers are how we go from LV Connections to MV Connections. The little Connector is LV and bigger one is MV! 

If you want to go from MV to HV we'll need an HV Transformer. These work the same as the other Transformer, just the smaller Connector is MV and bigger one is HV! 

No, you can't go from LV to HV without MV!

quests.title: Metal Press
Crusher
Sawmill
Mixer
Bottling Machine
Fermenter
Squeezer
Refinery
Assembler
Automated Workbench
Arc Furnace
Excavator
2F69010E1FA2787D
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: 5FE631066CAB7397
quests.description: Used to trap and transport mobs easily.

quests.title: Industrial Foregoing
quests.subtitle: Tier: 1
quests.description: Industrial Foregoing (IF for short) is a tech mod that adds many machines with various different uses.\n\nTo get started, craft a Pity Machine Frame.

quests.title: Wrenches that work with IF Machines
quests.description: I found myself annoyed at being unable to rotate Industrial Foregoing Machines with most Wrenches. To help with this, I have compiled a list of all the wrenches that I can find that are capable of rotating IF machines. These were tested primarily on the Laser Drill, so the results will focus primarily on that. Some wrenches might not work with other machines.\n\nClick the task in this quest to view all valid Wrenches for this quest.
task_titles: Wrenches that work with IF Machines

quests.title: Blocks
quests.description: These machines are used to automate block placing/breaking. This is especially useful when automating Latex.

quests.title: Infinity Tools
quests.description:
Infinity Tools, so called because of their ability to be charged near-infinitely. Increasing the tier of the tool can give said tool special perks. Having Biofuel in them will make them more efficient, by consuming the fuel instead of power when used.

There are 7 tiers:
Poor
Common
Uncommon
Rare
Epic
Legendary
Artifact

To learn more about each Infinity Tool, check out Industrial Foregoing's Manual (so that I don't have to cover so many infinity tools in one quest)!

quests.title: Animals
quests.description:
The Animal Rancher shears &zSheep and milks Cows.

The Animal Feeder feeds animals so they can breed.

The Animal Baby Separator teleports babies behind it.

All of these machines support Range Addons.

quests.title: Plants
quests.description:
The Plant Gatherer harvests plants in its working area. Harvested plants can give Sludge, which can be used in a Sludge Refiner. When supplied with Ether Gas, the Plant Gatherer will automatically replant crops.

The Plant Sower automatically plants crops and saplings. It has 9 color coded inventory slots, which correspond to the colored markings on top of the Plant Sower. The working area of the machine is divided into 9 segments, which correspond to the various inventory slots.

Both of these machines support Range Addons.

quests.title: 6E131A32A96D7BF5
quests.description: The Sludge Refiner can use Sludge to produce stuff like Dirt, Gravel, Soul Sand...whatever...check JEI for the rest.

quests.title: Item & Fluid Transport
quests.description: Transporters can be used to transport Items and/or Fluids between inventories that are 1 block away. You need a Transporter in the extraction side and another in the insertion side. To change these modes, right click the middle area.\n\nYou can have multiple transporter types in the same block. You can upgrade these with Addons. Speed to increase transfer speed, Efficiency to increase transfer amount.

quests.title: 33532408B21A5378
quests.description: The Pitiful Generator generates a small amount of FE using burnable fuels like Coal.

quests.title: 65C147F5282E8FCD
quests.description: The Infinity Charger is your best option for charging Infinity Tools. It holds a lot of FE, perfect for the Infinity Tools.\n\nIt can charge other stuff, too.

quests.title: Bio Power
quests.description: The Bioreactor produces Biofuel with Water and a bunch of different materials (check JEI for all valid Bioreactor Inputs). The more types of materials you provide, the more efficient the Bioreactor is at producing Biofuel.\n\nThe Biofuel Generator uses Biofuel made from the Bioreactor to generate FE.

quests.title: Sewer
quests.subtitle: Fresh from the Manure Field, your spookiness
quests.description:
The Sewer makes Sewage from animals in its working area, as well as absorb Experience from players to convert into Essence.

The Sewage Composter can turn Sewage into Fertilizer.

The Sewer supports Range Addons.

quests.title: 0EC2053B191C55C6
quests.description: Extracts Latex from logs, runs faster when given power.\n\nCheck JEI for acceptable logs and Latex amounts. The best log to use is Acacia or Mangrove.

quests.title: Latex
quests.description: Latex is a fluid used to make Dry Rubber, but it can also be used for some things in the Dissolution Chamber.

quests.title: 6FF04DD735346BED
quests.description: Turns Latex into Dry Rubber. Uses 750 mB of Latex and 500 mB of Water to produce 1 Dry Rubber.

quests.title: 0EA9E52B67B533DF
quests.description: When Rubber is smelted it turns into Plastic, which is the main resource in Industrial Foregoing.

quests.title: 690CFF61CE787D43
quests.description: Plastic is the main resource of Industrial Foregoing, you now have access to some very useful machines!

quests.title: 1823CC81D613892B
quests.description:
The Mob Slaughter Factory deletes mobs in its working area, and converts that mob into Pink Slime and Liquid Meat.

Passive Mobs -> More Pink Slime
Hostile Mobs -> More Meat

This machine supports Range Addons.

quests.title: Pink Slime & Liquid Meat
quests.description: Passive Mobs -> More Pink Slime\nHostile Mobs -> More Meat

quests.title: 408203C29BAABA44
quests.description: Only used for one thing.

quests.title: 483E93500E645835
quests.description: It's at least more versatile than the ingot.

quests.title: 616CFD4078D67B51
quests.description: Conveyors are another way to transport stuff. They work with items, entites, and even fluids. They can interact with the world with Conveyor Upgrades.\n\nYou can upgrade conveyors with Glowstone to make them faster, and with Plastic to stop them from picking up items.

quests.title: 4C366515E3CCB0B2
quests.description: Meat through a tube, yummy.

quests.title: Latex and Plastic? Huh?
quests.subtitle: Latex and Plastic? Huh?
quests.description:
In Industrial Foregoing, one of the main resources is Latex. Its used to craft Machine Frames, needed to make machines and upgrades.

Making Latex is pretty simple, Fluid Extractor extracts Latex from Logs (Acacia and Mangrove give the most).

------------------------

Now about making Plastic: Plastic results from smelting Dry Rubber - which is made in the Latex Processing Unit, that transforms Latex into Dry Rubber.

So basically Latex -> Dry Rubber -> Plastic.

quests.title: 57C4A0BAE739E903
quests.subtitle: The Crafting Table?
quests.description: The Dissolution Chamber is used to craft more advanced machines.\n\nYou will need to put a certain fluid in it along with the items needed for what you are crafting. Check JEI.

quests.title: Upgrades
quests.description: Used to make machines better. There are 4 tiers of addons, and 8 more specifically for Range.

quests.title: 0B35172E47705205
quests.subtitle: Ore Processing: Step 1
quests.description: Yes, Industrial Foregoing has ore processing too. This one uses Liquid Meat to convert an ore into Raw Ore Meat. I'm not an ore doctor, so I can't exactly do anything with this Raw Ore Meat. Maybe give it to the Fermentation Station?

quests.title: 34AA079FFAFC64BD
quests.subtitle: Ore Processing: Step 3
quests.description: The final step of the ore processing lineup of Industrial Foregoing, the Fluid Sieving Machine. This will use sand to filter out the useful part of Fermented Ore Meat, giving us some dust. Do whatever you want with that dust. Smelt it, mix it into an alloy.

quests.title: 06F84E2C484FAC5B
quests.description: Ever heard of a cobblestone generator? The Material StoneWork Factory works like one, but takes it to the next level. You can get it to crush stone into gravel, sand, silicon, you can get it to smelt it into stone, you can make Obsidian with it, and whatever else JEI shows for this machine.

quests.title: 2DC012EF21FB359E
quests.description: The Enchantment Extractor can automatically remove enchantments from gear. You can have it either go onto a Book, or have the enchantment be converted into Essence.

quests.title: 287B47E27EBC2C18
quests.description: The Enchantment Factory is basically an automated Enchanting Table. When provided with Gear/Books and Essence, it will enchant that item with something random. This machine can use fluids from tanks directly above it, to allow for an increased potential for enchanting gear and books.

quests.title: 3AFDE3396861A944
quests.description: The Enchantment Applicator is an automated Anvil. It can apply Enchanted Books to gear automatically. Uses Essence in place of Experience. This machine can use fluids from tanks directly above it, to allow for an increased potential for enchanting gear.

quests.title: 4A8C60412E59E971
quests.description: This machine can sort enchanted items and unenchanted items. The enchanted items end up in the top inventory, while the unenchanted items end up in the bottom inventory.

quests.title: 4F3EF1574F31A7E2
quests.description: The Stasis Chamber can hold mobs in place in its working area. The mobs held under stasis are also healed by the Chamber. Need more healing? Get some addons!

quests.title: 1684D52FDAAC894B
quests.subtitle: Ore Processing: Step 2
quests.description:
Remember that Not-An-Ore-Doctor fella? The Washing Factory fills in for him, to handle the Raw Ore Meat from the Washing Factory, turning it into Fermented Ore Meat. This machine has 4 modes.

1. 2x ore processing rate, 5 seconds to process.
2. 3x ore processing rate, 45 seconds to process.
3. 4x ore processing rate, 120 seconds to process. Uses Pink Slime as a catalyst.
4. 5x ore processing rate, 300 seconds to process. Uses Ether Gas as a catalyst.

quests.title: 224C07AC71C5F40E
quests.description: Applies Bone Meal or Fertilizer to plants in its working area. This will continue applying Fertilizer to the same crop until that crop can no longer accept Bone Meal before moving on to the next plant. This means that the machine can get stuck on plants that always accept Bone Meal, such as Sunflowers, or plants that never reach their final growth state.\n\nThis machine supports Range Addons.

quests.title: 2782EA80C1C74EBD
quests.description:
The Mob Crusher deletes mobs in its working area, collecting that mob's loot, as well as converting the Experience that mob would get into Essence. You can also optionally use the would be Experience to apply Looting to the Mob Crusher instead.

Bosses and other mobs that cannot go into spawners are "blacklisted" from the Mob Crusher. Instead of being deleted, they take 75 damage per operation.

This machine supports Range Addons.

quests.title: 15551AC6C68E12E0
quests.description:
Basically the spawner of Industrial Foregoing. It uses Essence along with a mob in a Mob Imprisonment Tool to spawn a copy of that mob.

Bosses and other mobs that cannot be put into a spawner* are blacklisted from the Mob Duplicator as well.

*With a few exceptions, hold SHIFT on a spawn egg while advanced tooltips (F3 + H) are enabled to see if you can find the Mob Duplicator Blacklist tag.

quests.title: 7CB4D47ABC295B92
quests.description: It brews potions. Much like a standard Brewing Stand, it requires Blaze Powder as fuel, and uses bottles. Unlike a Brewing Stand, though, it can autofill those bottles with water.\n\nUnlike with other quests where I give a brief overview of the machine, I will provide a setup in another quest to automate this machine, as it is fairly janky and unintuitive in some areas.

quests.title: 2E8E292ED596A104
quests.description: Laser Lens can make Ore Lasers focus more on a certain color of ore. Check in JEI to see what lens work best for a certain type of ore. It also determines what fluid type can be produced by Fluid Lasers.

quests.title: Laser Drill
quests.subtitle: Void Miner
quests.description:
The Ore Laser Base is Industrial Foregoing's Void Miner, being able to conjure ores out of thin air. Lens allow you to favor a specific color of ore, such as Blue for Lapis.

The Fluid Laser Base produces Fluids out of either thin air or from specific mobs. These require you to use specific Lens. Mobs that are used to produce Fluids will take damage, so using a Stasis Chamber for it is recommended.

Laser Drills provide progress to the Laser Base in its working area.

quests.title: Automating the Potion Brewer
quests.subtitle: Using AE2
task_titles: ME Export Bus OR ME Interface

quests.title: Understanding Ether Gas
quests.subtitle: Ether Gas? Huh?
quests.description:
Getting your first Ether Gas might be a little bit scary.

Ether Gas is made from drilling a Wither, using a Fluid Drill with a Purple Lens.

But don't worry about the Wither, Industrial Foregoing has a machine just to help you with that task. The Stasis Chamber is a machine that freezes in place anything that is on top of it in a 3x3 area, including the Wither.

Hope you don't run out of power, because if you do... I hope you're ready to fight the Wither. Because of this, I recommend using some kind of Wither-Proof Glass, such as Tinted Glass from Mob Grinding Utils, or Crystalix Glass with Reinforced Mode enabled.

quests.title: 605A5AC65BC7E864
quests.description: The Marine Fisher can fish automatically. Can catch fish, treasures, enchanted books, and some other stuff. Can't catch bees, though, you'll have to fish manually for that one.\n\nMust be placed above a 3x3 Water pool (or bigger).

quests.title: 0D2DD9AA960843A3
quests.description: The Mob Detector will detect entities in its working area, and output a redstone signal behind it with strength equal to the amount of entities in the working area.\n\nThis machine supports Range Addons.

quests.title: 22702838FC507A2E
quests.description: The Hydroponic Bed uses Energy and Water to grow crops and saplings planted on it. It supports pretty much any crop you can imagine. You can also provide Ether Gas so the machine automatically harvests the crop and puts the crop's results into its internal buffer. This can also gather crop data for a Hydroponic Simulation Processor, to use in a Simulated Hydroponic Bed.\n\nSaplings will require space to grow.

quests.title: Ether Gas
quests.subtitle: No, it's not a Mekanism Chemical, it's Wither Milk

quests.title: Simulated Hydroponic Bed
quests.subtitle: HNN but for crops?
quests.description: Ever feel like the standard Hydroponic Bed is too laggy? Can't fit enough Soul Surges? Allow me to introduce the Simulated Hydroponic Bed. This will use a Hydroponic Simulation Processor and a seed/sapling to grow any crop of your choice...virtually. You don't even need Water and Ether Gas for this one. On top of this, Hydroponic Simulation Processors get better over time as they grow more crops, though the rate at which it scales is slower in a Simulated Hydroponic Bed.\n\nDon't even bother trying to maximize the Processor. It will take an unfathomably long time. Much longer than what it would take for me to make the quests for Ender IO, for sure.

quests.title: Soulplied Energistics
quests.description: If you prefer not bringing Soul Pipes around, you can use AE2 instead.\n\nYou can put an ME Storage Bus on top of the Soul Laser Base to allow your ME network to access the Souls inside. These can be requested to be held in ME Interfaces.

quests.title: Industrial Foregoing Souls
quests.subtitle: Gotta go fast! (WIP)
quests.description:
Warning: As of writing, Mewtwo is unobtainable. As a result, the Industrial Foregoing Souls mod has no use at this time.

Industrial Foregoing Souls adds machines to allow you to accelerate other machinery.

The Soul Laser Base is the heart of this, working similarly to a Fluid Laser Base extracting Ether Gas from a Wither. It uses Blue Laser Lens to extract Souls from a Mewtwo, which can be extracted with Soul Pipes, or used with AE2. These Souls will be used by Soul Surges, in order to accelerate blocks. Yes, I know most of you are used to extracting Souls from a Warden, but come on, we had to give that thing a break.

Extracting Souls from the Mewtwo is a painful process to the creature, meaning it takes damage from the process, and can even die from it. Stasis Chambers are highly recommended, especially with upgrades to make the healing faster.
{@pagebreak}
Ensure there's a 3 block gap between the floor and the Soul Laser Base, like so:
{image:atm:textures/questpics/industrialforegoing/soul_laser_gap.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 28B3591BFC0FA08B
quests.description: The Wither Builder, as its name implies, builds Withers. It's part of the Wither's Compass for the ATM Star.\n\nYou may want to encase the Wither Builder in some witherproof glass, to prevent Withers from blowing it up.

quests.title: The Mycelial Reactor
quests.subtitle: Mycelial Reactor, huh?
quests.description:
The Mycelial Reactor consists of all the Mycelial Generators working at the same time, near the reactor block, and it produces a total of 25MFE/t.

All sounds good, but you need to automate some stuff to get it working, see what each Mycelial Generator consumes to work, and automate it, most things are simple, but others, not that much... looking at Disenchanting Mycelial Generator.

But after you get it all automated, you don't need to stop at one, you can make more reactors.

quests.title: 49EF8A4346AEF582
quests.description: Dropping Eclipse Ember into Voidflame Fuel will create Unrefined Eclipse Ember Fuel. Perfoming Goo Spread with Tier Four goo will convert Unrefined Eclipse Ember Fuel into Eclipse Ember Fuel.

quests.title: 40C5C355B6DA1893
quests.description: The Pocket Generator is a handheld generator that uses burnable items to charge items and tools in the player's inventory, the Pocket Generator is compatable with the Fuel Canister.

quests.title: 242F74010488F261
quests.description: The Fuel Canister is an item that allows for more efficent use of fuel. It can store 50,000 fuel, each burnable item has a different fuel value depending on the amount of items smelted. One fuel is enough to smelt one item.

quests.title: 53F9E5CE7EE6F852
quests.description: The Creature Catcher allows for the transport of mobs. Mobs can be blacklisted via an entitiy tag.

quests.title: 16E02F671FBE9148
quests.description: The Portal Gun is an item that uses power to create two portals to teleport between two points. Left Click shoots a blue portal, Right Click an orange portal and Shift Right Click removes both portals.

quests.title: 4F9932477EDDCB8E
quests.description: The Advanced Portal Gun is the upgraded version of the Portal Gun that requres both power and portal fluid to operate. Unlike the Portal Gun the Adavanced Portal Gun allows the player to teleport between locations that have been encoded. Using "V" (default keybind) the menu used to encode and select desinations for teleportion.

quests.title: 0FAF274ADA65B26A
quests.description: Portal Fluid is a mysterious green fluid vital in the operation of the Advanced Portal Gun.\n\nDropping Portal Fluid Catalyst into Polymorphic Fluid will create Unstable Portal Fluid BUT Unstable Portal Fluid can only exist in the End. Performing Goo Spread with Tier Three goo or higher will convert Unstable Portal Fluid into Portal Fluid.

quests.title: 70BF85E2D235BAD5
quests.description: Dropping Voidflame Coal into Blaze Ember Fuel will create Unrefined Voidflame Fuel. Perfoming Goo Spread with Tier Three goo or higher will convert Unrefined Voidflame Fuel into Voidflame Fuel.

quests.title: 3D9964CB0440DD5A
quests.description: Dropping Blaze Ember into Polymorphic Fluid will create Unrefined Blaze Ember Fuel. Perfoming Goo Spread with Tier Two goo or higher will convert Unrefined Blaze Ember Fuel into Blaze Ember Fuel.

quests.title: 76B1C5AFC5D6B7CF
quests.subtitle: Cousin of the Time in a Bottle
quests.description: The Time Wand can be used to accelerate blocks, similarly to the Time in a Bottle, up to x128 speed. Unlike TIAB, it uses FE and Time Fluid rather than stored time as fuel, making it considerably easier to refill.\n\nIt is blacklisted for fake players, though. We don't want you automating THIS.

quests.title: 200ECDC70E97D254
quests.description:
Fuel Canister is a tank that can fill containers with the fluid it contains.

The Fuel Canister has three fill modes:

 - None
 - Any
 - Just Dire Things

quests.title: 0B485DB737A036E9
quests.description: Machine Settings Copier allows players to copy settings between machines.

quests.title: 45A25221F54A1DEC
quests.description: The Ferricore Wrench allows the player to rotate machines, but it is also used to link swappers together.

quests.title: 48E4D75FD3145AD6
quests.description: Time Fluid is used by the Paradox Machine and Time Wand. It is obtained by dropping a Time Crystal into Polymorphic Fluid.\n\nFor a crystal so tough to get, I'm glad they gave us an easy fluid for once.

quests.title: 4458F8829800A950

quests.title: Time Crystal
quests.subtitle: Timey Wimey
quests.description:
Time Crystals are a new material added by JDT. These grow on Budding Time Crystal Blocks, which are created by performing goo spread on Budding Amethyst or a Time Crystal Block.

HOWEVER, the Budding Time Crystal Block must collect time from the Overworld, the Nether, and The End to be able to grow Time Crystal Clusters. You CANNOT break or use silk touch on the Budding Time Crystal Block. You must use a Swapper, Cardboard Box, or Cut Paste Gadget to move them.

After a while, the Budding Time Crystal Block will run out of energy, and must go for another trip to the Overworld, Nether, and End.
{@pagebreak}
To automate this process, look at the video linked in the image above this quest.

And if the color coding in the previous page wasn't enough, I added an image to help you know what stage is which Budding Time Crystal Block.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/justdirethings/budding_time_crystal_reference.png width:250 height:125 align:center}

quests.title: Dynamic Tank Multiblock
quests.description:
Dynamic Tanks are Multiblocks which can be made at any size that is atleast 3x3x3! 

Dynamic Tanks will hold a ton of one Fluid or Chemical. How many Buckets of that Fluid or Chemical can the Tank hold? That matters on the size. 

Dynamic Tanks are made out of Dynamic Tank Blocks with the inside of the Structure being hollow. The Walls can be made with Structure or Reactor Glass but the frame will need to be made of Dynamic Tank Blocks. 

You'll also need Dynamic Tank Ports in the Walls to actually take and place Fluids and Chemicals. Whether it takes or places is determined by whether they Push or Pull.

quests.title: Ultimate Tier
quests.description:
Ultimate Tier is the best we can get from Mekanism! Well atleast in Survival. 

These will give the most Slots, hold the most Items, and move the most Items! 

Each Ultimate Tier will need Atomic Alloys, Ultimate Control Circuits, and Diamonds. 

Atomic Alloys will need Refined Obsidian to create, follow the Osmium Compressor Quest to get those. But basically we'll need to Infuse a Reinforced Alloy with 20mb of Refined Obsidian. 

Then, combine 2 Atomic Alloys with 1 Elite Control Circuit to make the Ultimate Control Circuit!

quests.description:
Don't like picking up your Machines to Upgrade them? Why not just use an Item! 

With Tier Installers you can just use the Item on the Machine to Upgrade them! 

Throw the Basic Tier Installer onto a Default Machine to upgrade them to Basic Tier. 

No, you can't skip upgrades. Can't turn a Basic into Ultimate with one Installer.

quests.title: Bins
quests.subtitle: Drawers
quests.description:
You like Drawers? Mekanism gives us some! Just these are called Bins. 

Bins can hold only one type of Item but will hold tons of Stacks of that Item! 

You can use a Configurator on the Bin to set it to automatically Output to the Inventory below it. 

If there is an Item in the Bin, you can Shift Right Click it to Lock that Item. 

Basic: holds 64 Stacks. 

Advanced: holds 128 Stacks. 

Elite: holds 512 Stacks. 

Ultimate: holds 4,096 Stacks.

quests.title: Personal Storage
quests.description:
Drawers not your style? You like Backpacks better? Then you'll need a Personal Chest/Barrel! 

Both of these will act the exact same. After Crafting, Right Click with them to set yourself as their User. 

Then, only you can open this Chest/Barrel. Oh yeah by the way you can open it from your Inventory or by placing it down like a normal Chest/Barrel. 

It has 54 Slots but no upgrades...

quests.title: Fluid Tanks
quests.description:
What a Bucket isn't enough? A Stack of Buckets isn't enough either? Then friend, you'll need some Fluid Tanks! 

Fluid Tanks can hold multiple Buckets of one Fluid within them and can then be moved around like a Bucket. These unfortunately can not place Source Blocks though. 

To add or take out Fluid, you'll need Mechanical Pipes configured to do either or. 

Basic: will hold 32 Buckets of Fluids. 

Advanced: will hold 64 Buckets of Fluids. 

Elite: will hold 128 Buckets of Fluid. 

Ultimate: will hold 256 Buckets.

quests.title: Chemical Tanks
quests.description:
Like Fluid Tanks but screw Fluids we want everything else! 

Everything Pressurized Tubes can move, the Chemical Tank can hold. 

Basic: will hold 64 Buckets of Chemicals. 

Advanced: will hold 256 Buckets of Chemicals. 

Elite: will hold 1,024 Buckets of Chemicals. 

Ultimate: will hold 8,192 Buckets.

quests.title: Fuelwood Heater
quests.description:
The Fuelwood Heater will generate Heat by using Furnace Fuels. 

Logs, Coals, Charcoals, even Wooden Swords! 

I can't tell you how Hot it can get, but you'll know it is Heated by the Color of the Heater changing!

quests.title: Resistive Heater
quests.description:
The Resistive Heater will also generate Heat, but instead of using Furnace Fuel, it will use Energy! 

By feeding it Energy, we can choose however much Heat it will make. 

The more Heat it makes, the more Energy it takes! 

The max Heat is 9,999,999 something.

quests.title: Muffling Upgrade
quests.subtitle: shhhhh... too loud....
quests.description: Mekanism Machines can be pretty loud! \n\nLet's stop that!

quests.title: Elite Tier
quests.description:
Elite Tier comes right after Advanced. These have the same buffs as Advanced... just more! 

Elite are made with Reinforced Alloys, Elite Control Circuits, and most times Gold Ingots. 

You can get Reinforced Alloys from Infusing an Infused Alloy with 20mb of Diamond. That is 2 Diamond Dust or 1/4 Enriched Diamond! 

You can then use those Reinforced Alloys (2 of them) with an Advanced Control Circuit to make the Elite Control Circuit.

quests.title: Stone Generator Upgrade
quests.description:
Stone Generator is only for the Digital Miner. 

When used in it, they will automatically make Stone, instead of needing handouts. 

It will use these Stones to replace the Ores it picks up!

quests.title: Filter Upgrade
quests.description:
Filter Upgrades are used only in Electric Pumps. 

The Pumps will work the same, but instead of picking up Water, they will pick up Heavy Water. 

Heavy Water will be needed for Fuel for the Fission Reactor!

quests.title: Quantum Entangloporters
quests.subtitle: Wireless Power, Gases, Fluids, Everything.
quests.description:
"Through using highly detailed Atomic Machinery we can take all Matter apart to the molecular level and move those molecules through specific wave lengths..." Oh come on this is just Magic! 
With 2 Quantum Entangloporters we can Wirelessly move Items, Fluids, Chemicals, Heat, and Energy! 

First, we need to connect the Quantum Entangloporters. We do this by going into the Text Bar of one, and typing out a Network name. 

It can be Numbers, Letters, Symbols, whatever just Type it and hit the Checkmark Button! Then, go into the second Quantum Entangloporter and Click the name of the Set Network Name. Now they are connected. 

After that, Connect your Pipes, Tubes, Cables whatever, to a Quantum Entangloporter and place more or even a Machine to the other one. 

Once that is all ready, change the Side Configs in order to actually move our things around. Don't forget to set Auto-Eject!

quests.title: Dyes and Pigments
quests.description:
Mekanism has a couple of Machines just made for Coloring! 

There is 3 Machines we'll need to use and yes, in order! 

The Pigment Extractor will take the Color out of Dyed Blocks and make a Pigment! Pigments are Chemicals, and are used just like other Chemicals: moved through Tubes and held in Chemical Tanks. 

Pigment Mixer will take 2 Pigments and combine them into a new Color Pigment. This can even make some new Colors made for Mekanism Items! 

Painting Machine will take those Pigments and apply them to Blocks and Items that can be Dyed, to Dye them. This even works on Items that are already Dyed, you can't do that in Vanilla!

quests.title: Logistical Transporters
quests.subtitle: Items
quests.description:
Logistical Transporters will move Items and Blocks from one Inventory to another! 

In order to move Items to Machines though, we'll need to change the Configs within the Machine. Those are in the Top Left of the Machine's GUI, Side Configs. They'll need to be set to Auto-Eject to Output Items. 

Logistical Transporters are Crafted with 2 Steel Ingots and 1 Basic Control Circuit. You can then combine 8 Logistical Transporters with the next Control Circuit to upgrade them. 

Basic: will move 2 Blocks/Items across 1 Block each Second. 

Advanced: will move 32 Blocks/Items across 2 Blocks each Second. 

Elite: will move a stack of Items or Blocks across 4 Blocks each Second. 

Ultimate: will move 2 stacks of Items or Blocks across 10 Blocks each Second.

quests.title: Mechanical Pipes
quests.subtitle: Fluids
quests.description:
Mechanical Pipes will move Fluids. That is right! Not just Water! 

Mechanical Pipes are made with 2 Steel Ingots and 1 Empty Bucket. They are also upgraded in the same way as the Logistical Transporters. 

Basic: will hold 2 Buckets of Fluids and move 250mB of Fluid each Tick. 

Advanced: will hold 8 Buckets of Fluids and move a Bucket of Fluid each Tick. 

Elite: will hold 32 Buckets of Fluid and will move 8 Buckets each Tick. 

Ultimate: will hold 128 Buckets and will move 32 Buckets each Tick.

quests.title: Pressurized Tubes
quests.subtitle: Chemicals, Pigments, Infuse Types
quests.description:
Pressurized Tubes will pretty much anything the other Pipes can't move! Chemicals, Pigments, and Infuse Types are all moved with Pressurized Tubes. 

In order to move Chemicals in to Machines though, we'll need to change the Configs within the Machine. Those are in the Top Left of the Machine's GUI, Side Configs. They'll need to bet set to Auto-Eject to Output! 

You can Craft them with 2 Steel Ingots and a piece of Glass, any Glass! Then upgrade them with 8 Tubes and a Control Circuit. 

Basic: will hold 4 Buckets of Chemicals and move 750mB of Chemicals each Tick. 
Advanced: will hold 16 Buckets of Chemicals and move 2 Buckets of Chemicals each Tick. 

Elite: will hold 256 Buckets of Chemicals and will move 64 Buckets each Tick. 

Ultimate: will hold 1,024 Buckets and will move 256 Buckets each Tick.

quests.title: Thermodynamic Conductors
quests.subtitle: Heat
quests.description:
Thermodynamic Conductors will move Heat. Yeah, some Mekanism Machines use Heat! Like the Thermal Evaporation Machine. 

Most of the Heaters will have set Sides for Outputting Heat! 

I'm not sure what these numbers mean but following the pattern: more expensive, more good!

quests.title: Energy Upgrade
quests.description:
Almost every Machine will use Energy, and when we got dozens of them... it's definitely not easy on our Grids. 

If we add Energy Upgrades, the Machines will do the same Task, just now requiring less Energy to complete! 
If only we can put these on the S.P.S.!

quests.title: Speed Upgrade
quests.description: We don't have all the time in the World, let's Speed it up a bit! \n\nThe Reactors won't wait forever!

quests.title: Chemical Upgrade
quests.description:
Some Machines will use Chemicals especially to add to Items. Think, Metallurgic Infuser, Chemical Injector, and Purifiers. 

These will basically use less Chemicals for the same Tasks! 

I can't promise it'll work with every Item and Machine. And no, I am not testing with every Machine!

quests.title: Advanced Tier
quests.description:
Advanced is the Upgrade to Basic. 

Advanced Machines will hold more Items, move more Items, and have more Slots than Basic Tier. 

Advanced are made from Infused Alloys, Advanced Control Circuit, and usually Osmium! 

Advanced Control Circuits are made from 2 Infused Alloys and a Basic Control Circuit.

quests.title: Machine Upgrades
quests.description:
Most Machines, atleast the simple ones, can use Upgrades! 

Upgrades are in the Top Right of the GUI. This screen might be confusing but don't worry I'll explain it! 

First, the bottom shows the Supported Upgrades. The clear Upgrades are Supported while the more transperant ones are not! You can also hover over them with your Mouse to see their names and if they are Supported. 

Upgrades are added through the Top Slot, they'll then show up in the Right. Here you can Click them to see how many are in the Machine and see their Effect! 

If you'd like to take our Upgrades out, Click the one you want out, then hit the Uninstall Button. This will move the Upgrade into the Bottom Slot.

quests.title: Mekanism Logistics
quests.subtitle: The Configurator
quests.description:
You should know Logistics by know! This Quest will now be reserved to explaining the Configurator! 

By Holding Shift and Scrolling you can change the Mode of the Configurator. 

Wrench: will Drop Mekanism Machines and Blocks when used on them. 
Rotate: will simply Rotate the direction of the Block. 
Empty: will make it work like a Gauge Dropper. 
The rest of them will make the Configurator interact with Machines to change their Configs! 

If you use it on Pipes it will change if they Push, Pull, or Both. You can use it on Ports to set Inputs and Outputs. And even on Bins to set them to Auto-Export below them.

quests.title: Enriched Items
quests.subtitle: Enrich your items first!
quests.description:
Using the Enrichment Chamber, you can Enrich Items to convert them into Enriched variants.
These Enriched Items give 8x the amount of mb in a Metallurgic Infuser.
Enriched Coal will help make more Steel. Enriched Redstone will help with Infused Alloys and Basic Control Circuits. And Enriched Refined Obisidian will help make Ultimate Items!

quests.title: Basic Tier
quests.description:
Basic Tier is the simplest, cheapest, and worst Tier of Machines and Blocks! 

Well unless you count Default Machines as a whole new Tier but I don't. I just count it with Basic. 

Machines will start at default and can be Upgraded to Basic. While other Blocks like Pipes or Energy Cubes will start at Basic. 

All of these are made from Redstone, Basic Control Circuits, and sometimes Iron!

quests.title: Refined Obsidian Dust
quests.description:
Refined Obsidian will be important for many Items and Machines within Mekanism especially at Ultimate Tier. 
First, we'll need to Crush Obsidian to get Obsidian Dust. Obviously you need to use a Crusher for that. 

Then, we can use the Metallurgic Infuser to Infuse the Obsidian Dust with Chemical Diamond. I'd recommend using Enriched Diamonds to get the most bang for your buck! 

Now we get a few choices of what to do with it, either Enrich it to get more Chemical Refined Obsidian or...

quests.title: Chemical Oxidizer
quests.description:
The Rotary Condensator might make Gas from Liquids, but the Chemical Oxidizer can turn (some) Items into Gas! 

This includes Infuse Types like Coal to Carbon. 

This will also be needed for taking Wasted Combs and Lithium Combs into their Chemicals! 

Items will go in the Red Slot and their new Gas forms will appear in the Blue Bar.

quests.title: Refined Obsidian
quests.description:
Throw the Refined Obsidian Dust into an Osmium Compressor and Compress some Osmium into it! 

I think that's how the Osmium Compressor works... 

Now we'll have Refined Obsidian Ingots, these can be made into other Machines or even Tools and Armor!

quests.title: Rotary Condensentrator
quests.description:
Condensating is to make from Liquid to Gas. Decondensating is turning Gas to Liquid. 

The Rotary Condenstrator does both! 

Gas will go in the Bar on the Left. They can be added from Tubes or Chemical Tanks that you place in the Left Slots. 

Liquids will go in the Right Bar. They can also be added with Pipes or Fluid Tanks placed in the Right Slots. 

When powered, Gas will become Liquid, and Liquid turned into Gas. They will switch Bars and can then be taken out with Tubes/Pipes or Chemical/Fluid Tanks.

quests.title: Enrichment Chamber
quests.subtitle: Breaks Raw Ores into Dusts
quests.description:
The Enrichment Chamber will Enrich Items that go through it. Just place the Items in the Red Slots and the Enriched Items will come out of the Blue Slots. 

What is an Enriched Item? Or what happens when an Item gets Enriched? Either we get more of it the Items it can be made into or change the Item themselves! 

We can get 2 Dust from 1 Ore. We can get more Dyes from one Flower. We can even change Copper Stages or take Moss off Cobblestone! 

With later Tiers of Enrichment Chambers we get even more Slots to Enrich more Items at once. 

We also get the ability to Auto-Sort. With the press of this Button! We can set it so the Stacks of Items will be evenly distributed to each Slot so the Machine is more Efficient.

quests.title: Osmium Compressor
quests.subtitle: Really Only Good For 2 Things
quests.description:
The Machine creates two really strong ingots: Refined Glowstone and Refined Obsidian.

It Infuses an Item with Osmium to create a more powerful Ingot. 

We'll need to place Osmium Ingots, Osmium Blocks, or a Chemical Tank with Osmium Chemical in it to feed the Compressor Osmium!

quests.title: Chemical Injection Chamber
quests.description:
The Chemical Injection Chamber is another Machine that works with combining Items and Chemicals, but this time it is just 1 Item plus 1 Chemical to make 1 new Item! 

You can get Water Vapor from putting Water into a Rotary Condensator, then Inject that Water Vapor into Dead Coral to revive it. 

You can get Oxygen from an Electrolytic Separator and Inject that Oxygen into Copper to Oxidize it. 

And most important, using Hydrogen Chloride into Ore Blocks to get Ore Shards for Processing!

quests.title: Chemical Washer
quests.description:
The Chemical Washer is only for Ore Processing. 

Like the Electrolytic Separator, this one only works with Chemicals/Fluids! 

Water (or Water replacement) will go in the Left Bar! And the Ore Slurry will go in the Bar next to it. 

When given Energy, the Chemical Washer will make the Dirty Slurry, Clean! 

Like a Washing Machine!

quests.title: Infused Alloy
quests.subtitle: The Basic Alloy for Crafting Items
quests.description:
One of the 3 most important Infused Items is the Infused Alloy. 

To make it we'll need to Infuse a Copper Ingot with 10mB of Redstone. 

How do we get 10mB of Redstone you ask? By placing a Redstone Item into the Yellow Square of the Metallurgic Infuser! 

We'll lose the Redstone Item and different Items give different amounts. Redstone Dust gives 10mB, Enriched Redstone gives 80mB, and a Block of Redstone gives 90mB.

quests.title: Energized Smelter
quests.subtitle: Mekanism's Powered Furnace
quests.description:
No, no, no, no, no more using Coal to power our Furnaces, we need Coal for Steel! 

Here use the Energized Smelter instead! It uses Energy to Smelt Items! 

It can also be Upgraded to contain more Slots for more Smelting, kinda like a Jumbo Furnace. 

Upgraded Tiers will also have an Auto-Sort button. This allows the Machine to automatically distribute the Items evenly among the Slots to be more efficient!

quests.title: Mekanism
quests.subtitle: The Start of Your Own Factory
quests.description:
Mekanism is a tech mod that will change the way you play Minecraft. 

The mod focuses on breaking down materials to their chemical makeup, and getting the best out of every material you come across.

This mod features Hydrogen-Powered Jetpacks, a mini-robotic friend, Reactors, a Digital Miner to automate mining, and much, much more. 

Trust me, you'll see why it is used in almost every ATM Modpack!

quests.title: Osmium
quests.subtitle: The Base Crafting Ingot
quests.description:
Osmium is an Ore that spawns below Y Level 56. It's Ore is in similar shape to Emerald with the Color being a Blue-ish Grey! 

It will be useful for many of the Machines used in Mekanism! So you'll need a lot of it! 

You can also Craft Armor and Tools from it! The Armor and Sword are same Points as Netherite! While the Pickaxe is the same as an Iron Pickaxe.

quests.title: Metallurgic Infuser
quests.subtitle: The Starting Machine
quests.description:
The first and most important Machine is the Metallurgic Infuser! 

The Metallurgic Infuser will combine an Item and a Chemicals to Craft new Items and Alloys. 

Chemicals or Infuse Types will go into the Yellow Square and will show up in the Bar to the Left of it. 

The Red Square will hold the Item that gets Infused. 

The Dark Blue Square will be where the product goes to! 

To the Right, the Light Green Slot and Bar are for Energy! 

If you need to make room in the Chemical Bar, use the DUMP Button. This will eject all Chemicals in it!

quests.title: Steel
quests.description:
Now that we have our Metallurgic Infusion and hopefully some Energy, we can start making Steel! 

We'll need Carbon in our Chemical Bar. We can use Coal, Charcoal, or any varients of those in the Chemical Slot to add Carbon. 

Then, if we add an Iron Ingot/Dust into the Item Slot, it will Infuse it with 10mB of Carbon to make Enriched Iron. 

We'll need to repeat that step just now with adding 10mB of Carbon to turn our Enriched Iron into Steel Dust! Smelt the Dust to get a Steel Ingot. 

Steel is used for pretty much everything! Machines, Tools, Upgrades, Reactors, Energy Cells! You'll need a lot of it.

quests.title: Machines
quests.description:
Come on we all know what you are here for... MACHINES! 

Machines are our little Factories, each will do something unique in gaining us more Items. Follow the individual Quests to find out what each does. 

Here I will talk more on the Configs and Upgrades!
{@pagebreak}
All Machines are different but the Colors of Slots and Bars will tell what they are for! Light Green: Energy. Red: Initial Item/Fluid/Chemical. Blue: Product. Cyan: Second Product. Yellow: Infuse Types. 

Each Machine has default Config Sides. These are where Items will be Input and Output. You can change these in the GUI of the Machine in Side Configs. 

It will change for Items, Fluids, Chemicals, and Energy but each has similar Sides that can be changed. Red: Input. Orange: Second Input. Blue: Output. Cyan: Second Output. Purple: Both Input and Output. Light Green: Energy. Yellow: Extra like Infuse Types. 
You'll need to set the GUI to Auto-Eject if you want Items to be Input and Output!
{@pagebreak}
Some Machines can also use Upgrades! These are in the Top Right of the GUI. 

Here you can see which Upgrades the Machine can use. When you put them in it'll tell you how many it can hold. Speed Upgrades can hold more while Muffling doesn't need more!

quests.title: Chemical Infuser
quests.description:
Chemical Infuser will take 2 different Chemicals and... combine them. 

This isn't helpful early game, but later on it'll be very important! 

First Chemical goes in the Red Bar on the Left and the Second Chemical goes in the Orange Bar on the Right. 

Yes the pattern they are in matters. That I learned the hard way in 9TTS!

quests.title: Better Machines
quests.description: Some Machines are a little more advanced, so that means we'll need more Advanced Items to Craft them! \n\nTalking about Advanced, they take the same Materials as Advanced Tier Machines.

quests.title: Even better Machines!
quests.description: These Machines are even better than Advanced! \n\nUse Items from the Elite Tier to make these Machines!

quests.title: Some of the best Machines!
quests.description:
Only the best of the best Machines, will need the best Materials. 

Use Ultimate Items to make these Machines and more! 

Yes, you'll want these Machines, they are worth the time and Materials!

quests.title: Chemical Crystallizer
quests.description:
The Chemical Crystallizer is actually a pretty simple Machine! We just need a Chemical and Energy! 

And yes this one isn't only used for Ore Processing! Well some of it is... but not all. 

Just throw some Clean Ore Slurry into the Crystallizer and it will turn it into Ore Crystals. 

You can also feed it Antimatter to make Antimatter Pellets, or Lithium to make Lithium Dust!

quests.title: Mekanism: Reactors
quests.description:
You think this is all Mekanism has? You don't even have a clue! 

Before we get there though, let's get some Machines and Sulfur ready! 

We're going to have a long road ahead of us.

quests.title: 4A1C8125896F7F1A
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: 0498A578D0EC3254
quests.subtitle: The Basic Control Circuit
quests.description:
The last of the important Infused Items is the Basic Control Circuit. 

These ones are made by combining 20mB of Redstone with an Osmium Ingot. 

Check out the Infused Alloy Quest to learn how to add Redstone to the Metallurgic Infuser!

quests.title: Precision Sawmill
quests.description:
The Precision Sawmill will work to "recycle" Wood Items. 

Just give it some Energy and throw a Wood Item in and wait! 

It will turn Beds into 3 Wood Planks and 3 Wool. Doors into Wood Planks. And Logs into 6 Planks instead of 4! 

It will also turn Sticks into Sawdust which is needed for the Cardboard Box!

quests.title: Purification Chamber
quests.description:
The Purification Chamber is technically an Upgrade to the Enrichment Chamber. Well... it loses a lot of functions but it does Upgrade the Ore Processing! 

That is pretty much all it does, it combines Ores with Oxygen to get more Ingots out of them! 

Well... it doesn't make Ingots it makes Clumps... whatever just read the Ore Processing Quest to find out more about that then!

quests.title: Combiner
quests.description:
The Combiner can automate simple 2 Item Recipes! 

Like 2 different Dyes, or Mud and Wheat to get Packed Mud. 

It can even do some new unique Recipes like Cobble and Flint to make Gravel, or 4 Obsidian Dust and Deepslate to make Obsidian!

quests.title: Chemical Dissolution Chamber
quests.description:
The C.D.C. (Chemical Dissolution Chamber not Center for Disease Control and Prevention) is another Machine only used for Ore Processing. 

The C.D.C. will need Sulfuric Acid and Ore. 

The Ore will go in the Red Slot while the Sulfuric Acid will go in the Red Bar. 

The finished Dirty Slurry will spawn in the Blue Bar!

quests.title: Pressurized Reaction Chamber
quests.description:
The P.R.C. (Pressurized Reaction Chamber) combines multiple Fluids and Chemicals with an Item to make new Items and Chemicals! 

Fluids, most likely Water, go in the farthest Left Bar. Chemicals go in the Bar next to it, and initial Items in the Red Slot. 

The finished Item will spawn in the Blue Slot and the finished Chemical will be in the Blue Bar. 

The P.R.C. can make a few Items like HDPE Items, Gunpowder and Sulfur, and even Nuclear Items!

quests.title: Crusher
quests.subtitle: It Crushes Things.
quests.description:
The Crusher does as the name suggests! Just like every other Mod's Crushers... 

We can get Dust from Ingots, Cobble from Stone, and Bio Fuel from Plants! 

Dust will be needed for lots of Recipes so you'll definitely need this. Especially for making Upgrades!

quests.title: Electrolytic Separator
quests.description:
Electrolytic Separator will take 1 Fluid and split it into 2 Chemicals! 

The Fluid will go in the Red Bar and the Chemicals will appear in the Blue and Cyan Bars. 

We also get two Buttons on each of the bottom sides of the GUI. These will switch between functions of the two Output Bars. 

Idle will just reach the limit it can and won't take anymore. So if it is full on Hydrogen it will no longer use Water. 

Dumping Excess will reach the top but will dump enough to keep producing each Chemical. This is helpful for those who need lots of Oxygen but not Hydrogen. 

Dumping will delete all of that Chemical that is made.

quests.title: Using everything to turn Bio Fuel into HDPE
quests.description:
With 2 Bio Fuel we can make 1 Substrate through the P.R.C.. 

Well... we'll also need Water and Hydrogen in the P.R.C. but then we'll get our Substrate and also Chemical Ethene. 

In order to make HDPE Pellets we'll need our Substrate as well as turning our Chemical Ethene into Liquid Ethene. We can use a Rotary Condensator to turn it Liquid! 

Now throw both of our Liquid Ethene and Substrates into the P.R.C. to make HDPE Pellets! 

We can then Craft 4 Pellets together to make a HDPE Rod or Enrich 3 of them to make a HDPE Sheet.

quests.title: Crushing Plants to get Bio Fuel
quests.description:
Bio Fuel is made by Crushing up some Plants! All types of different Plants each giving a different amount! 

Pumpkin Pie gives the most Bio Fuel but Melon Slices are most efficient. 

Bio Fuel can be used in a ton of different ways! We can Power a Bio-Generator, Infuse Items with Chemical Bio Fuel, or...

quests.title: Crushed to Dust!
quests.description:
Some Recipes will require Ore Dusts! 

Thanks to AllTheOres, we can make Ore Dusts in a million different ways! 

The Mekanism ways are with the Crusher and Enrichment Chamber. 

We can Crush Ingots into Dust. Or Enrich Ore Blocks to get 2 Dusts.

quests.title: Power!
quests.description:
90% of Mekanism Machines will need Energy to run. Mekanism uses FE to run Machines! 

1kFE is 1000 FE, and 1mFE is 1,000,000 FE! 

The Energy Tablet is Mekanism's version of the Battery. It will also be needed to Craft most Generators. 

Yes, Mekanism has Generators and yes, they are awesome!

quests.title: Advanced Solar Generator
quests.subtitle: Generates about 480FE/t
quests.description:
If you're wondering if it is worth making this upgrade, the answer is yes.

Advanced Solar Generators will take up more Space and are expensive to Craft but will Generate so much more Energy. 

They work the same as normal Solar Generators, Daytime and need Sky Exposure. 

These can hold 100kFE! 

You can also add them on top of Thermal Evaporation Plants to produce more Heat.

quests.title: Solar Generator
quests.subtitle: Generates about 60FE/t
quests.description:
The Solar Generator will Generate Energy based on being exposed to the Sky during Daytime. 

It is a very simple to use automatic Generator, just Crafting them is annoying! 

They won't generate Energy as much as Wind Generators do (only Daytime) but produce more in Bursts and take up less Space! 

They have been buffed and can now hold around 40kFE!

quests.title: Bio-Generator
quests.description:
The Bio-Generator works by taking Bio Fuel, making Bioethanol, and using that for Energy! 

This Generator has been heavily nerfed though, so it is recommened to not use it! 

That is because you buttheads keep making massive Melon Farms that eat Servers TPS!

quests.title: Portable Teleporter
quests.description:
The Portable Teleporter will allow you to Teleport to any (Powered) Teleporter. 

Of course it does need Energy as well, so you'll need to Charge it. And Right Click it to set it to you for Security reasons. 

After it is Charged and yours, you can Right Click to open its GUI. Here you can Click any Network and hit the Teleport Button to Teleport to that Teleporter. 

No, you can't Teleport to the Portable Teleporter, it's an Item...

quests.title: Dictionary
quests.description:
The Dictionary isn't helpful to the average Player: it doesn't Mine, Place Blocks, Craft, Smelt, really interact with anything. 

Instead it is used for finding Tags! 

We can Right Click a Block with the Dictionary in Hand and the Blocks Tags will show up in Chat. We can do the same with Entities. 

Is that not enough? Well we can also Shift Right Click to open up our Dictionary! 

Here we can see the Items in our Inventory and check all the different Tags for them. From Item, to Potion, to Enchantment Tags, nothing can hide from the Dictionary!

quests.title: Enrich then Smelt
quests.subtitle: Tier 1 Ore Processing
quests.description:
The very first and simplest Ore Processing is just 2 Machines! Enrichers and Smelters! 

We can use Ore Blocks to get twice the Dust or Raw Ore to get 1/3 more. So 3 Raw Ore to get 4 Dust. 

Throw the Ore into the Enricher and you'll get Dust! Then, Smelt that Dust to get Ingots! 

Congrats, you just Ore Processed!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier1_1.png width:150 height:50 align:center}

quests.title: Universal Cables
quests.description:
Universal Cables are used to move Energy from Machine to Machine! 

Most Machines will have a default Energy taking Side notified by the Green Square on them. These can be changed within the GUI of the Machine in Side Configs. 

Machines will also share the Energy they have in them with other Machines next to them, if their Configs are set to it!

Universal Cables are made with 2 Steel Ingots and a Redstone Dust. They can be upgraded by combining 8 of the same Tier with a Control Circuit! 

Basic: will hold and move 3.2kFE per Tick. 

Advanced: will hold and move 51.2kFE per Tick. 

Elite: will hold and move 409.6kFE per Tick. 

Ultimate: will hold and move 3.27mFE per Tick.

quests.title: Energy Cubes
quests.description:
Energy Tablets not holding enough Energy? Then, you'll need some Energy Cubes! 

Energy Cubes can have Energy Cabled in and out of it. Each has a set amount of storage for Energy that is determined by their Tier. 

All sides of an Energy Cube can take or place Energy, that is determined by whether Cables are Pushing or Pulling. 

Basic: will hold 1.6mFE. 

Advanced: will hold 6.4mFE. 

Elite: will hold 25.6mFE. 

Ultimate: will hold 102.4mFE.

quests.title: Scuba Set
quests.description:
The Scube Set is both a Helmet and Chestplate that will give you Water Breathing when worn! 

In order to get Breathing though, we'll need to give our Scube Tank some Oxygen. Just place it within a Machine that has some, like an Electrolytic Separator and it will slowly fill up! 

Then, put on both the Scube Mask and Scube Tank and press (G) to turn it on. Once the Scube Gear is on, it will use up the Oxygen allowing you to Breath Underwater!

quests.title: Jetpack
quests.subtitle: Requires Hydrogen to Work!
quests.description:
The Mekanism Jetpack works similar to Iron Jetpacks just with different Modes and it requires Hydrogen as Fuel instead of Energy! 

Just place some Hydrogen in the Jetpack by putting it in a Machine that has Hydrogen. Funny enough the Electrolytic Separator also has Hydrogen when it has Oxygen! 

Once you strap it on your Back you can press (G) to switch between the Modes. 

Regular: hold Jump to go up, you will move in any direction you hit with WASD and if you don't you will only go up. When you release Jump Button you will Fall. 

Hover: same controls as Default but with slower movement and you won't Fall when you release Jump. You can lower by hitting (Shift). 

Vector: won't respond to WASD and instead will move to where the Player is looking when holding Jump to go up. 

Disabled: doesn't work! 

By the way, you can upgrade the Jetpack with a few Blocks and Items to make it have Armor Protection!

quests.title: Free Runners
quests.description:
Free Runners are different from the other Armors, these will use Energy instead of a Chemical Fuel. 

When Powered and tied onto your Feet, you can press (B) they will start working and you can press it again to switch it's modes. 

Regular: the Free Runners will protect you from Fall Damage and Auto-Jump over Blocks for you. 

Safety: will prevent Fall Damage but won't Auto-Jump. (The preferred Method). 

Disabled: Free Runners won't protect or Auto-Jump, just look stylish! 

You can also Upgrade Free Runners to give them Armor Protection, just like the Jetpack.

quests.title: Wind Generator
quests.subtitle: Generates Power from the Wind
quests.description:
This is a great option for automatically generating Energy.
The amount of Energy the Wind Generator creates is based on its Y Level.
This generates around 90FE/t at sea level and the most it can produce is 360FE/t!
The Wind Generator will also need Sky above it to work, like a Beacon!

quests.title: Heat Generator
quests.subtitle: Basic Power Gen
quests.description:
The Heat Generator has 2 modes to generate Energy. 

Passive: Surrounding the Generator with Lava Source or flowing blocks creates passive Energy by creating Heat. 

Place one Lava Source Block on top, and let it flow over the sides. 

Make sure to connect Pipes first!

Active: Placing combustible materials such as Coal or Wood into the Generator will burn the fuel to create Energy. 

It now creates 320FE/t.

quests.title: Cardboard Box
quests.description:
Only one of the most powerful Tools in all of Modded Minecraft! The Cardboard Box! 

These are made with very simple ingrediants, just 4 Sawdust. Sawdust is made from putting Sticks into a Precision Sawmill. 

Now that we hopefully have one, just Right Click a Block with it and the Block will be placed into the Cardboard Box. Now we can break the Cardboard Box and move the Block by placing it again and Shift Right Clicking it to remove the Box. 

Some Blocks won't work like Bedrock or End Portal Frames... but there's so many more that will! Like Obsidian, Reinforced Deepslate, and Spawners!

quests.title: Gauge Dropper
quests.description:
The Gauge Dropper is a useful Tool for clearing out Chemical Inventories. 

In a Machine's GUI, pick up the Gauge Dropper and drag it over the Chemicals in the Machine. Then, just Right Click and it'll remove the Chemicals and add them to the Dropper. 
I should have specified, we can get those Chemicals back from the Gauge Dropper by clicking any Chemical Storage like a tank or clear the Dropper by shift-clicking it in the air.

quests.title: Flamethrower
quests.description:
The Flamethrower is one of the Ranged Weapons Mekanism offers. 

Like the Jetpack it uses Hydrogen as Fuel and is loaded just the same way as the Jetpack. 

We can press (N) to change its modes. 

Combat: will set Mobs on Fire and do Damage, but won't Burn Blocks or Items. 
Heat: from what I can tell can only do the same. 

Inferno: Burns everything!

quests.title: Electric Bow
quests.description: Just a normal Bow that takes Energy instead of Durability.

quests.title: Chargepad
quests.description:
Chargepads will Charge any Items on the Player when the Player steps onto the Pad! 

Obviously it will need Energy within it to work. We can add that in on the Back or Bottom of the Chargepad. 

Once it has Energy within it, it will Charge each Item in your Inventory that can hold a Charge! 

Doesn't matter the Mod it is from either! 
It will prioritize the first Items in your Inventory and once it is full it will Charge the next. 

How quickly it fills the Items seems to be the same for every Item.

quests.title: Making Oxygen for Purifier
quests.subtitle: Tier 2 Ore Processing
quests.description:
For the next Tier of Ore Processing we'll need Purifiers and they'll need Oxygen. So, let's make some Oxygen! 

Use an Electric Pump or any Automated Water to feed Water into an Electrolytic Separator. 

Once fed Energy and Water, the Electrolytic Separator will turn that H2O into H (Hydrogen) and O (Oxygen)! 

We can dump the Hydrogen, and Pipe the Oxygen into the Purifier. 

Now that the Purifier has Oxygen, we can place our Ores into it to get 3 Ore Clumps from Ore Blocks or 2 Ore Clumps from Raw Ore.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier2_1.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Crush and Enrich our Clumps
quests.subtitle: Tier 2 Ore Processing
quests.description:
We got Ore Clumps? What do we do with a Clump, we wanted Ingots! 

To start, Crush each Clump to get 2 Dirty Ore Dust. 

We can't Smelt Dirty Dust, it'll ruin the Furnace! So we'll need to Enrich them to get our regular Dust. 

And like usual, Smelt the Dust to get Ingots.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier2_2.png width:250 height:50 align:center}

quests.title: Making Chlorine
quests.subtitle: Tier 3 Ore Processing
quests.description:
If we want even more Ores! We'll need a better way of Processing our Ores. Hydrogen won't work, let's try Hydrogen Chloride. 

Obviously for that we'll need Chlorine! 

Look at the Thermal Evaporation Plant Quest to learn in better detail how to Craft the Mutliblock, but basically we'll need one. 

Feed Water into a Thermal Evaporation Plant to (slowly) make Brine. 

Throw that Brine into an Electrolytic Separator to get Sodium and Chlorine! Sodium is helpful for Fission Reactor... but not Ore Processing!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier3_1.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Injecting Hydrogen Chloride
quests.subtitle: Tier 3 Ore Processing
quests.description:
Good good, now we got Chlorine. What else do we need for Hydrogen Chloride? Oh yeah, Hydrogen! 

Feed some Water to an Electrolytic Separator, like in Tier 1, to get Hydrogen and Oxygen. Just this time we need to keep the Hydrogen. 

With our Chemical Infuser we can combine Hydrogen and Chlorine to make Hydrogen Chloride. 

Pipe that Hydrogen Chloride into a Chemical Injection Chamber to Inject Ores to get Shards. 

Ore Blocks will get 4 Ore Shards while 3 Raw Ores will get 8 Ore Shards.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier3_2.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Shard, to Clump, to Dust, to Ingot
quests.subtitle: Tier 3 Ore Processing
quests.description:
Again? Dude, we want Ingots not Clumps and not Shards! INGOTS! 

Throw those Ore Shards into a Purifier with Oxygen (most likely from our previous Electrolytic Separator) to make Ore Clumps. 

Now we just repeat steps from previous Tier. Crush the Clumps to get Dirty Dust. 

Enrich the Dirty Dust to clean it. 

Then, Smelt the Dust to get our Ingots!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier3_3.png width:250 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Creating Sulfuric Acid
quests.subtitle: Tier 4 Ore Processing
quests.description:
How fun! A shopping List of Chemicals! What are we Walter White? 

First, and most important, for Sulfuric Acid, is Sulfur! Mine some then Oxidize it to get Sulfur Dioxide. 

We'll need a little more Oxygen though, so let's get some more with an Electrolytic Separator being fed Water. 
Then, combine that new-found Oxygen with the Sulfur Dioxide in a Chemical Infuser to get Sulfur Trioxide. 

Leave that Sulfur whatever for a moment until we get Water Vapor! To get Water Vapor, put Water through a Rotary Condensator.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier4_1.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Melting Ores with Acid and Crystallizing them
quests.subtitle: Tier 4 Ore Processing
quests.description:
Now use another Chemical Infuser to Infuse our Water Vapor and Sulfur Trioxide. Now we have our Sulfuric Acid! 

Pipe the Sulfuric Acid into a C.D.C. to Melt down our Ores with Acid. This will give us Dirty Ore Slurry, a Chemical form of Ores. 

3 Raw Ore will give 2 Buckets of Ore Slurry and 1 Ore Block will give 1 Bucket of Ore Slurry. 

We can't go around with Dirty Ore Slurry, it's embarrassing! We'll need to clean it! Start up a Chemical Washer and put some Water (and laundry detergent) into it. 

Every 5mb of Dirty Slurry will be turned into 3mb of Ore Slurry. 

Now that our Slurry is all clean, we can put it into a Chemical Crystallizer. This will give us Ore Crystals! Yes, different from Shards and Clumps. Each 200mb of Ore Slurry is equal to 1 Crystal.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier4_2.png width:300 height:50 align:center}

quests.title: Making more Hydrogen Chloride
quests.subtitle: Tier 4 Ore Processing
quests.description:
Our Crystals will need even more Processing! 

Repeat the previous steps of making a Thermal Evaporation Plant to create Brine. 

Use an Electrolytic Separator to Separate the Chlorine from the Brine. 

Then get Oxygen from putting Water into an Electrolytic Separator. 

Combine the Chlorine and Oxygen in a Chemical Infuser to get Hydrogen Chloride! 

With our Chemical Injector, we can Inject the Crystals with Hydrogen Chloride to get 2 Ore Shards from each Ore Crystal.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier4_3.png width:250 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Crystal, Shard, Clump, ETC
quests.subtitle: Tier 4 Ore Processing
quests.description:
This seems familiar? 

Now we have Shards again. Before we do anything with them though, we'll need Oxygen. 

Throw Water into an Electrolytic Separator to get Oxygen. Then, Tube that Oxygen from the Separator to the Purifier. 

With that Oxygen, the Purifier can turn your Shards into Ore Clumps. 

Now, Crush those Clumps to get Dirty Dust. Then, Enrich those Dirty Dust to get Ore Dust. 

And finally Smelt that Dust, to get our beautifully Processed Ore!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_tier3_3.png width:250 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Energy Unit
quests.subtitle: Everything
quests.description:
Energy Units can be used in all the MekaSuit Parts and even the Meka-Tool. 

We can add 8 of them to each Item. Each adds more Energy Storage to the Item. 

No, it doesn't increase the Energy that is already in it. There's no such thing as Free Energy!

quests.title: Antiprotonic Nucleosynethesizer
quests.description:
Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer is a Machine made from Antimatter Pellets. 

Of course it also uses Antimatter as Fuel as well, because it wasn't expensive enough! 

So what does it do? 

With our Antimatter, Energy, and a certain Item to create a brand new (and usually rare) Item. Some we can't even Craft! 

Like Amethyst to Echo Shards, Golden Apple to Enchanted Golden Apple, and even Eggs to the Dragon Egg!

quests.title: Upgraded, Un-Upgradable Machines
Radiation Shielding Unit
quests.subtitle: All Armor
quests.description:
You know that Radiation stuff can get pretty deadly! And everyone makes mistakes. 

But the question remains, would you rather wear the stylish but very weak Hazmat Suit or... the all powerful MekaSuit with Radiation Shielding Unit! 

If all MekaSuit Parts have the Radiation Shielding Unit installed, you'll be able to safely walk around in Radiation!

quests.title: Laser Dissipation Unit
quests.subtitle: All Armor
quests.description:
The Laser Dissipation Units will upgrade the MekaSuit. Well each piece of it. 

Instead of quickly killing you when you walk into Lasers, they won't cause any Damage at all! 

A little bit of the Laser will actually pass right through you! Not all of it.

quests.title: Color Modulation Unit
quests.subtitle: All Armor
quests.description:
The Color Modulation Unit will allow you to change the Color of the MekaSuit Part it is in. 

Just hold the Item and press (\) in order to access its Configs. 

How many Colors do we have available? I don't know, how many Colors do we have with the Hex Codes! 

This will only effect that MekaSuit Part though, each MekaSuit Part will need their own Units.

quests.title: MekaSuit Helmet
quests.description:
The MekaSuit Helmet, is obviously the part that goes on your head! You'll need an Antimatter Pellet, Polonium Pellets, an Ultimate Induction Cell, and more! 

It serves as an Upgrade to Unobtainium Helmets. While it has a lot less Armor Points, it works different from Unobtainium Helmets. 

If the MekaSuit Helmet isn't Charged, it will work with similar stats to a Netherite Helmet, but here's the fun part! MekaSuits Helmets will block all Damage (but Magic Damage) and use up Energy. 

Also when worn, it will display on our HUD: our Cordinates, Energy within our MekaSuit, and will replace the Armor Points with an Energy Bar. 

We can use the Modification Station to give Upgrades to the MekaSuit Helmet, like more Energy to take even less Damage! Water Breathing, safety from Radiation, and even Solar Charging!

quests.title: Solar Recharging Unit
quests.subtitle: Helmet
quests.description:
Solar Recharging Units go into MekaSuit Helmets and will charge the MekaSuit! 

The more you have added, the more FE will be generated. 

Yes, it works just like a normal Solar Generator... Daytime and exposed to the Sky!

quests.title: Nutritional Injection Unit
quests.subtitle: Helmet
quests.description:
Nutritional Paste is made from processing any Item that gives Food Bars when eaten through a Nutritional Liquifier. 

Think of it like a giant Blender! I can't promise the Nutritional Paste will taste good though... 

The MekaSuit Helmet can hold Nutrional Paste and with this Unit it will automatically feed you when you lose Hunger Points.

quests.title: Vision Enhancement Unit
quests.subtitle: Helmet
quests.description:
To all Players who don't cheat by using Night Vision Resource Packs, this might be helpful! 

This Module Unit will give you some Night Vision when you wear the MekaSuit Helmet. 

While yes, lots of Items make this useless, I'm still going to tell you about it!

quests.title: Inhalation Purification Unit
quests.subtitle: Helmet
quests.description:
The Inhalation Purification Unit actually does a few things. 

1. It will use Energy to block out Magic Damage. Like Potions of Instant Harming! 

2. It can be Configured to block Potion Effects based on their level of help or harm. Beneficial, Neutral, and Harmful. 

Beneficial will help the Player in any way. Like Regeneration, Healing, Speed, and Strength. Neutral doesn't do much, like Glowing. Harmful will make the Game harder for the Player. Like Wither, Weakness, or Blindness.

quests.title: Electrolytic Breathing Unit
quests.subtitle: Helmet
quests.description:
Talking about replacing things (Hazmat Suit with Radiation Shielding Unit) lets replace the Scube Gear! 

With this Module Unit added to our MekaSuit Helmet, we will be able to swim Underwater and breathe! 

If we have a Jetpack Unit in our MekaSuit Bodyarmor it will feed it Hydrogen when in Water.

quests.title: 50F23B2688D7E699
quests.description:
With 1,000mB of Antimatter processed through a Chemical Crystallizer we can make 1 Antimatter Pellet. 

That means it takes 1,000,000mB Polonium or 1MmB Polonium. 

For all that Polonium you'll need 5,000,000mB Nuclear Waste and Fissile Fuel to make the Nuclear Waste. Only 5MmB Fissile Fuel... only! 

But finally, we have it! The most valued Item in all of Mekanism! The Antimatter Pellet. 

We can now make our MekaSuit, more storage for the QIO, and even the ATM Star!

quests.title: MekaSuit Bodyarmor
quests.description:
The MekaSuit Chestplate Bodyarmor, will be an upgrade to Unobtainium Bodyarmor Chestplate. 

It will need a few other Items in order to upgrade it though, like an Antimatter Pellet, Polonium Pellets, and even an Ultimate Induction Cell! 

The MekaSuit Bodyarmor without Energy will act just like a Netherite Chestplate. What about with Energy? It might just block all Damage besides Magic Damage and will use Energy instead of Health! 

We can toss it into a Modification Station in order to add Module Units which can upgrade it! The MekaSuit Bodyarmor has the most Module Units of all the Armor, so definitely check them out!

quests.title: Gravitational Modulating Additional Unit
quests.subtitle: Bodyarmor
quests.description:
Gravitational Modulating Additional Unit, as you can tell by the name is an upgrade to the Gravitational Modulating Unit. 

Both will need to be Installed to use them! 

So what are these Upgrades? Well you will instantly stop when you stop holding your Movement Keys in Flight. You can ascend faster! And even Fly always!

quests.title: Gravitational Modulating Unit
quests.subtitle: Bodyarmor
quests.description:
Literally just Creative Flight. 

You can't use this with the Jetpack Unit and yes it will use Energy to Fly! 

Within its Configs you can increase how fast you Fly as well.

quests.title: Jetpack Unit
quests.subtitle: Bodyarmor
quests.description:
The Jetpack Unit will act as if you are wearing the Mekanism Jetpack and your MekaSuit Bodyarmor. 

The Jetpack uses the same Controls, and will need Hydrogen as fuel. 

You can fuel it with Hydrogen in 2 ways. You can place it in a Machine that has Hydrogen in it. Or be under Water while your MekaSuit Helmet has Electrolytic Breathing. 

You won't be able to use this Unit while you have the Gravitational Modulating Unit on.

quests.title: Elytra Unit
quests.subtitle: Bodyarmor
quests.description:
Elytra or MekaSuit Bodyarmor... 

Elytra or MekaSuit Bodyarmor... 

Why not both?

quests.title: Charge Distribution Units
quests.subtitle: Bodyarmor
quests.description:
Instead of each MekaSuit Part having their own individual Charge, they will now share one Charge. 

This is important in keeping every Part Charged. 

And that is important to keeping you alive!

quests.title: Geiger Unit
quests.subtitle: Bodyarmor
quests.description:
The Geiger Unit will work like the Dosimeter Unit but instead of Radiation in you, it's Radiation around you! 

Just so you can find where it might be hiding. 

You can also enable and disable it!

quests.title: Dosimeter Unit
quests.subtitle: Bodyarmor
quests.description:
The Dosimeter will show how many SVP Units of Radiation are currently in you. 
Yes, in you. 

Remember you can enable and disable it to clear up room in your HUD!

quests.title: Modification Station
quests.description:
The Modification Station is how we will throw our Module Units into our Tools and Armor. 

It will need Energy to operate, because of course it does. 

When you Right Click a (powered) Modification Station it will open up its GUI. Here we can see our entire Inventory including Armor and Offhand. We also have a Screen and 2 extra Slots. 

The 2 extra Slots are where our Module Units (Left Slot) and our Armor or Tools we want to add the Module Units go (Right Slot). 

Once both are added into their Slots, they will automatically place the Module Units into the Item. If they stay in the Slot, we can view the Module Units installed in the Item in the Screen. 

If you want to take our a Module Unit, click it on the Screen, and then hit the Remove Button. 

When we have Module Units installed we can hit (\) to pull up their Configs. Here we can Enable or Disable them, and more!

quests.title: MekaSuit Pants
quests.description:
You need even fancier Pants? How about we upgrade our Unobtainium leggings into MekaSuit Pants! 

This will also cost an Antimatter Pellet, an Ultimate Induction Cells, and a few Polonium Pellets. 

Is the upgrade worth it? It only has the same Armor stats as Netherite Leggings?!? And these should be 4 upgrades after Netherite! 

Yes... it... is! We can Charge the MekaSuit Pants and instead of you taking Damage, the MekaSuit Pants will use up Energy! Well all Damage except Magic Damage... 

Then, use it in a Modification Station to add Module Units which mostly upgrade your Movement. Yeah, that can be pretty darn important!

quests.title: Geothermal Generator Unit
quests.subtitle: Pants
quests.description:
Wait, so we take less Damage Energy from Heat Sources and make Energy from them? Sign me up! 

When you walk on Magma, through Fire, or in Lava you'll gain Energy in your MekaSuit Pants. 

If you have Charge Distribution Unit in your MekaSuit Bodyarmor, it will also Charge the other MekaSuit Parts.

quests.title: Motorized Servo Unit
quests.subtitle: Pants
quests.description: This one is just Swift Sneaking Enchantment... just a Unit now!

quests.title: Hydrostatic Repulsor Unit
quests.subtitle: Pants
quests.description:
Thank you Minecraft for the Update Aquatic, but Swimming can still be very slow. 

So why not speed it up! Just like Depth Strider! 

With the Hydrostatic Repulsor Unit you can Walk and Swim faster in Water.

quests.title: Gyroscopic Stabilization Unit
quests.subtitle: Pants
quests.description:
Lots of these MekaSuit Pants Units work just like Enchantments. 

This one is a 2 for 1! Both Air Affinity and Aqua Affinity. 

You will no longer have a Mining penalty when Swimming or Flying or Falling.

quests.title: Locomotive Boosting Unit
quests.subtitle: Pants
quests.description:
Potions are nice but don't you hate that they have time limits? 

No, shut up about the Infusion Pylon! 

With this Unit you will run faster and jump higher! (But you're still no good at Basketball). 

The more you have, the faster and higher you'll go!

quests.title: Super-Critical Phase Shifter
quests.subtitle: SPS

quests.title: Deuterium
quests.subtitle: D
quests.description:
Deuterium is actually relatively simple to get! 

First, we need Heavy Water. Heavy Water is just like good ol' H2O, just the H is a little different! 

We can use the Filter Upgrade in an Electric Pump (obviously above Water) to extract Heavy Water instead of Water. 

Processing the Heavy Water through an Electrolytic Separator will give us Oxygen and Deuterium instead of Hydrogen. 

Told ya it's simple!

quests.title: Lasers
quests.description:
You ever see those Tutorials that use Beacons as a Laser Security Gate. Then, when you try it you get disappointed it doesn't kill people? 

Well Lasers do just that! 

Trust me, they look like Beacons and they definitely kill! 

Unlike Beacons though, you can't change its Color with Glass. Most likely because they break almost every Block that gets in their way and Voids the drops... 

They also use Energy instead of Materials to get powered. 

I don't know the exact amount of Damage they do but they do enough to Fry a Chicken the instant it touches the Laser!

quests.title: MekaSuit Boots
quests.description:
Hey, nice Kicks! The MekaSuit Boots are an upgrade to Unobtainium Boots. 

No, not just Unobtainium Boots, you'll also need an Antimatter Pellet, Polonium Pellets, and an Ultimate Induction Cell! 

Do you really care about the stats of Boots? Who's hitting your Feet! Oh yeah Fall Damage forgot. 

Well if it isn't charged it will protect the same amount as Netherite Boots... but if it is Charged it will use Energy to protect you.
