Modification Station is a Machine we can use to add Module Units to upgrade our MekaSuit Parts, including Boots. These upgrades are similar to lots of Enchants!

quests.title: D-T Fuel
quests.description:
We can combine Deuterium and Tritium in a Chemical Infuser to make our D-T Fuel. We can also just Port both the Chemicals into the Fusion Reactor and combine them within the Reactor. 

If we just Port D-T Fuel it will Inject at the rate it is Ported into. But if we Port both Deuterium and Tritium and combine it within the Reactor we can pick any Inject Rate we want! 

We'll also need a little dab of D-T Fuel within a Hohlraum and put that within the Fusion Reactor for the inital start up. 

How do we make a Hohlraum you ask? Just Infuse 4 Gold Dust with 10mb of Carbon within a Metallurgic Infuser to Craft the Hohlraum. 

Oh wait it comes out empty, throw it into a Machine that has D-T Fuel to fill it up. Then, put it within the Slot in the Fusion Reactor's GUI, and it is ready!

quests.title: Fusion Reactor
quests.subtitle: Combining 2 Elements into 1

quests.title: Laser Focus Matrix
quests.description:
Another part we'll need to actually start the Fusion Reactor is Heat! We can use either Lasers or Porting Heat into it. 

We're just going to use Lasers here. More specifically Laser Amplifier shooting a certain amount into the Laser Focus Matrix. 

We'll need a Laser Amplifier with 1GFE worth of Energy to be shot into the Laser Focus Matrix. It sounds like a lot of Energy but don't worry we'll get it back! 

Following the Laser Amplifier Quest, we'll need to shoot Lasers into the Laser Amplifier. But each only gives about 1MFE every few seconds... 

Instead of waiting a year, we can use multiple Lasers shooting into multiple Laser Amplifiers that shoot into the one targeting the Laser Focus Matrix. 

Place the Laser Amplifiers so that they have another behind each other, while all of them have 4 Lasers shooting from the other directions!

quests.title: Soul Surfer Unit
quests.subtitle: Boots
quests.description:
Usually Soul Sand will slow you down. Usually... 

With Soul Surfer Unit you will walk normally on Soul Sand and Soil. 

With a few more you'll walk even faster on Soul Sand and Soil than on other Blocks! 

Hey, maybe Soul Sand paths aren't a bad idea anymore...

quests.title: Frost Walker Unit
quests.subtitle: Boots
quests.description:
It is in the name, but it being a Treasure Enchantment not everyone will know about it. 

When walking over Water with Boots enchanted with Frost Walker or MekaSuit Boots with the Frost Walker Units the Water will turn into Ice! 

The Ice won't last forever though, it will thaw out shortly! 

The more Frost Walker, the more Ice!

quests.title: Magnetic Attraction Unit
quests.subtitle: Boots
quests.description: The Magnetic Attraction Unit works just like a Simple Magnet. When used/worn, it will attract Items toward you that are out of range. \n\nThe more Magnetic Attraction Units the farther Items can be that will be pulled toward you.

quests.title: Hydraulic Propulsion Unit
quests.subtitle: Boots
quests.description:
These Units will make your Feet and pretty much entire Legs, longer and stronger! 

You can Sprint Jump higher and walk up higher steps. 

You can Jump and step higher with more Units Installed and you can change the Configs of the Unit to go even higher!

quests.title: Tritium
quests.subtitle: T
quests.description:
Tritium is unfortunately not as easy to get as Deuterium is... 

We'll need a Thermal Evaporation Plant. Well... actually 2 of them. 1 to turn Water into Brine, the other to turn the Brine into Lithium. 

Well... actually Liquid Lithium, we need Chemical Lithium. Use the Rotary Condensator to turn it from Liquid to Chemical! 

Then, we can use the Solar Neutron Activator to turn the Lithium into Tritium.

Harder than Deuterium, but easier than Fissile Fuel.

quests.title: Laser Amplifying
quests.description:
Laser Amplifiers have their own Internal Energy Storage, but they don't charge like most Machines. 

The way Laser Amplifiers work is by taking Charge from other Lasers shooting into them! 

Whether it be other Laser Amplifiers or Lasers, that is how they gain Energy. 

They will then use that Energy into a more focused beam by the Configs you set within its GUI. Delay, Minimum, and Maximum. 

Delay is how many Ticks it will wait after reaching the Minimum Eergy to shoot it. The least amount of Ticks is 0 and the most is 9,999! 

Minimum is the amount of Energy it will hold before shooting an even more powerful Laser! The least FE it will wait for is 800mFE while the most is 2GFE. 

Maximum works similar with how much it will hold before shooting the Laser.

quests.title: SPS Ports
quests.description:
The Super-Critical Phase Shifter (S.P.S.) will turn our Polonium into Antimatter. 

In order to do that, we'll need Polonium, Energy, a place to mix both, and a place to take Antimatter out! 

So we'll need a Port for each of those! 
2 Ports for Energy at the sides, 1 Port for giving the SPS Polonium, and the last for taking our Antimatter out.

quests.title: Supercharged Coils
quests.description:
The Super-Critical Phase Shifter will need a lot of Energy. I mean a lot a lot! Hundreds of Millions of FE. 

How do we deliver this much Energy though? 

We'll need atleast 1 (recommended 2) Supercharged Coils! 

The Supercharged Coil is placed inside the S.P.S., on an SPS Port. The Port will need to feed the Supercharged Coil Energy. 

Each Supercharged Coil can send in 400MFE per Tick. And we'll need a whole lotta those for Antimatter!

quests.title: Teleportation Unit
quests.subtitle: Meka-Tool
quests.description:
Teleportation Unit is a pretty unique Unit. 

With our Meka-Tool with Teleportation added we can look at a Block and Right Click to Teleport on to it. 

It uses Energy and has a limited range, but don't worry the range is still pretty far! 

This Unit can't work with the Farming Unit or Shearing Unit.

quests.title: Vein Mining Unit
quests.subtitle: Meka-Tool
quests.description:
Vein Mining is a limited FTB Ultimine. 

When we Mine Ores or Logs, the same Blocks connected to it will be broken with it. 

Saving lots of time... but we also have FTB Ultimine... so.

quests.title: Blasting Unit
quests.subtitle: Meka-Tool
quests.description:
Blasting isn't close to Vanilla Enchantments, but closer to Modded! 

Once Installed, we can mess with its Configs to change how big of a square of Blocks we can Mine. 

Default is 1x1 aka 1 Block. We can change it to 3x3, 5x5, 7x7, and 9x9. 

Yes, Mining a 9x9 square will take more Energy than Mining a single Block.

quests.title: Ore Refinement Unit
quests.subtitle: Meka-Tool
quests.description:
We need lots of Ores for Mekanism so why not upgrade our Meka-Tool to get more! 

Ore Refinement will act like Fortune. When Ores are Mined, there is a chance to get more Drops from them. 

We can't use the Silk Touch Unit with this one though. Either Ore Blocks or Ore Drops, choose 1!

quests.title: Silk Touch Unit
quests.subtitle: Meka-Tool
quests.description:
The Silk Touch Unit will act as a Silk Touch Enchantment for the Meka-Tool. 

But not just the Pickaxe part, also the Shovel and other Tools within the Meka-Tool! 

So you can pick up Stone and Ores plus Grass and Mycelium. 

We can't use this Unit with the Ore Refinement Unit on a Meka-Tool.

quests.title: Shearing Unit
quests.subtitle: Meka-Tool
quests.description: This one adds Shears to our Meka-Tool! \n\nWe can't use it with the Farming Unit or Teleportation Unit.

quests.title: Farming Unit
quests.subtitle: Meka-Tool
quests.description:
Wait if Paxels can make Paths, make Farmland, and Strip Logs why can't the Meka-Tool! 

Oh wait, it can if you just use the Farming Unit. 

You'll need to enable which is set in the Configs though. You can't make Soil and Farmland from the same Grass! 

We can't use this one with the Shearing Unit or Teleportation Unit.

quests.title: Attack Amplification Unit
quests.subtitle: Meka-Tool
quests.description:
The Meka-Tool already does more Damage than an AllTheModium Sword, but why not a little more! 

I can't tell how much more each Unit gives, but it definitely increases the more you have added. 

Just like Sharpness!

quests.title: Excavation Escalation Unit
quests.subtitle: Meka-Tool
quests.description:
With this Unit the Meka-Tool will Mine Blocks much quicker! 

The more you have, the quicker it goes! 
Just like the Efficiency Enchantment.

quests.title: Fusion Reactor Ports
quests.description:
Fusion Reactor Ports will replace the Reactor Glass within the Fusion Reactor in order to be used. 

We'll need a few Ports. 2 (or 1) for Deuterium and Tritium (or just D-T Fuel) for Fuel. We'll also need 1 for Outputting Energy. 

If you want to use Water to cool the Fusion Reactor, you'll need 2 more Ports. 1 for Inputting Water and 1 for Outputting Steam. 

Like other Ports, we can use the Configurator to set whether the Port Inputs or Outputs!

quests.title: Making Energy with a Turbine
quests.description:
Before we start making Energy let's get our Steam all over the place. We can do that by surrounding the Rotational Complex with Pressure Dispersers! 

Above that layer we'll need a new layer, this one full of Electromagnetic Coils. These will be moved because of the Rotational Complex, them moving with each other is what develops Energy through their Magnetic Forces. Same thing happens with Hydroelectric Plants! 

Above the Electromagnetic Coils we can use Saturating Condensers which will recycle our Steam back into some Water! The Water will be extracted through the Vents.

quests.title: Boiler Ports
quests.description:
Our Thermoelectric Boiler can be used to get Superheated Sodium and Water and recycle it into Sodium and Steam! 

But how do we get our Superheated Sodium and Water into the Boiler? 

With Boiler Ports! We'll need to use a Configurator on them to change the Ports configs though. 

Our Superheated Sodium and Water will be added in through Input Ports (separate Input Ports). 

The cooled down Sodium, will be taken out through an Output Port. And Steam gets its very own Steam Output Port!

quests.title: Turbine
Moving parts
quests.description:
The way the Turbine works is it takes in Steam via the Ports and that Steam will move the Blades on the Rotors. 

Oh wait I should probably tell you how to create the Turbine insides! 

The Rotors will be placed from the floor up within the exact center of our Turbines. Each Rotor can hold 2 Blades. 

The more Blades and Rotors the wider it will get. We won't be able to use 5x5 Base with bigger insides. 

On top of our highest Rotor we'll place the Rotational Complex. Trust me it is important!

quests.title: Plutonium Pellets
quests.description:
We got our Plutonium and the rest is what we should already have! 

A P.R.C., Water, and Fluorite Dust! 

Combine 1,000mB Water, with 1,000mB Plutonium, and 1 Fluorite Dust to make 1 Plutonium Pellet and 1,000mB Spent Nuclear Waste. 

Fluorite Dust can be made like any Metal Dust: Crusher, Enrichment Chamber, or even an Ore Hammer!

quests.title: Polonium Pellets
quests.description:
We got our Polonium and the rest is what we should already have! 

A P.R.C., Water, and Fluorite Dust! 

Combine 1,000mB Water, with 1,000mB Polonium, and 1 Fluorite Dust to make 1 Polonium Pellet and 1,000mB Spent Nuclear Waste. 

Fluorite Dust can be made like any Metal Dust: Crusher, Enrichment Chamber, or even an Ore Hammer!

quests.title: Thermoelectric Boiler
The Thermo part of the Thermoelectric Boiler
quests.description:
The inside, and important part, of the Thermoelectric Boiler is made of fancy Blocks! 

Superheating Elements which work in transfering Heat to Water and Pressure Dispersers which will help create the Steam! 

If we use bigger Builds, we can leave room between the different Blocks inside the Boiler to give more storage to Steam and Water. 

Air between the Top and the Pressure Dispersers will add to the Steam Storage. Air between the Pressure Dispersers and the Superheating Elements will give more room for Water.

quests.title: Turbine Inputs and Outputs
quests.description:
Our Turbine will need Steam in, Water out, and Energy out. 

But how? 

We can use Turbine Ports to bring in Steam and take out Energy. We'll need to use the Turbine Vents to take out Water though! 

Both of these are placed within the Walls of our Turbines.

quests.title: Spinning for Plutonium
quests.description:
Hey, I remember you! 

Turns out, the Isotopic Centrifuge is used for 2 Recipes. Fissile Fuel and Plutonium! 

For each 5mB of Nuclear Waste we can create 1mB of Plutonium. 

If each Plutonium Pellets are 1,000mB worth of Plutonium, then we'll need 5,000mB of Nuclear Waste and the same for Fissile Fuel.

quests.title: Using the Sun to make Polonium
quests.description:
Like the Isotopic Centrifuge, the Solar Neutron Activator is only used for 2 Recipes and 1 of them is with Nuclear Waste! 

This Machine will take in the Sun's Rays through the Solar Cells on top. It will then focus those Rays into one Beam and use it on the Nuclear Waste. 

This also makes it so it doesn't work at Nighttime... 

Every 5mB of Nuclear Waste will become 1mB of Polonium. 

So you'll need 5,000mB of Fissile Fuel to make 5,000mB of Nuclear Waste.

quests.title: Toss it!
quests.description:
Honestly, if you don't need more Energy and would rather be as safe as you can with your Reactor then just delete it! 

Oh yeah, you heard me! Just delete the Steam! 

I know lots of things are important in Minecraft and it is usually greater to hold onto these, instead of tossing them... 

But Steam is pretty much only for Turbines to make Energy. 

Don't need it? Then, Tube it into an Ultimate Trash Can!

quests.title: Steam
quests.description: If we are using Water as a Coolant, we will get Steam as a byproduct! \n\nNow what do we do with it?

quests.title: Radioactivity
quests.description:
Now we can finally worry about Radioactivity! 

Nuclear Waste (and it's products) are Radioactive. That means they must be held within Radioactive Waste Barrels. 

The Nuclear Waste (and it's products) must be Tubed into and out of the Radioactive Waste Barrels. 

You can not break the Barrel or Tubes that hold Radioactive materials, or else the Radiation will spread in the World. 

Radioactivity can also come from Reactors leaking or melting down. 

How do we deal with Radioactivity? Hazmat Suit and time. Check out its own Quest to learn more about them!

quests.title: Hazmat Suit
quests.description:
The Hazmat Suit is the only way of preventing Radiation from killing you. 

You need to wear the entire set to prevent Radiation Poisoning! 

Radiation will kill other Mobs and Players near it, the Players can be saved with Hazmat Suits... but Mobs aren't so lucky!

quests.title: Clock Switch
quests.description:
If you have a small Fission Reactor primarily for Polonium then we should use this as a simple fail safe! 

Polonium is made with the Solar Neutron Activator. You can probably tell it needs Daylight to work! 

So, in order to stop bottle-necking (which can be deadly when we are talking about Reactors) we can turn off our Reactor when it is Nighttime! 

First, set your FRLA to Activation. This will turn on the Reactor when it has a Redstone Signal and turned off when it doesn't. 

Now we can place our Daylight Sensor and connect it to the FRLA with Redstone. 

Then, boom, it is ready!

quests.title: Sodium Coolant
quests.description:
Sodium can be used as a Coolant instead of Water. Sodium is more Efficient, gets higher Temperatures, but is harder to get and reuse. 

Now how do we get it? 

We'll need a Thermal Evaporation Plant. I've made like 3 Quests explaining how to Build and use them, this won't be the 4th. 

We'll use the Thermal Evaporation Plant to take our Water and make Brine. 

Then, we can use an Electrolytic Separator to demolish that Brine to get our Sodium! 

And another Chemical but we don't care about it!

quests.title: Fission Reactor Logic Adapter
quests.description:
The Fission Reactor Logic Adapter ,which I will be calling FRLA, is used to monitor and configure the Fission Reactor with Redstone. 

First, place the FRLA in one of the walls of the Fission Reactor like you would with the Ports. 

Then, we can Right Click the FRLA to configure it. 

Disabled: won't interact with Redstone. 

Activation: will turn the Reactor on when given a Redstone Signal, and when there is no longer a Signal it will turn off. 

High Temperature: will send out a Redstone Signal when the Temperatures reach a dangerous Level. 

Critical Waste Level: will give a Signal when there is too much Nuclear Waste. 

Damage Critical: will, like the others, will give out a Signal when the Reactor is just about to blow up! 

Insufficient Fuel: will give a Signal when it is running out of Fissile Fuel.

quests.title: Fission Reactor
quests.subtitle: Splitting 1 Element into 2
quests.description:
The smallest (working) Fission Reactor we can make is 3x4x3. 

The base and frame will need to be made of Fission Reactor Casing while the inside will need to be either Empty, or have Fuel Rod Assembly or Control Rod Assembly! 

The inside of the walls (not the edges) can have our Fission Reactor Ports or FRLA and the rest can be filled with Reactor Glass. 

Once our Fission Reactor is built, we can Right Click anywhere (besides the FRLA) on the Reactor to open its GUI.
{@pagebreak}
This can look pretty scary to new Players so we'll go through it slowly to understand it better! 

At the top, we can see 4 different Bars. These are where we can see how much Fissile Fuel, Coolant, Heated Coolant, and Nuclear Waste. 

Between the Bars we'll find the main menu of the Reactor. It will tell us whether it is on or off, how Fissile Fuel is being used up every Tick, how much Temperature it rises every Tick, and how much Damage the Reactor has suffered! 

Below all of these we'll see 2 Buttons! One to turn on the Reactor saying Activate and the other to turn it off saying SCRAM. Next to the SCRAM Button is a little image to help Players know if it is on or off. Green when on, Red when off. 

Below those Buttons we'll see how Hot our Reactor is and below it will show a visual of the Temperature change.
{@pagebreak}
Outside of this menu, we can Click the Top Tab to pull up the Statistics. 

The top Chart shows off how much Heat can be held until Damage occurs, how much room Fuel has within the Reactor, and how Efficient it is at using Heat to use up Fuel. 

The rest is all based on how much Fuel can be used each Tick. We can set a max in the Type Box. It is also set at mB per Tick! 

The other Tab we can find on the side of the main menu is for our Temperature! 

It will show its Dissipiation rate as well as the Temperature Unit shown. We can change the Temperature Unit by Clicking on the Tab. You'll most likely use F (Fahrenheit) or C (Celsius) but we can also use K (Kelvin), R (Rankine), or STP (Standard Temperature and Pressure)!
{@pagebreak}
MELTDOWNS! 

The Fission Reactor will explode if it goes to 250% Damage. When it explodes it will break Blocks, start Fires, and worst of all... spread Radiation! 

Let's avoid that! 

The Damage will increase when the Temperature goes over 1,200K. We'll need to use Coolants to keep that Temperature down. 

Make sure it has a constant supply of Coolant and make sure the Coolant Output doesn't bottle-neck. If this happens, more Coolant can't be used and the Temperature will increase. 

LEAKS! 

Radiation leaks can also occur if the Nuclear Waste Bar is full. This will spread Radiation around the Reactor. Avoid this with constantly removing Nuclear Waste and even using FRLA to know when Waste is full!
{@pagebreak}
This Multiblock can be made at any size available, not just what is shown through the Images. The Images merely show the smallest size we can make.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_fission1.png width:100 height:75 align:center}
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_fission2.png width:100 height:100 align:center}
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_fission3.png width:100 height:100 align:center}
{image:atm:textures/questpics/mek/mek_fission4.png width:100 height:110 align:center}

quests.title: Fission Reactor Port
quests.description:
Fission Reactor Ports are pretty darn important. The Fission Reactor will need Ports for Fuel, Coolant, and Waste... so it won't work without Ports. 

Ports can be placed within any parts of the Fission Reactor's Walls, just not on the edge. 

We'll need to have 4 of them and we'll need to use the Configurator on the Ports to Configure them. 

They will start as Input Only but by Shift Right Clicking the Ports with the Configurator it will switch to Output Waste and then to Output Coolant. 

Input Only will take in both Fissile Fuel and Coolant as either Water or Sodium. 

Output Waste will send Nuclear Waste out of the Fission Reactor. 

Output Coolant will either take out Steam if Water was used as the Coolant or if Sodium is used it will take out Superheated Sodium.

quests.title: Advanced Fail Safe
quests.description:
In bigger Reactors we'll need a more advanced fail safe. 
For this one, our Reactor will need to be atleast 5 Blocks wide. That gives 3 Block width for our 2 FRLA. 

Place 1 of our FRLA in the Reactor and set it to either High Temperature or Damage Critical. Then, place the second one atleast 1 Block away while on the same Y Level. The second will need to be set to Activation. 

Now, let's do some Redstone! 

Place a Redstone Repeater facing out from the first FRLA. Then, where the Repeater is facing, place a Block that can transmit Redstone. 

On that Block, place a Redstone Torch in the direction that the second FRLA is. 

After that, place Redstone Dust next to the Torch, while on the same X/Z Level of the second FRLA. And lastly, place a second Redstone Repeater going from the Redstone Dust and into the second FRLA.

quests.title: Water Coolant
quests.description:
Listen, I have been telling you guys to use Electric Pumps for most of the Mekanism Quests. 

But to be honest I have to let you guys graduate. The Reactors will need more Water so I grant you, the Sink! 

The Sink has Infinite Water and can be Piped out from practically any Mod. I recommend using ID if available because it can pull over 2 Billion mB of Water each Tick! 

The reason I have been using the Electric Pumps is not because I don't trust you with Sinks rather it is for these reasons. 1. it will stay for Modpacks that don't have Sinks and 2. it is from Mekanism.

quests.title: Fissile Fuel storage and usage
quests.description:
Fission Fuel Assembly are what make up the storage for Fissile Fuel. They also help determine Efficiency. 

Fission Fuel Assemblies will need to be placed in the Fission Reactor in order to work. 

They can be stacked on top and next to each other, but each stack will need a... 

Control Rod Assembly on top of them! Control Rod Assembly don't change anything like Efficiency but the Fission Fuel Assembly won't work if there isn't a Control Rod Assembly above them within the Fission Reactor!

quests.title: Energized Induction Matrix
Meka-Tool
quests.description:
The Meka-Tool is the best Tool Mekanism offers, hence the name! 

It can do everything the Atomic Dissambler just better! Breaking Blocks wise, with more Damage and Attack Speed. 

Instead of having Modes though, it can use Modification Units! Check out their own Quests. 

Even though it uses the Configurator to Craft, it doesn't replicate it any way.

quests.title: Digital Miner
quests.description:
The Digital Miner is a 3x2x3... Block? Machine? 

We all know of Void Miners but come on those are weird! This Mines actual Blocks! 

We can Right Click it to open it's GUI, here we can see a whole bunch! Buttons, Screens, and even Slots! 

Slots are where the Mined Items will go to. The Screen will tell if it is ready, doesn't have enough Energy, or how many Blocks it can Mine. It also has Buttons within the Screen to Auto-Eject, suck up the Blocks it Mines, and even use Silk Touch! 

The Buttons will do everything else! We can use Visuals to see the area that will be Mined. Or even add Upgrades to make it better! 

Start: will tell the Digital Miner to start Mining! It won't work if the Machine isn't ready. Stop: will tell the Digital Miner to stop Mining. Config: sets Filters, this is important. Reset: is broken. 

Configs left side sets the Working Area for the Mining. How far, high, and low! The right side is for the actual Item Filter. The Filter is the same as with QIO Importers and Exporters, check out their Quest to learn how to set those! 

You can also use Inverse Mode to Blacklist the Filters. Plus Replacements which will fill in the Mined Blocks.

quests.title: Portable QIO Dashboard
quests.description:
The Portable QIO Dashboard allows us to view our QIO System from anywhere! 

Right Click with the Item to make it yours! 

Now you can Right Click it and set a Network Frequency to our QIO System. 

Boom everything the QIO Dashboard does, we can do with this little friend!

quests.title: Atomic Dissambler
quests.description:
The Atomic Dissambler is Mekanism's Paxel! 

It can Mine any Blocks an AllTheModium Paxel can! It can also be used as a Sword... well more like an Axe, there's no Sweeping Edge. 

It has different Modes, each doing different Efficiency and Energy usage. We can change it by holding Shift and Scrolling. 

Normal: is default Mode. With an Efficiency of 20 which means just around Efficiency II. 

Slow: is like a Paxel without Efficiency, but will use less Energy on use! 

Fast: uses a ton more Energy but much faster! Like Efficiency V. 

Off: will not break Blocks, instead it's sole purpose is to KILL!

quests.title: Fissile Fuel
quests.description:
Great, another Chemical Infuser! 

Combine the Uranium Oxide and Hydrofluorite Acid to create Uranium Hexafluoride. 

Now we can process the Uranium Hexafluoride through an Isotopic Centrifuge to finally get our beautiful Fissile Fuel.

quests.title: Robit
quests.description:
Meet Robit! He is your new Robotic Companion! 

Place him down onto a Chargepad to set it as his Home! This is important as Robit needs Energy to move and work. He can hold 40kFE. 

We can Right Click him to open his GUI (with his permission of course!). In the middle we'll see a Screen that teaches us facts about him: his Name, his Energy, his Job, and his Owner! 

On the left we got some Buttons. In order from Top to Bottom: Teleport Home will bring him to his Chargepad, Rename changes his Mob Name, and Appearance is cosmetic Robit stuff! 

Below the Energy Slot is Buttons to set his Job. Pickup: will allow Robit to pick up Items on the ground and put them in his Inventory. Follow: will make Robit either Follow you or stop where he is at. 

To the far right, is even more Buttons! The first, will bring up the main Robit menu. Crafting will open up a Crafting Table within Robit! Inventory will open up Robit's Inventory. Here you can store Items or where picked up Items will go. Smelting will use Energy to Smelt Items like a Furnace. Repairing will allow you to combine two Items to Repair their Durability.

quests.title: QIO Drives
quests.description:
QIO Drives determine the Storage within QIO Drive Arrays. 

They are placed within the Machines Inventory in order to be used. You can place up to 12 of them. 

The QIO Drives hold the Items and they will automatically fill up the first QIO Drive in order. 

Each of them have an Item Storage limit and Item Type limit. The better the QIO Drive, the more Items and Item Types you'll get! 

QIO Drive: is the most basic, having 16k Items and 128 Types. This is the only one not needing a Fission Reactor to Craft. 

Hyper-Dense QIO Drive: and everything after will need the Fission Reactor. This one holds 128k Items and 256 Item Types. 

Time-Dilating QIO Drive: can store 1,048k Items and 1,024 Item Types. 

Supermassive QIO Drive: will need Antimatter to Craft but will obviously give the most Storage. Allowing 16b Items and 8,192 Item Types.

quests.title: QIO Dashboard
quests.description:
The QIO Drive Array doesn't do much on its own, instead we'll need to add a QIO Dashboard! 

The QIO Dashboard, like all Items QIO related, needs to be set to the same Network. 

When it is finally ready we can deposit and access Items into our QIO System. 

We'll start with the most important parts! The Slots in the middle are where Items can be put, stored, and taken from. We can increase how many Slots are shown with the Buttons on the Left to Increase or Decrease Height. From 2 Rows, to 7. 

Above the Slots is the Search Bar to look up Item names, Tags, and Mods. Below the Slots is a Sorting option. Whether Items are A to Z or from least to most Items in a stack. 

The Right Button will make it so either when we open the QIO Dashboard, our Typing will start at EMI or the QIO Type Bar. 

Now for another helpful part of the QIO System, Crafting! On the Left we have a Crafting Button! This will bring up, up to 3 Crafting Windows. These each have a 3x3 Crafting Grid we can use. 

The Button below the Crafting Button effects Shift Clicking Items from our Inventory. Either it will send them to the open Crafting Window, or into the QIO System. 

The last Button is used with EMI and automatically setting up Recipes. Either the replaced Blocks will be put in your Inventory, or back into the QIO System.

quests.title: Import and Export
quests.description:
Importers and Exporters can be used to automatically Import and Export Items from and to the QIO System. 

Importers and Exporters are both Placed on Blocks with Inventories in order to take or give Items. They'll also need to be set to the same Network as the QIO Drive Array. 

If they are set to Import or Export without Filters, they will automatically take in (or out) every Item in the respected Inventories or System. 

If you want to Filter, you use Itemstack, Tag, and Mod. Each are set by putting an Item into the Slot. Itemstack will use only that Item. Tag will need the Item Tag typed into the Text Box. Mod will use the Mod an Item is from. Like Minecraft for all Vanilla Blocks.

quests.title: Induction Cells
quests.subtitle: Storage
quests.description:
Induction Cells are placed within the Energized Induction Matrix and will increase the amount of storage it has. 

And yes, their totals will stack on each other! 

Basic Induction Cell: will hold 3.2GFE each. 

Advanced Induction Cells: will hold 25.6GFE each. 

Elite Induction Cell: will hold 204.8GFE each. 

Ultimate Induction Cell: will hold 1.6TFE each.

quests.title: Induction Providers
quests.subtitle: Transport
quests.description:
Induction Providers are placed within the Energized Induction Matrix and will increase the amount of Energy it can Input and Output. 

And yes, their totals will stack on each other! 

Basic Induction Providers: will Input and Output 102.4kFE each Tick. 

Advanced Induction Providers: will Input and Output 819.2kFE each Tick. 

Elite Induction Providers: will Input and Output 6.55MFE each Tick. 

Ultimate Induction Providers: will Input and Output 52.41MFE each Tick.

quests.title: Sulfur Trioxide into Hydrofluoric Acid
quests.description:
We aren't done with our Sulfur Trioxide yet! We will need some Water Vapor to process it further though. 

To get Water Vapor we can use the Rotary Condensator to turn Water into Water Vapor! 
More Infusing! Combine our Water Vapor with our Sulfuric Trioxide to make Sulfuric Acid. 

Well it's an Acid now... but not the right one... 

Oh yeah, we'll need Fluorite which we can get from Mining Ores. Then, use the Chemical Dissolution Chamber to dilute the Sulfuric Acid with Fluorite to finally get our Hydrofluoric Acid!

quests.title: Preparing Uranium
quests.description:
Let's take a break from Sulfur and Acids and let's focus on the Radioactive part of Fissile Fuel! 

Now let's see... what is Radioactive, abundant, and used in ATO so any version will work? 

Oh yeah Uranium! 

Mine Uranium Ore and use the Uranium Ingots in an Enrichment Chamber to make Yellow Cake Uranium. 

No, don't eat it. It isn't that type of Cake! 

Bake the Yellow Cake Uranium in a Chemical Oxidizier to make Uranium Oxide.

quests.title: Quantum Item Orchestration
quests.subtitle: (QIO)
quests.description:
Move aside AE2 and RS2! We got Mekanism! 

The Quantum Item Orchestration (QIO) is a Virtual Item storage. We'll need a few Items to open and store Items in it before we get to use it! 

First, is the heart of the system, the QIO Drive Array. It is the Machine everything will go through and connect through. 

It doesn't require Energy but like Teleporters and Quantum Entangloporters it will need to be set to a Network! The other Items that connect to the QIO Drive Array will need to be set to that Network as well. 

For the QIO Drives we just need to place them within the QIO Drive Array!

quests.title: Induction Ports
quests.description:
Induction Ports are how we'll get our Energy in and out of our Energized Induction Matrix. 

Like in what seems to be every single Multiblock, you'll need to place the Ports within the Walls of the Induction Matrix. 

I don't believe the Ports have limits besides what the Induction Matrix has, so you won't need more than 2 unless you're taking from different sources!

quests.title: Mekanism: Reactors
quests.description:
Yes, Mekanism is that big! 

If you want your Reactors and Invincible Armor, then you are in the right spot! 

First, we'll need a Fission Reactor and that needs Fissile Fuel. To make Fissile Fuel we'll need some Sulfuric Trioxide. 

Start by putting Sulfur into a Chemical Oxidizier to make Sulfur Dioxide. 

Then, make some Oxygen by processing Water through an Electrolytic Separator. 

Now we can Tube that Oxygen and Sulfur Dioxide into a Chemical Infuser to make our Sulfur Trioxide.

quests.title: Spinning into gems

Currently, some recipes are broken which output dusts or nuggets.

quests.title: 35BC118040E7428F

Enderic lasers have multiple uses:

quests.title: 3CFE522A4B7CC2EC

quests.title: PneumaticCraft: Repressurized

quests.description:
PneumaticCraft is all about Pressure! These quests won't go over everything the mod has, but will still go over a lot! Please remember to check JEI, read the tooltips and read the PCB:R, they are all very useful.

To get started, you'll need to craft some Compressed Iron Ingots! The easiest way to do this is to make a hole in the ground, throw in some iron ingots (or blocks) and then blow it up with some TNT!

Some might get lost in the explosion, but that's a risk we'll have to take!

quests.title: Reinforced Stone

quests.title: Logistics

quests.title: 5B9F933ECD6B24FD

quests.description:

quests.description: The Tube Junction gives you more control over the transportation of your pressure by allowing you to move your Pressure Tubes in more directions.

quests.description: To move pressure you will need to obtain Pressure Tubes. What pressure you may be asking? Continue the questline to see what these are used for.

quests.title: 495DCA49B4E80852
quests.subtitle: Pew Pew!
quests.description: The Minigun is a gun that needs pressure and ammo to work. Read the tooltip for more info.

quests.title: Pressure from Power
quests.subtitle: Power = Pressure
quests.description: The Flux Compressor can create a ton of pressure using power. Simply pump some FE in and it will start generating some. If you have enough FE to spare, this is probably the easiest way to generate pressure.

quests.title: 2745297337E13E9E

quests.title: 53518D4ED99A242F
quests.subtitle: Want to make your setup look cool?
quests.description: The Camouflage Applicator can be used to hide PneumaticCraft machinery inside of other blocks.

quests.title: 4FCC20D9F8F87B2F
quests.subtitle: Torque-ing about Tools!
quests.description: The Pneumatic Wrench is used to move around or break your machines and tubes.

quests.title: 4CA17B0A80020B2F

quests.title: 0A912B2E2BE34920

quests.description:
Although you can find Crude Oil on the surface, drilling is a great way to obtain a bunch of oil. First use a Seismic Sensor until you find oil underneath you, then use your Gas Lift filled with drill pipes to drill for oil. (This requires pressure to work).\n
{image:pneumaticcraft:textures/patchouli/oil_pumping.png width:200 height:200 align:right fit:true}

quests.title: Diesel
quests.subtitle: Poor Sel
quests.description: Diesel can be used to make more Kerosene or to make Lubricant.

quests.title: Lubricant

quests.title: 2338E5269CA23C91
quests.subtitle: This is the Best Bit

{image:atm:textures/questpics/pneumaticcraft/block_tracker.png width:150 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: 0F49E9167B5E97C9

quests.description: Any damage you take when falling (ignoring armor) will also be dealt to nearby mobs.

quests.description:
Allows you to fly like Iron Man.

You can only have one level of these Upgrades in the Boots at a time. Each level will use more pressure than the previous.

Use these upgrades, don't just craft them.

quests.title: 6674270897997BF7
quests.subtitle: Max: 1

The Sentry Turret can be placed somewhere and set to attack mobs or players when they are in range. It just needs some Minigun Ammo.
{image:pneumaticcraft:textures/patchouli/sentry_turret.png width:100 height:100 align:left fit:true}

quests.title: Pressure from Liquids
quests.description:
The Liquid Compressor creates pressure using certain liquids. You can put the fuel in by right-clicking the bucket onto the machine, pumping in the fluid, or by putting a bucket in the top slot in the GUI.
{image:pneumaticcraft:textures/gui/gui_liquid_compressor.png width:200 height:200 align:center fit:true}

quests.title: Kerosene
quests.subtitle: Have you Kero-seen this?
quests.description: Kerosene can be used to make Gasoline or it can be used as fuel in a Kerosene Lamp.

quests.title: 23737103592776C2
quests.subtitle: Mega Torches are nothing!
quests.description: The Kerosene Lamp is a great light source that uses fuel (Kerosene being the best) to produce light.

quests.title: Jet Boots
quests.subtitle: You thought using an Elytra was hard?
quests.description: You will only see this quest if you have used Jet Boots.\n\nThere's no way of using Jet Boots without taking damage, don't even try...

quests.title: Generating Power
quests.subtitle: Pressure = Power
quests.description: Whoever told you PneumaticCraft wasn't about generating power?\n\nThe Pneumatic Dynamo allows you to turn your pressure in FE. Read the tooltip or read about it in the PNC:R to learn how it works.

quests.title: 64E2E05B228EA53E
quests.subtitle: A Whole new Level!
quests.description: Advanced Pressure Tubes are the best Pressure Tubes available, being able to hold 20 bars of pressure!\n\nAlthough these are really cool on their own, they can also be used in some even cooler recipes.

quests.title: Pressure from the Sun
quests.subtitle: In the palm of my hand...
quests.description: The Solar Compressor generates Pressure by using sunlight, the warmer it gets, the more Pressure it will produce.\n\nHowever, be careful, if it gets too hot it will malfunction and you will need to repair it.

quests.title: Generating Pressure
quests.subtitle: Feeling the Pressure
quests.description: The Air Compressor is an easy way of making pressure, simply put some burnable items into it, and watch the magic happen! (I recommend making at least 3 of these to start off with).

quests.title: Preventing Explosions?
quests.subtitle: If only there was an easy Solution...
quests.description: Did I forget to mention everything can blow up? ...\n\nLuckily there's an easy solution! The Security Upgrade when placed in a machine makes sure they don't explode, put these into any machines they can go into.

quests.title: The Pressure Chamber
quests.subtitle: Pressurizing!
quests.description:
The Pressure Chamber is an important multiblock structure made up of Pressure Chamber Walls (The faces can be replaced with Pressure Chamber Glass). The Pressure Chamber can be as small as a 3x3x3 multiblock, or as big as a 5x5x5 multiblock. The blocks required for the 5x5x5 is what's needed to complete this quest.

To use the Pressure Chamber you will need to pipe pressure into a Pressure Chamber Valve using the Pressure Tubes you made earlier, remember to put a Security Upgrade into the Pressure Valve. Different recipes require different amounts of pressure.

You'll need to be able to input and output items to and from the Pressure Chamber, this is where Pressure Chamber Interfaces come into it. Blue on the outside means it's for importing items, while if gold is on the outside it's for outputing items, place one of each on any face.

quests.title: Crude Oil
quests.subtitle: The Path to Plastic
quests.description: The next stage of the mod requires the collection of Crude Oil. This Oil can be found naturally on the surface of the overworld.

quests.title: Oil Refinery
quests.subtitle: Now we're getting somewhere
quests.description:
The Oil Refinery we'll be making is a 1x1x5 multiblock made up of 1 Refinery Controller (at the bottom) and four Refinery Outputs (on top). You will need to input Oil and heat for this to work. This will produce Diesel, Kerosene, Gasoline and LPG. Putting Thermal Laggings on the sides helps keep it warm.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/pneumaticcraft/oil_refinery.png width:300 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: 5303509A1C2B1CCD

quests.description: The Pneumatic Jackhammer uses pressure to mine, it can be upgraded to be amazing!

quests.title: Elevators

With these 3 components you can create some amazing Elevators.\n
{image:pneumaticcraft:textures/patchouli/elevator.png width:1 height:1 align:left fit:true}

quests.title: 6EB53CDCB80D4B66
quests.description:
The Pneumatic Door acts as automatic door that can be made to only open for you!
{image:pneumaticcraft:textures/patchouli/pneumatic_door.png width:200 height:200 align:right fit:true}

quests.title: Programming Drones

quests.description: With Micromissiles you can shoot explosions from far away! Now nobody can escape!\n\nTheses are needed to craft the ATM Star.

The Thermal Compressor creates pressure using heat! Place somthing hot on one side and something cold on the other to create pressure.
{image:pneumaticcraft:textures/patchouli/thermal_compressor.png width:100 height:100 align:left fit:true}

quests.title: 0D2F5CC96269F9E3

quests.title: 0D50BDEFA0319EA1
quests.subtitle: Always Required
quests.description: This will drop the finished product into your output chest.

quests.title: 230463E830D6FFEB
quests.subtitle: The path to PCBs
quests.description: Now that we have plastic, the next step is getting some finished PCBs, first make some Empty PCBs in the Pressure Chamber.

quests.title: Understanding Pressure
quests.subtitle: What happened to RF or FE?
quests.description: When making pressure in an Air Compressor, if you don't have anywhere for the pressure to go. it will just disappear. Make sure you have somewhere for the pressure to go before making some.

quests.title: Heat Production
quests.subtitle: Still not RF...
quests.description: The Vortex Tube seperates pressure into hot and cold air. The cold air goes to the blue side and the hot air goes to the red side.

quests.title: Moving Heat
quests.subtitle: We have the heat to move :)
quests.description: To move the heat being made by the Vortex Tube, make some Heat Pipes.

quests.title: LPG
quests.subtitle: The one we need
quests.description: LPG can be used to make Molten Plastic.

quests.title: Thermopneumatic Processing
quests.subtitle: The longer the name, the better
quests.description: The Thermopneumatic Processing Plant will be used to make Molten Plastic, simply pump in some LPG, Coal and some heat.

quests.title: 657DB994B029F61C
quests.description:
When the Heat Frame is placed on a container containing certain fluids and made cold enough, it will turn said fluids into items.
Turns Molten Plastic into Plastic.
Turns Water into Ice.
Turns Lava into Obsidian.

quests.title: Plastic
quests.subtitle: Finally!
quests.description: Place your Liquid Plastic onto the ground or store some in a Chest with a Heat Frame attached and there's your Plastic Sheet!

quests.title: PCB Blueprint
quests.subtitle: Thanks Amadron!

quests.title: Charging with UVs
quests.subtitle: I hope you have some Sunglasses!
quests.description:
Place your Empty PCBs in a UV Light Box to charge them. Needs pressure and access to sunlight.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/pneumaticcraft/uv_charging.png width:300 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: 602C3E88D96F8843
quests.subtitle: Almost there!
quests.description: Put a Charged Empty PCB into the Etching Tank with some Etching Acid and some heat and you'll get an Unassembled PCBs.

quests.title: 1427B3AB09510D20
quests.subtitle: You did it!
quests.description: Craft together your Unassmbled PCB with 2 Capacitors and 2 Transistors to get yourself a Finished PCB.

quests.title: 09BA45CBBFB4AE26
quests.subtitle: Always Required
quests.description: The next stage of this mod requires you to set up Assembly Lines. The main component of an Assembly Line is the Assembly Controller.\n\nThis is where the pressure will go.

quests.title: 3D819550074CA376
quests.subtitle: Always Required
quests.description: The item will need to be placed here before getting picked back up.

quests.title: Using Assembly Lines
quests.subtitle: Some Assembly Required
quests.description: Although not every recipe requires the same components, you can set up your Assembly Lines with everything installed. A simple Assembly Line setup that can be used for everything is shown in the image below. Read the quests for each component for some important information about them.\n\nSpeed Upgrades make this so much quicker!

quests.title: Solar Cells
quests.subtitle: The Sun's Cells
quests.description: Solar Cells are used to make Solar Compressors.

quests.title: Amadron
quests.subtitle: I wonder if they have 1 day delivery?
quests.description:
We will need to order some stuff off of Amadron using the Amadron Tablet in order to continue progression. To use it, shift-right click a Chest and a Fluid tank, put your currency in a linked container (Emeralds, etc) and order something. You'll see an Amadrone come down to take your money and another Amadrone come to drop off what you ordered.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/pneumaticcraft/amadron_drone.png width:300 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Fish & Chips!
quests.subtitle: Fancy some Fish & Chips?
quests.description: Could I get that with some Mashed Peas with a side of Beans on Toast please Governor?

quests.title: Vegetable Oil
quests.subtitle: Better Oil
quests.description: Vegetable Oil can be made by putting either crops or seeds into a Thermopneumatic Processing Plant.

quests.title: 52D3697F1F5625C7
quests.subtitle: Don't Ask...
quests.description: Etching Acid is made in the Pressure Chamber with Molten Plastic...and some other stuff. Used in the Etching Tank.

quests.title: 00075A5F9AC120ED
quests.subtitle: Always Required
quests.description: This will take the items out of your input chest.

quests.title: Better Heat Production
quests.subtitle: More Heat
quests.description: To increase your heat production, place a Heat Sink on the cold side of your Vortex Tube.

quests.title: 5A9D6672385D3D82
quests.subtitle: Saving Lapis
quests.description: Only use 1 Lapis for an Upgrade instead of 4.

quests.title: Construction Bricks™
quests.subtitle: There's no pain worse than stepping on these
quests.description: Construction Bricks are cool building blocks, be careful they hurt. Craft them again to make them smooth.

quests.title: 32C3E14578D48E6C
quests.subtitle: Upgraded Pressure Tubes
quests.description: Just like regular Pressure Tubes only these can hold 10 bars of pressure.

quests.title: Automating PCBs
quests.description: Using a Laser Assembly Program you can speed up the production of Unassembled PCBs. Just put an Empty PCB in the input chest, pump in some pressure and wait.

quests.title: 30AD7B15682E4D0E
quests.subtitle: Signs? Never heard of them!
quests.description: A smart Sign which can store and display arbitrary amounts of text, scaled so the text always fits.\n\nRight-click with any Dye to recolor the tile, you can color the border and the background independentrly.

quests.title: 5A0860631323B5E3
quests.subtitle: You knead this
quests.description: Made with Wheat Flour. Can be used to make Salmon Tempura and Sourdough Bread.

quests.title: Yeast
quests.subtitle: The Yeast of your Problems
quests.description: Why doesn't regular Bread need Yeast?

quests.title: Ethanol
quests.description: Ethanol can be used to make Biodiesel.

quests.title: Biodeisel
quests.subtitle: Bio/Diesel
quests.description: Biodeisel can be used to make Lubricant and Molten Plastic.

quests.title: 541D270451DA4320
quests.description: The Switch Track will be needed for moving lanes between the different Special Tracks. The Arrows on it show which goes where.

quests.title: 6E7C4228CD2B6BB9
quests.description: This Crowbar has a few different modes, each with change the design of a Locomotive. From default which is described while hovering over the item in your inventory, none which goes to grey, Halloween which makes it spooky, and Christmas which makes it festive!

quests.title: Turnout Tracks
quests.description:
The Turnout track is the first from hitting a track with a Spike Maul. It can help go two directions, forward and to a side. It can be switched with a Switch next to the track.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_turnout.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Wye Tracks
quests.description:
The Wye Track is the second track made by using a Spike Maul. It directs two Tracks into one. If you have one Track intersected by another the Wye will move Carts on the first Track into the intersecting one.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_wye.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Junction Tracks
quests.description:
The Junction is the last Track made by the Spike Maul. It acts as a normal intersection for Tracks. Carts keep going the same way as before but now Tracks can intersect. What happens if 2 Carts hit each other on it? THEY EXPLODE!!! I'm kidding but Electric Locomotives will though.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_junction.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Crowbars
quests.subtitle: "What, ya gonna rob me?"
quests.description:
The Crowbar is the main tool of RailCraft. 

When used on a Locomotive it will change the direction it's facing. 

When shift clicked you can connect Locomotives and Carts. 

When just used on Carts they give them a slight push. 

And when used on special tracks they change their mode. 

The different Crowbars just give different looks and damage.

quests.title: 'Switch em up'
quests.description: The Spike Mauls are used on normal Tracks to switch their modes. Very helpful for trying to make intersections!

quests.title: Color Legend
quests.description:
With this Quest page I took a lot of time coloring the texts to try and help you the Player understand what I am referencing. Only for me to realize it might be even more confusing, so here's a Legend! 

Purple is any Train or Locomotive, so both Electric and Steam Locomotives and Carts attached. 
Gold is any Tracks and Rails, includes special Rails but not Track Kits. 
Light Red stands for any Track Kits. 
Dark Red is for Crowbars. 
Cyan is for the Steam Locomotive only. 
Yellow is for only the Electric Locomotive. 
Blue is for the Tunnel Bore. 
Grey is for Minecarts and special Carts.

quests.title: Steam Turbine
quests.description:
The Steam Turbine uses Steam to make FE and EU energy. \n\nIt's 3x2x2 building of only Steam Turbine Housing, and it'll need a Turbine Motor in it, and Steam piped in.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_turbine.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Steam Oven
quests.description:
The Steam Oven is another machine that uses Steam for something useful. 

By putting Steam into the Steam Oven it will act as a furnace to any items in it. Making Ingots from Ores and cooking food items. 

It's a 2x2x2 machine of Steam Oven blocks.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_oven.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Abandoned Tracks
quests.description:
Abandoned Tracks are good for the cheapskates and aesthetic. They can be used to bridge accross a few blocks without support. They can only be 2 blocks away from blocks going the same direction, or one block from the opposite direction. They come at the risk of derailment though, basically your Cart will be thrown off the rails.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_abandoned.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 5F458D79D43D8842
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Track Kits for stopping Carts
quests.description:
These Tracks are made for stopping the Locomotives and Carts. 

The Locking Kit stops Carts and only starts them when given a redstone pulse. 
The Buffer Kit is for the end of your tracks, will stop them and not start. 
The Gated Kit just deploys a Fence Gate connected with the track.

quests.title: Track Kit Coupler
quests.description: The Coupler is for connecting or disconnecting Carts. Coupling is the phrase for connecting Carts. \n\nIt can be configured with a Crowbar to couple, decouple, or auto couple. Needs Redstone to work.

quests.title: Boilers
quests.description:
The Water Boilers are some of the most helpful machines from RailCraft. They need a Fuel Firebox and some sort of boiler on top. The Fueled Firebox can be 1x1 2x2 or 3x3. The size of the Firebox changes how big the Boiler on top can be. For 1x1 Firebox it can only have 1x1 Boiler. For 2x2 Firebox it can be a 2x2x3 Boiler. For 3x3 Firebox it can be 3x3x4. The Liquid Fuel will take Creosote to heat up. For Solid Firebox it'll use anything a furnace can use.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_big_boiler.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: High Speed Tracks
quests.description:
High Speed Tracks are like Reinforced Tracks but obviously faster. They'll need Track Kits to help build up speed though! And careful around corners.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_speed.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Reinforced Tracks
RailCraft
quests.description:
RailCraft is an entire mod based off Trains! 

From Minecarts to Electric Locomotives to Tunnel Bores! It has everything Train accessory wise as well! Traffic Lights, Steam Boilers to power Trains, and automation for it all. 

The model Mod for Model Train Lovers!

quests.title: Track Kits for moving Carts
quests.description:
These Tracks Kits are for changing momentum with your Carts. 

The Transition Kits change the speed of the passing Locomotive, needs redstone power. 
The Booster Kits will speed up the Cart if powered and slow down the Cart if not powered. 
The Control Kit gives the Carts a little push, when powered it'll change the direction it pushes it in. 
The Throttle Kit will change the speed of a passing Locomotive to whatever speed is configured, needs to be powered with redstone. 
The Launcher Kit will quite literally throw your Cart!

quests.title: Track Kit One Way
quests.description: The One Way Track Kit is quite simple. Carts can only go where the arrow is facing.

quests.title: Rails!
quests.description: Hence the name of the mod, RailCraft, and what it revolves around, Trains, Rails are pretty important. \n\nThe Vanilla ones work for lots of these but come on we all know they suck. Upgraded ones will need some more special items for their recipes! Craft them! (They might require using machines to make the items so check out that part of the quest!)

quests.title: Tracks!
quests.description: Track Kits are used to craft with rails to make special rails. \n\nThese rails will be helpful for everything Train wise like: stopping the Train, moving the Train, and emitting redstone.

quests.title: Blast (Steel) Furnace
quests.description:
RailCraft adds a Blast Furnace multiblock for us to transform Iron into Steel! 

To build it you'll need 34 Blast Furnace Bricks. It'll be 3 blocks wide, 3 blocks long, and 4 blocks tall. The two blocks in the exact center need to be hollow. You'll know it's done when it forms all together and allows you to access its GUI. 

There you can put Iron ,in any form, to get Steel and Granulated Sand.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_furnace.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Water Tank
quests.description:
The Water Tank is like having a barrel outside. Just this barrel is much bigger. It collects water and can hold water for Steam Locomotives. 

The amount of water is makes is dependent on the biome and visible to the sky. 

It's made by a 3x3x3 Water Tank blocks with the center being hollow.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_tank.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: High Speed Electric Tracks
quests.description:
The High Speed Electric Tracks are like the Electric Tracks but faster! They also require what the normal High Speed Tracks require and what the Electric Tracks require. Speed Boosts and Frames to power them. Now you have to be careful around corners and with touching them!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_electric_speed.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Electric Tracks
quests.description:
The Electric Tracks are used for the Electric Locomotives. They'll need to be powered by Frames and yes it will hurt you if you touch it.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_electric_rail.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Track Kits for moving entities
quests.description:
These Track Kits are for using entities with your Carts (Entities aka Mobs). 

The Embarking Kit will pick up any Mobs nearby and put them in a Cart. 
The Disembarking Kit unloads Mobs from the Carts. 
The Dumping Kit will drop the mobs in the Carts below the tracks its on.

quests.title: Track Kit Whistle
quests.description: The Whistle Kit when active with Redstone will cause the Locomotives to set off their whistles.

quests.title: Machines
quests.description:
RailCraft uses many machines for different things but mostly resource creation.
All of them start with Iron Ingots!

quests.title: Coke Oven
quests.description:
Wait we have Steel again does that also mean we get our (Coal) Coke back? Yes! 
To get (Coal) Coke you'll need a Coke Oven. To make one you'll need 26 Coke Oven Bricks and place them 3x3x3 with 1 block hollow in the center. You'll know it's done when you can access the GUI and it's all one texture. 

Place Coal or Coal Blocks to get (Coal) Coke and Liquid Creosote! You can always put any log in to get Charcoal and Creasote.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_coke.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Crusher
quests.description:
The Crusher is just as the name suggests. It can crush blocks to get the crafting materials, like bricks from a brick staircase, or dusts from ingots. 

It needs power to work though! 

To build one it's 3x2x2 of Crusher blocks.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_crusher.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Strap Iron Tracks
quests.description:
The Strap Iron Tracks, like the Abandoned Tracks, are perfect for the cheapskates. They go much slower than the other tracks but no risk of derailment!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_strap.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Steam Locomotive
quests.description:
The Steam Locomotive is the most basic Locomotive. It can be powered by giving it water, furnance fuel, and waiting. It'll need constant water to keep working. \n\nDon't worry that just means the smoke coming out of the top of it is Water Vapor, which is safe for the Environment. Well the Coal part isn't the best for the Environment... eh its Minecraft what do we care!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_steam_locomotive.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Track Kits for using Redstone
quests.description:
These 2 Track Kits are for using Carts and Redstone.

The Activator Kit will activate whatever Cart goes over it. 
The Detector Kit will activate a redstone signal whenever a Cart passes over it. 

Both are similar to their Vanilla counters for regular tracks.

quests.title: Track Kit Routing
quests.description: The Routing Kit is used with the passing tickets.

quests.title: 7D40B80DBBC4E160
quests.description:
The Manual Rolling Machine will be your little crafting machine for many things material for railcraft! 

When you put the recipe in and it can make more than 1 it will autocraft while you're still looking at it. When you leave the Rolling Machine while crafting it will abort the crafting and put it in your inventory. 

You must manually build the last recipe!

quests.title: Electric Locomotive
quests.description:
Unlike the Steam Locomotive you won't need to put anything into the Electric Locomotive. 

It runs off the power from the Frames beneath the Electric Tracks. 

Yes, it can only be ran off Electric Tracks.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_electric.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Frames
quests.description: In order to power your Electric Rails and your Electric Locomotive you'll need Frames. Frames need to be powered and will move power to each connected to Frame.

quests.title: Carts 'N' Trains!
quests.description:
The reason we're all here, Trains. The mod is called RailCraft don't act surprised. 

There's 2 different main Trains and 1 special mining Train. 

These Trains all by themselves can get a little boring, so why not attach Carts to them! Connecting Carts with Carts and with Trains is called Coupling, and to unconnect them is to Decouple. To Couple Trains and Carts use a Crowbar or a Track with the Coupling Track Kit.

quests.title: Tunnel Bore, Bore Head
quests.description:
To actually use a Tunnel Bore you'll need a Tunnel Bore Head. 

They come in 4 different styles and it mines dependent on the Bore Head. 

It can be enchanted and has durability so you'll want to enchant it!

quests.title: Tunnel Bore
quests.description:
The Tunnel Bore is perfect for automatically placing Rails especially under mountains or hills. 

It'll need 3 things to start working: Bore Head, fuel like Coal, and Rails. Once it has all 3 just let it go! 

Remember to keep track of the items going in it!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/railcraft/rail_tunnel.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 78D8F40AA9568511
quests.description:
The Powered Rolling Machine is much better version of the Manual Rolling Machine. 

You don't have to keep looking in the machine to craft things and it will automatically craft all of them. 

The only problem is it needs power!

quests.title: New Carts
quests.description: These new Carts are similar to the special Vanilla Carts. The Minecart with a Tank will hold and move any Liquid held in it. The Minecart with an Energy cell will instead hold and move Energy!

quests.title: Carts and Tracks
quests.description:
These new Carts are mostly for laying down Tracks.

The Track Layer places down Tracks while the Track Remover removes Tracks.

The Track Relayer replaces the Tracks with different ones and the Track UnderCutter replaces the blocks beneath the Tracks.

quests.title: Item Loader
quests.description: The Item Loader is the most basic dispenser from RailCraft. It has to be above the Track and can be configured to what you'll want loaded onto your Carts below.

quests.title: Item Unloader
quests.description: The Item Unloader is the opposite of the Item Loader. It will take items from the Carts. This one must also be above the Track.

quests.title: Fluid Loader
quests.description: The Fluid Loader will be helpful to keeping your Steam Locomotives up and running. It has to be placed a few blocks above the Tracks and it will deploy fluids into either the Locomotive or Carts.

quests.title: Cart Dispenser
quests.description: The Cart Dispenser will do as the name suggests. It can dispense any Carts onto the Tracks in front of it. Needs a Redstone signal to dispense.

quests.title: Advanced Item Loader
quests.description: The Advanced Item Loader is everything the regular one is but can be used from anywhere near the Track. Next to, above, next to on the other side. Use the Crowbar to change its direction.

quests.title: Advanced Item Unloader
quests.description: The Advanced Item Unloader is just like the normal part but can be used from any direction. Nothing different besides direction.

quests.title: Fluid Unloader
quests.description: The Fluid Unloader is the exact opposite of the Fluid Loader. Instead of being over the Track its under. Instead of giving Steam Locomotives water it takes their water. I don't know why you'd want to do that but you can!

quests.title: Train Dispenser
quests.description: The Train Dispenser is a better version of the Cart Dispenser. It can Dispense the whole Locomotive and more! Set a pattern for what you want to be deployed then give it a redstone signal.

quests.title: Pipez: Upgrades
quests.description:
All Upgrades increase the amount the Pipez move and also grant more options to use with the Pipe. 

Basic Upgrade allows Redstone Activation with Pipez, to change distribution either:Closest First, Farthest First, Round-Robin, or Random, and to add Filters.

Improved, Advanced, and Ultimate upgrades don't grant anything new they just move more!

quests.title: Pipez: Energy Pipes
quests.description:
These are simple pipes that can be upgraded with Pipe Upgrades.

To 'extract' power from a block, place the pipe down next to the block, and on the side that is connected, shift+right-click with the pipe wrench to set the pipe to extract.

The Pipez mod also offers ways to transport items, gases, and liquids as well! Or you can make an All-In-One Pipe called the Universal Pipe.

Other Wrenches work with Pipez as well!

quests.title: Transferring Power
quests.description: If you're looking for different ways to get power out of your machines, this is where you can find it!\n\nThere are several options, both wired and wireless, for transferring power.

quests.title: Mekanism: Universal Cables
quests.subtitle: Mekanism's Energy Transfer Pipe
quests.description: Mekanism offers a nice looking Cable to transfer your power.\n\nIf the machine you are connecting to already pulls or pushes power, you will not need to configure the Cable. Otherwise, you'll need a Configurator to configure the Cable. Shift right-clicking will change the Cable to pull or push mode.

quests.title: Basic Power
quests.subtitle: All The Power!
quests.description: This chapter is dedicated to all things power related!\n\nHere you'll find the basic ways to generate, store, and transfer power.

quests.title: Storing Power
quests.description: This section shows you different ways to store your power!

quests.title: Mekanism: Quantum Entangloporter
quests.subtitle: Doesn't just work for Power
quests.description: With a little work into Mekanism, this machine allows you to transfer anything wirelessly.\n\nYou can set specific channels to transfer individual items, energy, or even gases from Mekanism. It's pretty cool.

quests.title: Integrated Dynamics: Energy Battery
quests.subtitle: Batteries Included
quests.description: Integrated Dynamics provides a simple power storage system. The Batteries can be combined in a crafting grid to increase the overall storage!

quests.title: RFTools Power: Powercells
quests.description: RFTools Power has Powercells to store power, which are multi-block storage units that can be customized and upgraded to store power.\n\nYou will need a Wrench to determine inputs and outputs for power.

quests.title: Mekanism: Energy Cubes
quests.description:
Mekanism is one of the best mods for energy storage, especially in the early game.

The Basic Energy Cube is easy to configure, easy to craft, and stores a lot of power. It can also be upgraded, and can charge items inside of the interface!

To learn more about upgrading the Energy Cube as well as the mod, head over to the Mekanism quest chapter!

quests.title: Automated Flux Dust
quests.description: Flux Dust can be automated using Productive Bees!\n\nRedstone Bee Spawn Eggs can be converted to Flux Dust Bee Spawn Eggs using an Obsidian Bee.

quests.title: Flux Networks
quests.subtitle: The Ultimate Wireless Power Solution
quests.description:
Flux Networks is a mod that aims to be the solution to all of your wireless power needs.

The mod itself does not have a way to generate power, but it can store and wirelessly transmit power, even across dimensions. It can even charge your items in your inventory.

You can even charge your Jetpacks while you are flying with this mod.

To get started with the mod, you'll need some Flux Dust. Head to Bedrock, then throw some Redstone on top of some Bedrock. Place some Obsidian right above the floating Redstone, then left click the Obsidian.

quests.title: Heat Generator
quests.description:
Mekanism's Heat Generator is a different take on basic power production. It has two modes of creating power:

Passive: Surrounding the generator with Lava source or flowing blocks creates passive power over time through heat. Place one Lava source block on top and let it flow over the sides. Make sure to have Pipes connected for energy first!

Active: Placing combustible materials such as Coal or Wood into the generator will burn the fuel to create power. This is not very efficient.

quests.title: Early Game Power Options
quests.subtitle: Starter Power
quests.description: Looking for early game power options? These are good ways to get you started with generating power.\n\nThese don't produce a ton of power, but they are typically easy or cheap to get in the early game!

quests.title: Mid Game Power Options
quests.description: You can't power your base off of Coal forever! If you've got a decent amount of resources available, it's time to upgrade your power setup!\n\nThese options usually require a little setting up, but produce enough power to carry you far into your playthrough.

quests.title: Extreme Reactors: Reactors
quests.subtitle: Customizable Reactors!
quests.description: Extreme Reactors offers multi-block Reactors that are completely customizable in size, efficiency, and more.\n\nTo learn more about getting started with Extreme Reactors, check out the quest chapter for the mod!

quests.title: Coal Generators
quests.subtitle: Fossil Fuels
quests.description: These Coal Generators are some of the easiest generators to make.\n\nThey are very simple to use and create a decent amount of power based on the combustible material you put in. They also automatically distributes power to adjacent blocks.

quests.title: More Powah!
quests.description: Believe it or not, the Powah mod has some great options for getting... powwe.\n\nMake sure to check out the Powah qyest chapter to learn more!

quests.title: More Power Storage
The "Core" Crafting Materials
quests.subtitle: Of Cores you need these
quests.description: In this mod, you'll need Flux Cores and Flux Blocks to craft the core parts of your network. Make a few of each!

quests.title: Mekanism: Renewable Energy
quests.subtitle: The Power of the Sun...
quests.description:
Mekanism provides several ways to make power using renewable resources.

The Solar Generators harness the power of the Sun to provide basic power needs. It does not work during the night, and must have access to the sky. Glass is okay.

The Wind Generator provides power via the wind. Unless you've figured out a way for your character to manually spin this, the speed it spins is based off of the Y lvl it is placed at. It also needs direct access to the sky without any blocks above it.

quests.title: Mekanism: Gas-Burning Generator
quests.subtitle: MELON POWER!
quests.description:
If you've ever heard of someone talking about "Melon Power", this is it. Mekanism's Gas-Burning Generator can produce a good amount of power by pumping in Ethylene made from Melon Slices.

To produce Ethylene, start by crushing organic materials in a Crusher to create Bio Fuel. Melon Slices are typically used for this! This is then pumped into a Pressurized Reaction Chamber (PRC for short).

The PRC needs Water, Bio Fuel, and some Hydrogen to create Ethylene. You can get the Hydrogen from separating water in an Electrolytic Separator.

Once you've started producing the Ethylene, pump it into the Gas-Burning Generator to start generating power!

quests.title: End Game Power Options
quests.subtitle: More Power Than You'll Need
quests.description: If you're looking to generate a ton of power, you can start by scaling up some of the options from the Mid Game Power section. Make your Reactors bigger. Upgrade your Thermo Generators to Nitro. Go wild.\n\nHowever, you may need even more power.

quests.title: Starting Your Network
quests.subtitle: Just plug it in!
quests.description:
The first item you'll need to start your Flux Network is a Flux Plug.

The Plug is used to "draw" power from the block it is attached to. Aside from a small buffer, the Plug does not store any power itself, so don't worry about it zapping up all of your power.

It is suggested to place the Plug on a power storage block like an Energy Cube. It can connect to Cables, Pipes, or the output of any power producing machine.

To learn how to set up your first network, check the next quest!

quests.title: The Flux Networks UI
quests.description:
Right clicking a functional Flux Network block will give you this UI.

Each Plug or Point can be named, have a custom priority level, and have a custom power transfer limit. This allows complete control over all parts of your system.

Bypass Limit ignores the limit set.

There are several other tabs to check out, mostly for statistics on your network!

{image:atm:textures/questpics/basic_power/flux_ui.png width:125 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: The First Network
quests.subtitle: Becoming a Network Admin!
quests.description:
If you right-click on the Plug, you'll see the Flux Network UI. On the far top-right corner, click on the + button to create your first network. You'll need to set a password to create the network, but you can also set a color!

From here, you can go to the Network Selection tab to activate your network on the Plug. If the Plug is attached to a power source, you can now harness that power anywhere in your system using a Flux Point!

Pro Tip: You can create multiple networks if you want to have different power sources powering different parts of your systems!

quests.title: Industrial Foregoing: Mycelial Reactor
quests.subtitle: It's not Yourcelial Reactor
quests.description:
The Mycelial Reactor consists of all the Mycelial Generators working at the same time, near the reactor block, and it produces a total of 25MFE/t.

All sounds good, but you need to automate some stuff to get it working, see what each Mycelial Generator consumes to work, and automate it, most things are simple, but others, not that much... looking at Disenchanting Mycelial Generator.

But after you get it all automated, you don't need to stop at one, you can make more reactors.

quests.title: Mekanism: Fusion Reactor
quests.subtitle: Fusion Activate!
quests.description: Mekanism has an end game power option that is tough to beat. The Fusion Reactor can produce up to 80MRF/t, and if you want to learn how to build it, make sure to check out the Mekanism: Reactors quest chapter!

quests.title: Accessing Network Power
quests.description: With our Plug set up, we can now tap into the power from our network. The Flux Point does exactly that. It points the power from your network to whatever block it is attached to, including Pipes or Cables, or just directly on machines!\n\nOnce you've placed your Point on the machine or block you want to power, right-click on it and select your network in the "Network Selection" tab. Just like the Plug, you can adjust how much power the Point pulls, priority level, etc.

quests.title: Flux Storage
quests.subtitle: Storing Power
quests.description: Flux Networks does provide a way to store the power you generate for your network!\n\nThese hold massive amounts of power overall, and can be upgraded to store even more!

quests.title: Wireless Charging
quests.description:
Flux Networks also provides a way to charge your items wirelessly, even across dimensions!

Once you have a Plug attached to your power system, you'll want to make the Flux Controller and place it down.

Right-click on it to bring up the interface, and go to the "Wireless Charging" tab. From there, you can select each section of your inventory you'd like to keep charged. To activate, make sure to hit the toggle button at the bottom to enable Wireless Charging, then click apply!

{image:atm:textures/questpics/basic_power/wireless_ui.png width:125 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: The Turbine
quests.description:
Instead of building the smallest Turbine at this point, it's better to build a Turbine based off of the design of your Reactor.

For starters, you want to build a Turbine that can handle the Vapor Production Rate of your reactor. To get the most power out of it, it'll need to maintain either 900RPM or 1800RPM as well. This takes a lot of experimenting with different coils, # of blades, and overall size of the Turbine!

Note: To complete this quest, you'll need to create a Task Screen of any size. Once placed, you can right-click the screen and select this quest as the requirement, then output power into the task screen block to fill it up and complete the quest.

quests.title: Creating The Turbine Shaft
quests.description:
To get a Turbine spinning, we'll need these required components:

- Rotor Bearings are placed at one end of the shaft of the turbine. This can be on any face, but dictates where the shaft extrude from. This is typically placed in the center of the bottom face.

- Rotor Shafts extend from one Rotor Bearing to the opposite side of the turbine, all the way to a single Turbine Housing block, creating the shaft for the Turbine.

- Rotor Blades make the rotor spin. These are placed onto the Rotor Shafts and can be multiple blocks in length. Each Blade can handle a certain amount of vapor, and determines how many are needed based on your reactor's production rates.

Here is an example of a Vertical Shaft setup for a Turbine, with the Turbine Coil of Lead on the top.

{image:atm:textures/questpics/extremereactors/maxbasicturbine.png width:100 height:150 align:1}

quests.title: 19DE6EBEA8219E8E
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Turbine Ports
quests.description:
To interact with our Turbine, we'll need several Ports.
