The Ritual of the Forest can be done by creating a multiblock structure using 8 Wooden Stands, 16 Gold Powder and either an Oak or a Jungle Sapling, depending on the recipe.\n\nTo start a ritual place the items needed for the recipe on the Wooden Stands and Grow the Sapling needed in the middle. The Gold Powder is consumed in the recipe, so you'll need a lot.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/natures_aura/forest_ritual.png width:295 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Token of Joy
quests.description: The Token of Joy is the first Token you should craft, tokens are important crafting materials for items in Nature's Aura.

quests.title: Natural Alter
quests.description:
The Natural Altar is a multiblock structure made from 1 Natural Altar, 20 Planks, 16 Stone Bricks, 8 Golden Stone Bricks and 4 Chiseled Stone Bricks.

The Natural Altar will use up aura for each recipe and is needed to continue progressing in the mod.

The image to the right of this quest shows the multiblock setup.

quests.title: Bottles of Aura
quests.subtitle: Bottling up Aura
quests.description:
Aura can be bottled up by right-clicking in the air with a Bottle and Cork. Aura takes different forms depending on where it's collected.

In the Overworld it is bottled as Sunlight, in the Nether it's Ghosts and in the End it's Darkness.

If the area you used the Bottle and Cork in has a severe lack of aura, you will get Bottled Vacuum.

quests.title: Aura Creation
quests.subtitle: More Aura!
quests.description: The Canopy Diminisher and the Herbivorous Absorber are both simple and easy ways of generating aura.

quests.title: 3C2F5AB815A6C949
quests.description: To make an Infused Iron Ingot place an Iron Ingot on the Natural Altar.\n\nThis process will be quicker than with Tainted Gold.

quests.title: Tainted Gold
quests.subtitle: Taint that Gold!
quests.description: To make a Tainted Gold Ingot place a Gold Ingot on the Natural Altar.\n\nThis process will take longer than with Infused Iron.

quests.title: 5A0EB2ADEBC7EE2B
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Ender Crates and Oculars
quests.subtitle: Here and There!
quests.description: Ender Crates are Ender Chests that can be used to transport items.\n\nEnder Oculars are handheld versions of Ender Crates.

quests.title: Structure Finders
quests.subtitle: I've got my Eyes on you
quests.description: The Eye of the Pillager, Eye of the Blaze and Eye of the Shulker are each used to locate specific structures.

quests.title: Aura Cache
quests.subtitle: Caching in!
quests.description: The Aura Cache can be used to store Aura!

quests.title: Flowers
quests.subtitle: Offering the gods a Birdbath in a Forest of Flowers
quests.description:
The Offering to the Gods is a multiblock structure made from 1 Offering Table and 36 Flowers. To make an offering you need Spirits of Calling.\n
{image:atm:textures/questpics/natures_aura/offering.png width:295 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Upgraded Tokens
quests.description: Using your Tokens on the Offering Table will upgrade them. These upgraded Tokens will be needed for more advanced crafting recipes.

quests.title: Staff of Riches
quests.description: The Staff of Riches uses aura to highlight all storage containers in a 64 block raidius for about 1 minute.\n\nThis can be very useful if you're looking for loot chests or if you put a chest in a mine somewhere.

quests.title: Aura Trove
quests.subtitle: A Treasure Trove!
quests.description: The Aura Trove is an upgraded version of the Aura Cache.

quests.title: Ingots of the Skies
quests.description: If you use Infused Iron Ingots or Tainted Gold Ingots on the Offering Table you will get Ingots of the Skies.

quests.title: Altar of Birthing
quests.subtitle: Makin' Babies with Magic
quests.description: You can make a large number of vanilla mobs with the Altar of Birthing. Spirits of Birthing are made by breeding animals in areas with large amounts of aura.

quests.title: 34ABEF75AE1E5A0F
quests.subtitle: Netherite Finder
quests.description: The Staff of Ancient Knowledge uses Aura to highlight nearby Ancient Debris.

quests.title: Ingots of the Depths
quests.description: Combining 2 Ingots of the Skies, 2 Tainted Gold Ingots and 1 Netherite Scrap together in a crafting grid will make Ingots of the Depths.

quests.title: 41ABC09C798CA8BE
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

quests.title: 7A1C117CA8FB7C31
quests.description:
This one's unique!

Instead of finding Ores it will find Budding Amethyst blocks!

No more struggling to find Geodes for you good sir!

quests.title: 3C5734448FEC128B
quests.description: The cheapest Divination Rod, the Glass Divination Rod. \n\nIt can find all Ores that a Stone Pickaxe can mine. So Copper, Coal, and Iron. Nothing higher.

quests.title: 7198ED7E97A256A4
quests.description:
The first special crafted Divination Rod is the Abundant Material Rod! 

When you craft the Rod with an Alchemical Sulfur of an Item, the Rod will be attuned to that Item. 

You can see the list for Abundant Materials in the Tags, it's too big for me to read off in Quests.

quests.title: 6C6F4EB5CBE2FBC2
quests.description: The Iron Divination Rod is a slight bit higher, being able to find Ores that an Iron Pickaxe can mine! So Diamonds, Redstone, and Gold.

quests.title: Divination Rods
quests.description:
Divination Rods are our Tools we use to contact the spirits to find certain Items. 

First, you'll need to select the Block or Item by either Shift Right Clicking it with the Rod, or crafting the Rod with its Alchemical Sulfur!

By holding them and holding Right Click the Rod will look for a selected Item. It will make a noise and the Rod will light up for how close the Block or Item is. 

If close enough an orb might appear showing you the way to the Item.

quests.title: 2F0D6267569F740B
quests.description: Common Materials are a step higher and rarer than Abundant. These are mostly Ingots and rarer Mob Drops like Ender Pearls or Rabbit Hide. \n\nAgain you can see the whole list in Tags.

quests.title: 457CAE66B0FA4CCF
quests.description: All Vanilla Ores can be found with the Diamond Divination Rod. Being able to find all plus Netherite!

quests.title: 7119F8C352D057BC
quests.description: Now we're getting to the fun stuff! The Rare items even go up the Elytra! Yeah I would think it's better than Rare but I didn't make this sorting.

quests.title: 4EE482B9D61B5933
quests.description: Of course Vanilla isn't our max, there's much more and much rarer in Modded!

quests.title: 7878F190BC8ADC82
quests.description: The best of the best. From Diamonds, to the Nether Star, to Allthemodium. This Rod finds only the best Items!

quests.title: Creature Salt
quests.description: Currently this can only be crafted from cooking 2 Plant Salts into 1 Creature Salt. \n\nHopefully in newer updates we can kill more living creatures for Salt!

quests.title: Theurgy
quests.description: Theurgy is the art of using Magic for Alchemy! Or in our sense using Machines and Items to make more or different Items! \n\nLot's of the Machines that we need for Theurgy needs Copper so start there!

quests.title: Plant Salt
quests.description: All gifts from Mother Nature... can be mercilessly burned down in an Oven to nothing but Salt! \n\nLogs, Leaves, and Crops can get Toasted into Plant Salts.

quests.title: Wires go here, Wires go there
quests.description: If you need Wires to go either farther or connect to more places, you might need a Connector Node. \n\nSimple as that!

quests.title: Desalination Plant
quests.description:
Salt is important for Incubating Alchemical Sulfurs! 

To get Salt we'll need to cook some Items. Different Items make different Salts though. The Salts have different Tiers with them going higher the rarer they are. 

To cook the Salt out we need to put the Items into the Oven and use a Heat source to Heat it. Then take the Salt out of the Oven!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_oven.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Man you're Hot!
quests.subtitle: Man you're Hot!
quests.description: Some Machines in Theurgy need Heat to get started! Except Theurgy is very jealous with how their Machines get Heat, you can only use these two Machines as Heat sources. \n\n(The Machines that use Heat are: Liquefaction Cauldron, Calcination Oven, Mercury Distiller, and Incubator.)

quests.title: Making Mercury
quests.description:
Mercury is one of the most important materials for Theurgy! 

To get it we'll need to distill some in the Mercury Distiller. Put Items into the Distiller, and give it some Heat! 

Some Items give more Mercury like Diamonds which will give 10 Mercury for 1 Diamond, compared to Stone which needs 10 Stone for 1 Mercury.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_distiller.png width:100 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Mineral Salt
quests.description:
Mineral Salts are made from... well Minerals. 

Everything Mined in some form of Ore can be made into Salt. Raw Ores, Ingots, Gems, all become Mineral Salt! 

Even Unobtainium can be made into Salt! Just please don't, there's so many better alternatives.

quests.title: Item Movement
quests.description:
You can transfer Items using Mercury. 
Attach an Item Extrator to where you want Items to be taken from. Then attach the Item Inserter to where you want Items to go. Connect both with Mercury Wires and the Items should start moving! 

This can be used with Theurgy Machines for automation!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_item.png width:200 height:75 align:center}

quests.title: Fluid Movement
quests.description:
You can also move Fluids from one Tank to another with Mercury. \n\nAttach Fluid Extrator from where you want the Fluid to be taken from, like a Sink. Then put the Fluid Inserter on where you want the Fluid to go, like a Sal Ammoniac Accumulator. Attach both with Wires and it should be moving!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_fluid.png width:200 height:75 align:center}

quests.title: Wireless Heat
quests.subtitle: How?
quests.description:
Don't you hate when you have all this power but no Heating? 

Now you can change that with the Caloric Flux Emitter! Shift Right Click with it to bind it to a Machine. Then place it down and power it to send Heat. 

Can't be set to multiple Machines!

quests.title: Furnace like Heat
quests.description:
Very simple Heat Source. Place under the Machine and feed it Furnace Fuel: Coal, Logs, Dried Kelp Blocks.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_brazier.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Logistics with Mercury
quests.description:
Theurgy has Machines so of course it needs Logistics!

(Check out the Basic Logistics Page to learn more about logistics).

With Mercury you can move Items and Fluids from place to place using Mercury Wires and other Items! Wires are what will actually move the Items.

quests.title: Mercury
quests.subtitle: Venus... no Mercury!
quests.description: Don't eat it! \n\nMercury can be used for 3 different things: Incubation, Power Creation, and Logistics!

quests.title: Mercury Vessel
quests.description:
Like a Thermometer these hold Mercury! \n\nEither Mercury Crystals or Shards it holds Mercury.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_vessel_1.png width:100 height:125 align:center}

quests.title: 2B29E9AB9447E1C6
quests.description:
Now this is a Multiblock Machine! 

To get Items back from Alchemical Sulfur we'll need to Incubate them. This requires The Incubator with all 3 Vessels adjacent to it. The order doesn't matter just as long as they are touching the bottom half. 

Once it has all the Items in the Vessels and Heat it will start Incubating your Items! You'll know it's working when Smoke particles come out from it.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_incubator.png width:200 height:200 align:center}

quests.title: Salt Vessel
quests.description:
This is where the Salt will be held. \n\nThe type of Salt does matter for what you will try and Incubate. If you want to make Unobtainium you'll need Mineral Salt, if you want Wheat you'll need Plant Salt, and so on.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_vessel_2.png width:100 height:125 align:center}

quests.title: Strata Salt
quests.description: Strata is the first and most basic crafted from regular blocks like Stone or Sand or Obsidian. \n\nYou can use 5 Strata Salt to craft Mineral Salt.

quests.title: Making Power with Mercury
quests.description:
Put Mercury in, 
Take Power out. 

MF stands for Mercury Flux not Metal Face or a vulgar phrase to call someone!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_mercuryflux.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 54F0C5C48CFC94D0
quests.description:
With Logistics we need Filtering. There's two different Filters: List and Attribute. 
List Filter you add Items into it and change whether it's whitelist or blacklist, and whether it respects NBT Data or not. 

Attribute Filter takes a reference Item then Filters off a selected Attribute. This includes tags and other things like whether it can be used as Furnace Fuel or can be pathwayed!

quests.title: Of course there's a Wrench
quests.subtitle: I thought this was a magic mod...
quests.description:
Theurgy's Wrench is the Mercurial Wand. You can Shift and Scroll to change its Modes. 

You can Enable/Disable to basically stop Wires from transferring. 

You can change the side of where Items will Extract or Insert to. 

And you can change the Frequency Channel!

quests.title: Sulfur Vessel
quests.description:
This is where you will put the Alchemical Sulfur into it. \n\nWhatever Item is in the Alchemical Sulfur will be turned back into that Item from Incubation!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_vessel_3.png width:100 height:125 align:center}

quests.title: Step 1: Source Pedestal
quests.description:
Reformation is changing one Alchemical Sulfur into another or using Alchemical Niter to turn into more! \n\nFirst step is the Source Pedestal, this is where you put the Sulfur that you want to be changed into another.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_reform_1.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Step 3: Result Pedestal
quests.description:
The third step is where the newly changed Sulfur will go, Result Pedestal. Once it's reformed it will go here.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_reform_3.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Digestion Vat
quests.description:
Digestion (very crude form of processing) is how we change Alchemical Niters to different forms. 

First we'll need Purified Gold which can be made from putting Gold, Alchemical Salt, and Water into the Digestion Vat and Shift Right Click to close it like the Fermentation Vat. 

Then we can either combine 4 of one Alchemical Niter with Purified Gold and Sal Ammoniac to get a higher Tier or do the reverse for a lower Tier.

quests.title: Easier Fermenting
quests.description: If you want to be cheap with Fermenting Recipes then Fermentation Starter is perfect for you. \n\nVery cheap replacement for other Items in Fermenting.

quests.title: Fermentation Vat
quests.description:
Fermentation: 
The chemical process by which molecules such as glucose are broken down anaerobically. 

AKA Water and time change thing! 

To use the Fermentation Vat put the Items and Fluid into the Vat then Shift Right Click to close it. 

After awhile it should ferment! This is how we turn Alchemical Sulfur into Alchemical Niter which can be turned into more Items!

quests.title: Alchemical Sulfurs
quests.description:
Alchemical Sulfurs can be made from practically anything and can be made into practically anything! 

There's a few different groups of Items in Alchemical Sulfurs which might be explained more in another Quest. 

There's 3 different paths you can take with processing Alchemical Sulfurs. 1. Fermentation and Digestion for making Niter. 2. Incubation for making those Items again and 3. Changing the Item with Reformation.

quests.title: Step 2: Target Pedestal
quests.description:
The second step is the Target Pedestal. This is where you put the Sulfur that you want the first one to be made into. \n\nOr where you put the Alchemical Niter.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_reform_2.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Step 4: Powering it
quests.description:
Reformation takes Mercury Flux to work! You'll need to Shift Right Click all 3 Pedestals with the Sulfuric Flux Emitter to set them. Then place down the Emitter and feed it power.\n\nAfter that it should be ready to Reform!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_reform_setup.png width:200 height:50 align:center}

quests.title: Making Alchemical Sulfur
quests.description:
Now we finally get to the Meat of the Mod, Alchemical Sulfurs! 

To make them we'll need a Liquefaction Cauldron, an Item, Sal Ammoniac, and a Heater. 

Heat is explained in another Quest but you'll need either the Pyromantic Brazier or the Caloric Flux Emitter beneath the Cauldron to Heat it. 

Then the Liquid Sal Ammoniac in it. 

And finally the Item you want to be turned into an Alchemical Sulfur. 

You'll know it's working when it's bubbling.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_lique.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Making Sal Ammoniac
quests.description:
We'll need these two Blocks to make Sal Ammoniac (felt like calling it a Multi-block but I don't consider 2 Blocks a Multi-Block). A Sal Ammoniac Tank on the bottom with a Sal Ammoniac Accumulator on top of it. \n\nThe Sal Ammoniac Accumulator is where Water and Crystals will go; it can hold 10,000mb of Water or 10 Buckets, and a stack of Sal Ammoniac Crystals. The Tank will hold the created Sal Ammoniac and can hold 2,000mb or 2 Buckets.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/theurgy/theurgy_sal_front.png width:100 height:200 align:center}

quests.title: Sal Ammoniac
quests.description: Sal Ammoniac is a critical part of Alchemical Sulfur which is what we will use to make and reproduce Items. \n\nTo get Sal Ammoniac we'll need some Water.

quests.title: Why Machines?
quests.subtitle: Why do we need Machines if we can just Mine it?
quests.description:
You can Mine Sal Ammoniac Crystals in the Overworld but it isn't that easy. We'll still need Water and the Machines to make Sal Ammoniac to make Alchemical Sulfur. 

The Crystals are optional but help a ton; with just Water 1000mb will be turned into 100mb of Sal Ammoniac. With 1000mb of Water and a Sal Ammoniac Crystal we'll instead get 1000mb of Sal Ammoniac. 

10 times the production with only a single Item more!

quests.description:

quests.title: Tools of the Trade: Divination Rod
quests.subtitle: Hunting for Otherworld Materials
quests.description:
While you can get most of the Otherworld materials using Spiritfire, you can also use Divination Rods to locate these materials.
First, you'll need to attune the Rod to the material you are looking for. For example, if you are on the hunt for Otherstone, you can use the Rod on Andesite to help locate the Otherstone in the world.
Once attuned to a material, you can hold right click with the Rod in hand, and a particle will shoot off in the direction of the nearest material it is attuned to.
You will still need to be under the effects of the Third Eye to be able to harvest the Otherworld block.

quests.title: Familiars
quests.description:
Occultism provides more than just Demons to crush your ores!
There are Demons that can move stuff for you, chop down wood, and more!!
There are also ways to summon cool friends known as Familiars that give special buffs and even fight for you! Make sure to check out the Familiar Rituals in your guide book!

quests.title: Little Book o' Demons
quests.description:
The Dictionary Of Spirits serves as the Guide Book for Occultism. You'll absolutely need to make this if you want to continue with the mod!
The Dictionary has a quest-style guide inside of it if you'd rather read it instead of doing these quests!
You'll also need the book to craft several things in the pack, so you kind of have to make it. :)

quests.title: Dreaming of Demons
quests.description:
Welcome to Occultism!

This mod aimes to help the player in many different ways by enlisting the help of Demons Spirits! Don't worry, most of them are friendly. Most.

To get started, you'll need to get some Demon's Fruit Seeds.

quests.title: The Flames of The Otherworld
quests.description:
What if I told you that the Demon's Fruit is flammable?
Throwing our Demon's Dream Fruit down and setting it on fire will create Spiritfire. This is how we'll convert some overworld items into Otherworld materials.
It's also pretty.

quests.title: Spiritfire Conversions
quests.description:
Using Spiritfire, we can convert several Overworld mats into their Otherworld variants. You can also find several Otherworld mats by going under the effects of the Third Eye and adventuring into the world. You might be surprised what you find. To make it easier, there are crafting recipes for the basic materials by throwing them into Spiritfire.
Andesite converts to Otherstone, which can be used to light a permanent Spiritfire.
Oak Saplings convert to Oak Saplings but they are not the same. When grown, these will look exactly like a regular Oak tree. However, under the effects of the Third Eye, you will be able to harvest the Otherworld variant.
If you have trouble collecting the logs (if they turn into regular Oak Logs even with Third Eye), try collecting them from the top.
Diamonds will turn into Spirit Attuned Gems which are used in several recipes we'll need later on.

quests.title: The Basics of Rituals
quests.description:
This is the main source of information on Rituals. Here's the basics:
Tiers of Rituals:
Rituals have (basically) four tiers based on how powerful the Demon that you're invoking is. The first tier is Foliot, then Dijini, Afrit, and Marid. Some rituals fall into in-between tiers, such as the Unbound Afrit tier.
Types of Rituals:
There are five main types of rituals, but we'll only need four for progression. The main three are Summoning Rituals, Possession Rituals, and Infusion Rituals. Each one will be explained the first time that they appear in these quests. The fourth type of ritual is a sort of Demon-less Ritual, meaning that it uses bits and pieces from all three types to preform a special action without the direct usage of a Demon.
The fifth type, Familiar Rituals, are not needed for progression. But they can still be summon some useful friends to help you out!
Chalks:
There are two types of Chalks: Foundation Chalks, and Colored Chalks.
Foundation chalks are used in every single ritual, and each tier higher gets a shade darker, starting with White Chalk and ending with Black Chalk.
Colored Chalks are the most commonly used, but the color of the Chalk doesn't directly corelate to its power the same as Foundation Chalks.
task_titles: Yes, I've read this and totally won't forget it!

quests.title: Empty Soul Gem
quests.description: This item is used to capture mobs for transport or storage. It's also needed for the ATM Star.

quests.title: The Otherworld Pickaxe
quests.description:
Once you've gathered a few Raw Iesnium Ores, you'll probably want to use the first few ingots to make an Iesnium Pickaxe. This not only mines Iesnium like the Infused Pickaxe, but lasts a lot longer too.
Do yourself a favor and make one of these!

quests.title: Demon Mining
quests.description:
With our ability to harvest Iesnium, we can call upon the Demons to do our bidding in the mines... I mean.... help us gather ores. Definitely not exploiting Demons or anything.

For this, we'll need to create a Dimensional Mineshaft to access the Demon Mining World. You'll also need a Mining Demon confined to a lamp, which you'll place inside of the Mineshaft for it to work. While any tier will complete this quest, higher tiers work faster and have a higher chance at mining Iesnium for you.

The Mineshafts do not auto-export on their own. You will need to extract the items out using either Hoppers, Transporting Demons, or some other method like Item Pipes. It will void any items over its storage limit.

quests.title: Demon Fruit
quests.subtitle: Get Ready for a Trip
quests.description:
Demon's Dream Fruit is perfectly healthy for you. There might be some side effects you should know about.
When you consume one, you have a chance to get the effect of the Third Eye, allowing you to see into the The Otherworld. Certain items in the world might not be what they seem, and you'll need this "vision" to find certain items for progression.
Or you can set it on fire and skip finding most of them. That's up to you.

quests.title: Iesnium: Ore of the Otherworld
quests.description:
The next step in your journey will be to find Iesnium Ore in the Nether.
Without the effects of the Third Eye, this will look just like Netherrack. Make sure to have your Otherworld Goggles equipped!
To locate the ore, try using a Divination Rod. You'll need to attune it to Netherrack first, then hold down right click to use it. After a few seconds, you will see a particle shoot out in the direction of the nearest Iesnium Ore. You can only mine the ore using the Infused Pickaxe!
Since you can't break this ore down into double the dusts using the standard methods, try using your Foliot Crusher to double your ingots per raw ore!
Note: If you don't see the particle, make sure your particle settings are turned on!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/occultism/iesniumexample.png width:200 height:175 align:1}

quests.title: Tools of the Trade: Infused Pickaxe
quests.description:
Most of the items we've needed from the Otherworld so far just needed some Spiritfire. However, we will need to use the help of the Third Eye to find the Ore of the Otherworld.
We'll also need a special pickaxe to be able to mine it. For this, we'll need to Infuse a Demon into a Spirit Attuned Pickaxe Head to create a pickaxe that can break this new kind of ore.

quests.title: Tools of the Trade: Spectral Goggles
quests.subtitle: Quit eating that fruit!
quests.description:
There are more Otherworld items you will need to gather, and eating Demon's Dream Fruit every time you need the Third Eye effect gets annoying.
This is what the Otherworld Goggles are for! When equipped (even in your Curios slot), it gives the Third Eye effect!

quests.title: Iesnium Ritual Bowl
quests.subtitle: Super-speed Rituals!
quests.description:
As you've probably noticed, rituals tend to be... a little slow. But not anymore! Using Sevira's Permanent Confinement, you can create the Iesnium Ritual Bowl.
When using this in place of a Golden Ritual Bowl, it greatly reduces how long it takes to perform a ritual, taking it down to one fourth of its original time!

quests.title: 1BDB369FD243D4C6
quests.description:
Arguably the most useful item that you can create in Occultism, the Iesnium Anvil is a super-powerful version of the Vanilla Anvil.
Created using Uphyxes' Inverted Tower, it:
- Is unbreakable.
- Increases the maximum level of all enchants for anything combined on it by one level.
- Costs half as much xp as the estimate says (rounded down, so if it says 25, it'll cost 12).
- Has a smaller experience requirement increase for repeated edits on the same item.
- Increases the maximum xp level at which you can edit items (the point at which it says "Too Expensive!").

quests.title: Magenta Chalk
quests.description: To create Dragonyst Dust, you'll need to perform Uphyxes' Inverted Tower. However, to create Magenta Chalk, you'll also need some materials that you can only get through the Marid Crusher.

quests.title: Trinity Gem
quests.description: Using Ronaza's Contact, you can upgrade your Soul Gem to create a Trinity Gem. It's basically just a beefed up version of the Soul Gem that can capture larger enemies, although it still can't contain most bosses.

quests.title: Chalk Repair
quests.subtitle: You break it, we Demons fix it!
quests.description:
If you haven't noticed already, making and re-making rituals over and over again is very taxing on the durability of your Chalks.
If you're worried about your Chalk breaking, but don't feel like doing the entire ritual to create a new chalk over again, then this ritual is for you!
Using the power of a Dijinni, you can repair any color of Chalk to it's maximum!
Alternatively, you could use something like the Eternal Stella from the Forbidden Arcanus mod to permenantly preserve your Chalks!

quests.title: Tools of the Trade: Ritual Satchel
quests.subtitle: Pocket Ritual!
quests.description:
Tired of lugging around Chalks, Candles, Skulls, and Crystals? Just make a Ritual Satchel!
By sneak + right-clicking with the Ritual Satchel in your hand, you can fill it with all the materials you need to draw a ritual circle.
Once you've loaded up the Satchel, simply right-click any preview block to begin (slowly) automatically placing all the runes for the selected ritual.
If a piece of chalk inside the bag falls under 40% durability, the enchantment glint on this item will dissapear to signal that it may be time to repair or replace some of your Chalks.

quests.title: Tools of the Trade: Butcher's Knife
quests.subtitle: Hack and slash!

quests.title: Tools of the Trade: Artisanal Ritual Satchel
quests.description:
The Ritual Satchel is nice, but it takes a long time to place all the blocks. Now that you can perform the Sevira's Permenant Confinement ritual, you can create the Artisanal Ritual Satchel!
The Artisanal Ritual Satchel functions nearly identically to the regular Ritual Satchel, except it instantly places all the nessecary items for the ritual, and has the added ability to right-click on Golden Bowl to erase all the Chalk Runes and collect all the other items (Skulls, Candles, and Crystals) and return them to the Satchel.
No, it doesn't restore the durability of the Chalk.

quests.title: Repairing Items
quests.subtitle: Free(ish) durability!
quests.description:
Similar to the Chalk Repairing function of Strigeor's Higher Binding, Sevira's Permanent Confinement can be used to repair items using the power of an Afrit Demon.
This ritual can repair just about anything, so Demon Miners, tools, and armor can all be restored to their original durability!
All items that are repaired using this ritual retain their original properties (affixes, enchantments, etc), so don't worry about your precious enchantments!

quests.title: Gray Chalk
quests.description: Using Strigeor's Higher Binding, you can create Gray Paste. Smear this on a piece of Impure White Chalk to create Gray Chalk.

quests.title: Uphyxes' Inverted Tower
quests.subtitle: Maximum Infusion
quests.description:
Uphyxes' Inverted Tower is the maximum tier of Infusion Rituals. It doesn't have as many uses as the other three tiers, but it's still nessecary for the "endgame" of Occultism.
Mainly, it's used to create Dragonyst Dust, which is the main ingredient for Magenta Chalk.

quests.title: Preparing for a Ritual: Candles
quests.description:
Demons like Candles. I think.

For almost every Ritual to summon our friends, you'll need some Candles. You can create the Butcher Knife and kill some pigs, cows, sheep, horses, or even the Trader Llamas to get some Tallow to make them. Matter of fact, you should definitely find the Trader Llamas. I hear they make good candles. I totally didn't just make that up.

Otherwise, Vanilla Candles can also work!

Spirit Attuned Crystals are also used in several Rituals, so might as well make some now!

quests.title: Books of Binding
quests.description:
For us to specify which Demon Friend we want to summon, we'll need to make a specific Book of Binding.\n\nTo make this, you'll need to purify some Black Dye in Spiritfire to get Purified Ink. With this, we're going to make our first Book of Binding which will summon a Foliot Demon.
Alternatively, you can make an Empty Book of Binding, which can be dyed later to fit whatever tier of ritual you need.

quests.title: Strigeor's Higher Binding
quests.subtitle: The "Everything" Ritual
quests.description: Strigeor's Higher Binding is the second tier of Infusion Rituals. It's used for many different things, but the main things we'll need are the Infused Pickaxe and Gray Paste.

quests.title: Kandar's Opened Conjure
quests.subtitle: Hot Demons!
quests.description:
No, not that kind.
Afrit Demons are Demons of Fire. They are more advanced Demons, which some are friends and some are... not. It all depends on how strongly the ritual can control the Afrit.
Because we don't have access to Red Chalk yet, all we can summon is an Unbound Demon, meaning it cannot be controlled and will be violent.

quests.title: Our First Ritual
quests.subtitle: Aviar's Circle
quests.description:
The first type of ritual we'll be performing is the Summoning Ritual. These rituals are used to summon different types of useful Demons to assist you in crushing, smelting, and more as you get to higher tiers of rituals.
For our first ritual, we want to summon a Foliot Crusher Demon. This Demon will crush items for us, which is something we'll need to make some of the higher level Chalks!
To start with, combine your Unbound Book with your Dictionary of Spirits in a crafting grid. This will bind a Demon to the Book, which is what we'll need for the ritual.
Speaking about your Dictionary of Spirits, it's time to open it up! On the left, click on the Pentacles tab and click on Aviar's Circle. You might have to advance through it by reading a little bit. There is also a way to click \"Mark All As Read\" so it unlocks everything in the Book.
This is what we're going to use to summon our new friend. On the right side, you can click the eye in the bottom-left corner of the image to build an outline of the ritual for you in the world. This is super helpful!
Once you've completed the multi-block ritual, place down 4 (or more for future rituals) Sacrificial Bowls anywhere within 8 block horizontal radius from the center Sacrificial Bowl and use the required items on them. Once you place your Bound Book in the Golden Sacrificial Bowl, the ritual will start!
This is what the ritual will look like.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/occultism/aviarcirclenew.png width:200 height:200 align:1}

quests.title: Foreword on Pentacles
quests.description:
Before we proceed with Occultism, it's time we learn about upgrading each type of Pentacle. Each pentacle builds off of the previous of that type.

This means that rather than building separate Pentacles for each tier of Ritual (I.E. a separate pentacle for summoning Djinnis and for summoning Foliots), you can have one pentacle handle multiple tiers of Rituals. For example, Fatma's Incentivized Attraction builds off of all previous Summoning pentacles.

Because of this, I suggest setting up 4 19x19 areas for each Pentacle. One for Summoning, one for Infusion, one for Possession, one for the Miscellaneous rituals (Wild and Eldritch).

quests.title: Chalking It Up
quests.description: Now that we have a Foliot Crusher, we can use politely ask it to crush down some End Stone, Obsidian and Calcite for us. We'll use these to make some new Chalk!

quests.title: Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion
quests.subtitle: Put some Demon Dust™ on it!
quests.description:
Our next step is a foray into Infusion Rituals. These rituals are used to imbue items with the magic of demons.
The first tier of Infusion Rituals is Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion. We'll be using this ritual to create several items that you'll need throughout this mod.
It is recommended to create this ritual in a separate area from your first one, because the three main types of rituals build off each previous tier.

quests.title: Lime Chalk
quests.description: The first and most important item to make using Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion is the Research Fragment Dust. This is used in combination with some crushed Emeralds to create Lime Chalk!

quests.title: Red Chalk
quests.subtitle: R.I.P. Betsy
quests.description:
If we want to collect all of the Chalks, we'll need to summon and kill aa not-so friendly Afrit.
Even though this isn't a Possession Ritual, you'll need a live sacrifice for this ritual. In this instance, we'll be sacrificing a Cow. Sorry Betsy!

quests.title: Sevira's Permanent Confinement
quests.subtitle: The "Even More Everything" Ritual
quests.description:
Sevira's Permanent Confinement is the third tier of Infusion Rituals. It's mainly used to create the next level of foundation Chalk, Black Chalk.
It's also used to create a couple of items that can speed up ritual making and performing by a significant amount.

quests.title: Black Chalk
quests.description: Using Sevira's Permanent Confinement, we can combine several different Wither materials and some Netherite to create three Witherite Dust. With these, we can create ourselfs the highest form of Foundation Chalk, Black Chalk.

quests.title: Tibira's Attraction
quests.subtitle: Is it a Bird? Is it a Plane? No, it's an unbound Marid!
quests.description:
Don't worry, this is the last of the Abras series of rituals. It is used to summon a Marid demon, but even though it uses Red Chalk, it's not powerful enough to bind the Demon. This means that, unfortunately, you're going to have to fight it.
This ritual uses a Trident as a sacrifice, which is confusing because most sacrifices are living creatures. So instead of killing a mob on top of the completed ritual circle, you simply throw the Trident at the center bowl to start the ritual.

quests.title: Blue Chalk
quests.description: After you've successfully slain the Unbound Marid Demon that you summoned with Tibira's Attraction, you can use the Marid Essence that it drops to craft the "highest" colored Chalk, Blue Chalk.

quests.title: Xeovrenth Adjure
quests.subtitle: Maximum Possession
quests.description: Xeovrenth Adjure is the maximum tier of Possession Rituals. It only has two uses: creating Cruelty Essence, the main ingredient in Brown Chalk, and creating an Iesnium Golem, which is basically just an Iron Golem that's immortal and does more damage.

quests.title: Brown Chalk
quests.description: After slaying the Goat of Mercy summoned from Xeovrenth Adjure, you'll find yourself one Cruelty Essence richer. Combine this with some Cocao Beans to create Brown Chalk.

quests.title: Ronaza's Contact
quests.subtitle: With this sacred treasure I summon...
quests.description:
Once you've gathered every single colored Chalk and Foundation Chalk, you can perform the second Demon-less type ritual, Ronaza's Contact. This is the ultimate ritual, using everything you've learned so far!
It has limited uses, but everything created with this ritual is super powerful!

quests.title: &zRainbow Chalk
quests.description:
Grab your chalks, draw your Ronaza's Contact ritual, and get ready to create the ULTIMATE CHALK!
Instead of having to lug around a full set of 16 chalks, you can use the Rainbow Chalk to paint a color-changing Rune that counts as any of them!

quests.title: 54378277B8D28B1D
quests.description: An alternative to the Rainbow Chalk, for those who prefer the colors of Foundation Chalk.\n\nHas the same function as the Rainbow Chalk, except all the runes will cycle between Foundation Chalk colors.

quests.title: What's Next?
quests.description:
Now that you've come this far, you may be asking yourself, what's next? Well, there are so many more things to explore in Occultism!
You can see a comprehensive list of every single ritual and item in your Dictionary of Spirits, you could try going through all the rituals' outcomes to see if you can find something that piques your interest!
If you haven't already, you could lay out and decorate four separate ritual areas, one for Summons, one for Possessions, one for Infusions, and one for miscellaneous Rituals (Wild and Eldritch rituals primarily).
There's always new ways to use each and every seemingly mundane feature to maximize your experience with the modpack. Happy ritual crafting!

quests.title: Preparing for a Ritual: Chalk
quests.description:
Before we start enlisting the help of our Demon friends, we will need to create the most important item needed for Rituals: Chalk.

There are several colors of chalk needed, with higher level Rituals requiring several to activate. To start with, White Chalk is the easiest to get.

Start by tossing Otherstone in a furnace, and tossing Otherworld Logs into Spiritfire. With the items you create, you'll be able to make the Impure White Chalk.

To purify any piece of Chalk, simply throw it into Spiritfire to cleanse it. Using the Purified Chalk on the ground will draw demonic pretty symbols on the ground. These are a pain to remove, unless of course, you make yourself the Chalk Brush. Do it, it's worth it.

quests.title: Preparing for a Ritual: Bowls
quests.description:
What is a Demonic Ritual without a Sacrifice! :D

Most of the time, Demons just like items so don't be too afraid yet. However, if you have a favorite Cow, you might need to be worried. Sorry Betsy.

Sacrifical Bowls are used to place items needed for Rituals. These can be placed anywhere within the Ritual, as long as it isn't convering up any of the required Chalk.
For now, you'll only need four, but later on you'll need upwards of ten bowls for each ritual!

The Golden Ritual Bowl is used in the middle of the Ritual to activate it, and also usually needs a Book of Binding for the Ritual in it.

quests.title: Ihagan's Enthrallment
quests.subtitle: Who you gonna call?
quests.description:
With Lime Chalk, it's time to delve into Possesion Rituals. These rituals are slightly different from the others because they all require a live sacrifice, usually small mobs such as Chickens, Bees, Bats, etc. However, as rituals get more complicated, they will require larger and larger sacrifices.
Even if you've placed all of the items needed and the Book of Binding into the Golden Sacrificial Bowl, the Ritual will not begin until you kill the sacrifice on top of the runes.
It is recommended that you make some sort of mob capture item such as an Empty Soul Gem, Jar, Mob Imprisonment Tool, or Quantum Catcher!
The first tier of Possession rituals is Heidryn's Lure, which is only used to get mundane items like Skeleton Skulls and End Stone. Because of this, you can skip straight to the second tier of ritual, Ihagan's Enthrallment.

quests.title: Odus' Open Convocation
quests.subtitle: How... Fleshy...
quests.description:
Odus' Open Convocation is used to bring an Afrit demon into a Pig. Because this ritual is performed without the use of Red Chalk, it's only powerful enough to summon an unbound demon.
In particular, this ritual will create an Afrit-possessed Zombified Piglin, which will drop some Demonic Meat, which is used to craft Pink Chalk
WARNING: YOU MAY HAVE TO DO THIS ONE MULTIPLE TIMES TO GET ENOUGH DEMONIC MEAT.

quests.title: Orange Chalk
quests.description: Using Ihagan's Enthrallment, you can sacrifice an Allay, Bat, Bee, or Parrot to summon a Possessed Bee. Upon defeating one, it will drop Cursed Honey, the main ingredient for making Orange Chalk!

quests.title: Fatma's Incentivized Attraction
quests.subtitle: Maximum Summon
quests.description:
That first Foliot Crusher was cool, but what if I told you that you could summon a demon that gives you 6 dusts per raw ore it crushes?
The Marid Crusher does exactly that. To summon one, you'll need to use Fatma's Incentivized Attraction.

quests.title: Demonic Magical Storage!
quests.description:
You're bound to have too many items playing this modpack. It's just it works, and if you haven't figured out your storage situation yet, Dimensional Storage might just be right for you!
To get started with this magical storage solution, you'll need to craft the Dimensional Storage Actuator and place it down into the world. This acts just like a Shulker Box, meaning if you break it, it won't lose any of the items stored inside.
By default, this has 128 storage slots with each slot holding up to 16 stacks of an item, except for items with NBT data. These will not stack and will take up an entire slot, so make sure to leave those items out!
If you aren't sure what items have NBT data on them, you can always check out the quest "NBT and You" in the Storage questline for more info on NBT!

quests.title: Ophyx' Calling
quests.subtitle: An alternate path for light blue
quests.description: Don't want to get a Marid Crusher for Light Blue Chalk? Then you can settle for a Djinni Crusher instead. Ophyx' Calling is used for summoning Djinnis. This includes a Demonic Wife/Husband. Djinnis are able to crush ores more efficiently than Foliots, but not as efficiently as Afrits or Marids. They're also capable of crushing ice without melting it.

quests.title: Green Chalk
quests.description: Using Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion, we can imbue a myriad of different nature blocks to form some Nature Paste. Combine this Paste with some Impure White Chalk to create Green Chalk.

quests.title: Pink Chalk
quests.description: After fighting through a few Demon Possessed Zombified Piglins summoned by Odus' Open Convocation, you can use the Demonic Meat dropped by them to craft some Pink Chalk.

quests.title: Light Blue Chalk
quests.description: After using either Fatma's Incentivized Attraction to summon a Marid Crusher or Ophyx' Calling to summon a Djinni Crusher, you can turn Ice, Packed Ice, and Blue Ice into their crushed forms, and use these to create Light Blue Chalk.

quests.title: Cyan Chalk
quests.description: With your freshly summoned Marid Crusher, you can break down an Echo Shard and an Iesnium Ingot, which when combined with a Glow Ink Sac creates Cyan Chalk.

quests.title: Eldritch Chalice
quests.description:
With Ronaza's Contact, you can upgrade your Iesnium Ritual Bowl to the Eldritch Chalice. When used in a ritual, reduces the time it takes to complete... entirely.
Yes, the Eldritch Chalice makes it so that all rituals complete instantly!

quests.title: Ars Ocultas: Spirit Jars
quests.subtitle: Spirits can work in Containment Jars
quests.description: You might be wondering: Why is an Ars Nouveau item in the Occultism chapter? That's because we have Ars Ocultas, to bridge the two mods. Particularly, Spirits, like our Foliot Crusher, can work in these jars. You can even pipe items into the jars for the spirits to interact with, and they will output it to adjacent inventories (I found the bottom side of the jar to be the most reliable place they output to). If they cannot output to an inventory, they'll output the items into the world.

quests.title: Remote Access
quests.description:
Want to access your storage remotely? This can be done with either the Stable Wormhole or the Storage Accessor.
To use the Stable Wormhole, shift-click a Storage Actuator to link it. You can then place the Wormhole to act as another storage location.
The Storage Accessor is linked in the same way, but acts as a wireless remote that can even work across dimensions!

quests.title: 4ABACE222E647E2C
quests.subtitle: Source Substitutes Sacrifice
quests.description: The Sacrificial Altar is another tool Ars Ocultas offers, this time, focusing on the automation of Sacrifices.\n\nThis Altar goes under your central bowl, and will allow for Sacrifices to be substituted with Source from a nearby Source Jar, if a Containment Jar containing the would-be sacrifice is also nearby.

quests.title: Osorin's Unbound Calling
quests.subtitle: For the less trial-chamber-inclined of us
quests.description:
Osorin's Unbound Calling is the second tier of Demon-less rituals. The first tier isn't useful for progression at all, it's only used for reviving Familiars and turning Vexes into Allays.
This ritual is used to create a ton of rare-ish blocks, items, and materials that you might not be able to (or it's hard to) get otherwise.

quests.title: Upgrading Our Magical Storage
quests.description:
To upgrade the amount of stacks your magical storage can hold, you'll need to make Storage Stabilizers.
Once made, these must point directly at the Dimensional Matrix part of your Storage Actuator, not the base. These can be up to 5 blocks away, but must have a clear line of sight to the Matrix.
Whenever you want to upgrade to a higher tier Stabilizer, breaking it won't destroy the items inside. However, you will not be able to add any more items to your storage until it is either replaced or upgraded.
Below is an example of a simple setup!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/occultism/storageupgradeexample.png width:200 height:150 align:1}

quests.title: Cross-Over?
quests.description:
Productive Bees? What are you doing here? 

Sometimes along the Hive Walls or Pillars you may find deposits of Combs from Productive Bees! 

Kinda like mining Ores in the Overworld.

quests.title: PHOBIA ALERT
quests.subtitle: Bee careful!
quests.description:
Please reconsider playing with the Bumblezone Mod if you suffer from any of these phobias: 

Melissophobia, Apiphobia, Entomophobia, Arachnophobia, Trypophobia, Acrophobia, Claustrophobia, and Crystallophobia. 

If you suffer from Trypophobia you can use the resource pack added by Bumblezone to help! If it's anything else you're screwed.

quests.title: The Bumblezone!
quests.subtitle: Welcome to the Bumble!
quests.description: The Bumblezone is an Exploration Mod that adds a whole new dimension inside our Beehives. \n\nEver wonder what Bees do in their Hives? Well you can find out by adventuring into it!

quests.title: Escaping
quests.subtitle: Let me outta here!
quests.description:
Once you enter the Bumblezone you might need to return to the Overworld. Like incase you left your Stove on! 

To get out the Bumblezone you can mine either down or up past the Beehive Beeswax in order to enter the Void. 

This Void won't kill you, instead it will teleport you back to where you were in the Overworld!

quests.title: 565EBD340595EAC4
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Ancient Hoops
quests.description:
Ancient Hoops are tall towers made of Ancient Wax. 

On top there can be Hoops with Windy Air flowing through them. 

That's also where you will find Cocoons! 

Looks like a great place to use the Elytra at!

{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_hoops.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Goliath Honey Fountain
quests.description:
Goliath is underestimating this Honey Fountain. Think more massive or huge! 

The Goliath Honey Fountain is a gigantic structure with an Oceans worth of Liquid Honey in it. 

You can even wander within it to find a ton of Honey Crystals and Amethyst.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_goliath.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Mite Fortress
quests.description:
Some of the Queen Bee Quests might seem annoying because there isn't many places to farm Endermites and Silverfish. 

Well there wasn't until recent updates! Welcome to the Mite Fortress! 

In the massive spiky Stone structures you'll find Silverfish galore (plus loot especially within the Obsidian). 

In the middle of the structure, with everything Purple colored, will be Endermites. 

BTW did you know that Bees will attack Endermites and Silverfish! Charge into battle with them to win the heart of their Queen!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_mite.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Honey Compass
quests.description:
The Honey Compass is a very useful tool added by Bumblezone. 

You can craft one or trade for it. 

You can Shift Right Click a Beehive to track that Hive (including Productive Beehives) or Right Click the Air to locate a Cell Maze.

quests.title: Cannon Range
quests.description:
The Crystal Cannon is a very fun and dangerous Weapon added from Bumblezone! 

But like all Cannons, it is best to practice. The Cannon Range is made for that! 

There you will find plenty of Cannons, Crystals, and Targets to hit! Then you can take the rewards for hitting the Target Blocks.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_range.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Honey Fountain
quests.description:
A wonderfully designed Foutain Structure with flowing Honey and Sugar Water.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_fountain.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 2DE2E5A1275E4B20
quests.description:
Can be found in structures in the Bumblezone or traded for with the Bee Queen! 

Bees have quite an interesting way of finding and communicating with each other. I don't know how they do it so I'm just going to guess their Antennas give and receive radio signals. 

While wearing the Stingless Bee Helmet you can Shift to highlight all Bees around you. 

Also while wearing it, poison and nausea will go away quicker.

quests.title: 7C7C0D3D7FCB0297
quests.description:
Can be found in structures in the Bumblezone or traded for with the Bee Queen! 

Bees have quite an interesting way of finding and communicating with each other. I don't know how they do it so I'm just going to guess their Antennas give and receive radio signals. 

While wearing the Stingless Bee Helmet you can Shift to highlight all Bees around you. 

Also while wearing it, poison and nausea will go away quicker.

quests.title: Pollinated Streams
quests.description:
Very simple structure, the Pollinated Streams. They are Sugar Water Aqueducts!\n
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_streams.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ancient Shrine
quests.description:
Another structure made mostly of Ancient Wax. 

This one looks almost like a satellite dish! Full of Pollen so careful those with allergies. 

In the middle you can find a block of Emerald and plenty of Amethyst.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_dish.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Hanging Gardens
Phantasm Aviary
quests.description:
Another floating structure! (I think I'm noticing a pattern here). 

Here you will find tons of Loot in Cocoons and under Glistering Honey Crystals. 

You'll also find tons of Phantoms in here, hence the name! Might want something to prevent fall damage...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_phantasm.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Battle Cubes
quests.description:
Battle Cubes are a dungeon in the Bumblezone! 

Similar to Trial Chambers these have multiple rooms with spawners and obviously Loot! 

In the rooms are Cobwebs and Wool to represent Spider Eggs, within them lies Spider or Cave Spider Spawners and sometimes valuable Loot like Diamond or Emerald Blocks! 

There is also some Honey Cocoons in the last room that can hold some valuable Loot, like a Throne Pillar Compass!

{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_cube.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Cell Maze
quests.description:
One of the biggest structures in Bumblezone which of course means most loot!

There's a ton of different rooms connected in some sort of puzzle design.

If you haven't used the Essence of Bees yet or have Protection of the Hive Effect on, you will get Wrath of the Hive while in the Cell Maze. So feed some Bees!

Also the Throne Pillar Compass will always spawn in this structure.

{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_cell.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Honitel
quests.subtitle: No Vacancy
quests.description:
The Honey Hotel (Honitel) is a big and relatively safe structure, besides fall damage. 

It has dozens of rooms for Bees to stay in. Also in the rooms is plenty of loot for you to take. 

I just hope you can feel guilty for stealing it from these innocent Bees.

{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_honitel.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Dance Floor
quests.description:
"The Vengabus is coming
And everybody's jumping
New York to San Francisco
An intercity disco
The wheels of steel are turning
And traffic lights are burning
So if you like to party
Get on and move your body".

{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_dance.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Honey Slime Ranch
quests.subtitle: A "Slime Rancher"
quests.description:
Here you can find the home of a Slime Rancher just making a living... wait what? How did a Villager get here?\n
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_ranch.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 5F834F8C607A8B77
quests.description:
You have to either find these in structures in the Bumblezone or you can trade with the Bee Queen to get one! 

While wearing it you can hold Space Bar to fly for a little. 

Except like a Bee the Wings are too small to keep your fat little body off the ground.

quests.title: 78B7FC6A868F5C4D
quests.description:
You have to either find these in structures in the Bumblezone or you can trade with the Bee Queen to get one! 

While wearing it you can hold Space Bar to fly for a little. 

Except like a Bee the Wings are too small to keep your fat little body off the ground.

quests.title: Bee House
quests.description:
It's a house shaped like a Bee! 

A Bee House! 

It has some very simple loot, Honey, and sometimes a Bee resident!

{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_house.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Hive Temple
quests.description:
Hive within a Hive, Hive-ception.\n
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_shrine.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Stinger Spear Shrine
quests.description:
The perfect place for all Bee Warriors! \n\nHere you can grab a Stinger Spear and enchants for it!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_stingy.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 67A0F6661D658A52
quests.description: This can be found in any of the 3 previous Quests but will always spawn in the Cell Maze. \n\nIt will point you to the closest Throne Pillar. Follow that compass!

quests.title: 6C5D61A704DC125A
quests.description:
This ones a funny one; you can either find it, craft it, or trade for it.

Then you can dye it whatever color you want and of course wear it on your Head!

The Bees will then think that you are a Flower and will follow you.

It also makes you look like Daffy from "Duck Amuck".
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_duckamuck.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Pollinated Pillars
quests.description:
Pollinated Pillars are what connect Pollinated Fields to the Hive Walls. \nThey are a good mix of both! Huge steep walls of Honey while being layered with Pollen!\n
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_pollenpillar.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Pollinated Fields
quests.description:
Pollinated Fields are... ACHEW... like the Plains Biome but full of Pollen! ACHEW... Pollen places like layered Snow, it... ACHEW... stacks on top of other Pollen and falls with Gravity... ACHEW. It will slow you down when walking through it, similar to... ACHEW... Powdered Snow.\n
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_pollenfields.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Gazebuzz Cluster
quests.description:
The Gazebuzz Cluster is a cluster of dozens and dozens of hanging, disconnected rooms. 

I couldn't list off everything in the rooms or I'd be typing all day! But I can summarize: there's rooms with Honey, Leaves, Loot, and even fun traps! 

You should probably be careful with those then, especially with Honey and Paintings...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_cluster.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ice Monolith
quests.description:
A very simple structure, some Bees and other stuff got frozen into a popsicle.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_ice.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 2B857941D7BBA0B8
quests.description:
Can be found in structures in the Bumblezone or traded for with the Bee Queen! 

Ever hate getting stuck on Honey Blocks? Or even when Pollen slows you down? Well there's no need to fear for the Honey Bee Leggings are here! They will help you move better through those Blocks. The more Bee Armor you wear, the easier travel will bee! 

Also you can Shift through Pollen to collect it!

quests.title: 78E40BDB0E54B638
quests.description:
Can be found in structures in the Bumblezone or traded for with the Bee Queen! 

Ever hate getting stuck on Honey Blocks? Or even when Pollen slows you down? Well there's no need to fear for the Honey Bee Leggings are here! They will help you move better through those Blocks. The more Bee Armor you wear, the easier travel will bee! 

Also you can Shift through Pollen to collect it!

quests.title: Candle Parkour
quests.description:
Jump on and over the Candles to reach the top! 

Once up there you can find some Honey Cocoons. 

Don't burn your feet.

{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_candle.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Honey Cave Room
quests.description:
Deep within the Hive Walls you may find a Honey Cave! 

Here you can find Honey Fluid, Honey Crystals, Brood Blocks, and even Beehemoths! 

Everything Honey related.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_cave.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Subway
quests.description:
A bunch of colorful tubes perfect for transporting Bees or you! \n\nThe Windy Air will take you anywhere in the Subways, even to rooms full of loot!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_subway.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Throne Pillar
quests.description:
The Throne Pillar looks similar to a Hive Pillar but this one is well decorated with Crystals, Webs, and Honeycombs in eloquent designs. \n\nIn the middle of the Pillar is the Throne Room where you will meet...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_throne.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 72489FB9D9A5A24B
quests.description:
Can be found in structures in the Bumblezone or traded for with the Bee Queen! 

These Carpenter Bee Boots truly are incredible, you can wall-run or jump farther off of Wood Planks, Leaves, and Honey Blocks. 

Also while holding Shift the Boots will Mine the Block beneath you.

quests.title: 7208CB011F6E2ACF
quests.description:
Can be found in structures in the Bumblezone or traded for with the Bee Queen! 

These Carpenter Bee Boots truly are incredible, you can wall-run or jump farther off of Wood Planks, Leaves, and Honey Blocks. 

Also while holding Shift the Boots will Mine the Block beneath you.

quests.title: Floaters
quests.description:
Floaters aren't technically structures in Minecraft files wise but still are in layman terms. 

They can appear in any Biome but always and abundtly in Howling Constructs! 

They are floating disc shaped structures made of Ancient Wax. If you haven't used the Essense of Bees yet you will get Weakness, Slowness, and Mining Fatigue when touching Ancient Wax. There's also Honey Cocoons or Crystals on them!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_floaters.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Howling Constructs
quests.description:
Easily the most fascinating Biome in Bumblezone, the Howling Constructs. 

On the ground there is spikes of Infused Sugar Stone, Carvable Wax, and Honey. 

The interesting part is what's not on the ground. There are floating structures all over the Howling Constructs. 

They are made of Ancient Wax which you will learn more of eventually.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_constructs.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Lakes of Sugar! (Water)
quests.description:
The Lakes, Oceans, Ponds, and Rivers of the Bumblezone. 

It probably was originally just Water but all the time it has spent within the Hive it has become Sugar Water. 

These are very helpful for getting out of the Bumblezone as there's a lot less Blocks in this Biome. 

Also Honey Slimes spawn sometimes here.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_sugar.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Pirate Ship
quests.description:
Sailing the 7 Sugar Seas is the dangerous Pirate Ship led by the terrifying Captain. 
On the Lower Deck holds the Navigators. 
Near the Weapons in the Cargo Hold keeps the Quartermaster. 

All over the Ship you can find the Loot from the Pirates many adventures!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_pirates.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Your Highness
quests.description:
Your Highness, the Bee Queen.

An absolute unit of a Bee, so big she can't even move on her own.

Upon meeting her, she will request of you to get a certain Item for her. If you do you'll be granted a special reward.

Also now that you have met her you can trade with her (check JEI for all trades) and you can do her quest desires.

In order to advance in Bumblezone you will need Bee Essence which you get from doing all 16 of her quests.

{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_queen.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Into the Hive
quests.subtitle: Unbeelievable
quests.description:
To get into the Bumblezone you'll first need a Beehive. Normal Beehives and Advanced Beehives it's not picky! 

Then you'll need to either throw an Enderpearl into it or have a Piston push you into it! 

And you'll get into the Hive and enter the Bumblezone!

quests.title: Cherry Veteran Tree
quests.description:
Part of the beautiful Floral Meadow is a Cherry Tree much older and bigger than the rest. \n\nThe Bees have seemed to take a liking to these Trees and have set up mini Hives next to them full of their young!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_cherry.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Floral Meadow
quests.description:
A change in pace for Bumblezone. 

The Floral Meadow has Grass, Cherry Trees, and more Flowers than imaginable. (This reminds me, you should follow Minty Meadow on Twitch). 

Wait if Bees have Flowers in their Hives why do we need to put Flowers outside of it?!?!?!?!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_meadow.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Crystal Canyons
quests.description:
These beautiful Canyons surrounded by Hive Walls are full of... you guessed it! Crystals! \n\nThe floor is made of Carvable Wax while the rest is full of small Honey Crystals and massive Glistering Honey Crystals.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_canyon.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Overgrown Flower
quests.description:
Amongst the massive Glistering Crystals in the Crystal Canyon lies a Crystal in the shape of a Flower. 

It's gorgeous, mesmerizing almost. It makes me want to grow a Garden of beautiful Flowers but I know not one of those Flowers will ever come close to how stunning the Crystal Flower is... 

Regardless you'll find plenty of Honey Crystals, Honey, and most importantly Crystalline Flowers!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_overgrown.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 42CB494F72FA1FD1
quests.description: Craft 6 Beehives or Beenests. This includes Productive Bee's Hives as well!

quests.title: 12EF38830108D02B
quests.description: Kill 32 normal Spiders.

quests.title: 14F6ED7F0C1DC503
quests.description: Drink 8 Bottles of Honey. \n\nThis ones the hardest for me I can't stand the noise of drinking Honey Bottles.

quests.title: 037E0DAA5ECC5AB8
quests.description: Hit 24 different Mobs with Pollen Puffs. \nBees are the most fun to hit with them!

quests.title: 5443AA65C0D0C599
quests.description:
These you can either steal it from the Bee Queen or work for it by helping her. I recommend being respectful to the Queen though, she is royalty! 

When you drink it you will get plenty of amazing Effects plus it will take away some terrible ones. 

It can also be used on Bees and Beehemoths to give them Effects!

quests.title: 04665EFC3A37250E
quests.description: Kill 8 Silverfish.

quests.title: 3365017C9B24C0A9
quests.description: Use Bows or Crossbows to shoot 32 Stingers. \n\nYes, you can do that!

quests.title: 72569275EDE9FA23
quests.description: Breed 6 Honey Slimes together with Sugar.

quests.title: 0F5549B02D1B383B
quests.description: Kill 16 Cave Spiders. \n\nDon't worry there is plenty of things from Bumblezone to help with Poison.

quests.title: 2149833F65D523E5
quests.description:
Similar with the Bee Cannon, the Crystal Cannon can be: Crafted, found in structures, or traded for with the Bee Queen. \n\nThis one is used like a Crossbow, if you have Honey Crystal Shards in your Inventory, Hold Right Click to load a Crystal and let go to shoot it!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_cannon1.png width:75 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: 027EF5C8A74B1596
quests.description:
Bee's main weapons are their Stingers. 

So why don't we use that for our own Weapon! You can make, find, or trade for the Stinger Spear and it works like a Trident. 

Just much weaker and inflicts Poison to Mobs!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_spear.png width:100 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Hive Pillar
quests.description:
Pillars are like Hive Walls just smaller. Simply that.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_hivepillar.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Hive Wall
quests.description:
Hive Walls are the foundation of the Bumblezone. 

They are massive walls of Honey Combs and Wax that go from the floor to the roof. 

They also hold Productive Bee Combs and holes in the Walls where Brood Blocks will spawn.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_hivewall.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Beehemoth
quests.description:
The Beehemoth are unique Bees who are more similar to a Wild Flying Horse. 

They can be tamed via feeding them Liquid Honey either in a Bottle or Bucket. 

They have a friendship level which determines if they are tamed by you and how fast they go and how much health they have! Feeding them will make the level go higher while if they take damage they lower the level. 

Once the friendship level is maxed they'll become a Queen Beehemoth! 

They will follow Honey Buckets like Cows to Wheat, (also try using Royal Jelly with them).
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_beehemoth.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 5219D2F2B13F57F3
quests.description:
One, if not the, most important Item in Bumblezone! The Buzzing Briefcase is the perfect Item for Bee Caretaking. 

You can Right Click a Bee with the Briefcase to capture them in it. Then, you can Shift Right Click with the Briefcase to view the Bees inside. 

It can hold 14 Bees, and any Bees including Productive Bees. 

Here you can view their Health, Name, type of Bee, if it has a Stinger, if it has Pollen, and more! 

You can also use it to release the Bees from it.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_briefcase.png width:200 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Bee Variants
quests.description: Obviously in real life there is much more than just Honey Bees or Bumble Bees, so the Bumblezone adds more Bees and unique Bees! \n\nFrom Redtail Bees, to Blue Bees, to Neopolitan Bees!

quests.title: Honey Slimes
quests.subtitle: No Royal Jelly Slimes?
quests.description:
Unlike most cubic Mobs the Honey Slimes are friendly! 

They can bred with Sugar and they can be... milked? With bottles for Honey Bottles. They will aggro if you milk them though, unless you have the Essence of Bees on. 

On death they will drop Sugar. 

You can find them in some structures, Sugar Lakes, or sometimes from growing Bees in Brood Blocks.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_slime.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 0C9C5639D76FDF65
quests.description:
Save 12 Bees by reattaching their Stinger. 

When a Bees hits a Mob or even you they will lose their Stinger which will give them a Fatal Poison. 

If you Right Click them with a Stinger you can reattach it and save them!

quests.title: 64FEF31955CB158D
quests.description: Hit Flowers with Pollen Puffs to spawn 8 more Flowers.

quests.title: 4646DCF463FD913F
quests.description: Kill the Wither with the Stinger Spear. \n\nTry using the End Exit Portal to help cheese this.

quests.title: 612157986673F815
quests.description: Feed Bees or a Bee anything but Flowers 48 times!

quests.title: 1A67F4F87B3D456C
quests.description:
The Bee Cannon can either be Crafted, found in structures, or traded for with the Bee Queen. 

It's quite simple: Right Click a Bee to load it, and Hold Right Click then let go to fire the Bee! 

They won't get hostile from being shot out don't worry, infact I think they enjoy it.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_cannon2.png width:75 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: 253957D992A88C88
quests.description:
This Shield, like what seems most Items here, can be: found in structures, crafted, or traded with the Bee Queen. 

It works like a Vanilla Shield, hold it in your off-hand and block attacks. 

What makes it different (and better) is that after you repair it with Honey Crystals it will grow stronger.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_shield.png width:100 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Rootmin
27B5D0329DD92126
quests.description:
Soup... made from Bees? Seems kinda inhumane... 

Eating/Drinking this will give you Beenergized Effect for awhile and gives a chance at giving Luck! 

Also a chance at Levitation, Slow Falling, Poison, and Paralized. 

Also while talking about Paralized you can make Paralizing Potions using the Soup.

quests.title: Daycares
quests.description:
On the outside of Hive Walls and Pillars you will find what I call Bee-Daycares.

Here there will be Honey Blocks and Honeycomb Brood Blocks! These spawn with baby Bees at some stage within them.

You can feed it: Sugar Water Bottles, Honey Bottles, or Bee Bread. It has 4 Stages and after the 4th is fed a Baby Bee will spawn out. Sometimes Honey Slimes will spawn as well!

You can take the Empty Brood Block to the Bee Queen to refill it!

When you feed them enough you will get Protection of the Hive. If you take them out you will get Wrath of the Hive.

{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_daycare.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 6BC0904E03683190
quests.description: Breed Bees to get 8 new Bees.

quests.title: 00764A738DA6451C
quests.description: Kill 4 Endermites. \n\nWe're just killing everything now aren't we?

quests.title: 341DF467E3936E78
quests.description: Kill the Ender Dragon while wearing a full set of Bee Armor! \n\nYour name will be remembered for centuries!

quests.title: 54D80939887B3F7D
quests.description: Trade with the Bee Queen 128 times! \n\nGood luck!

quests.title: 6434796EAAF2A4EC
quests.description:
After completing all of these Quests you can Right Click the Queen for the Essence of Bees. 

Eat it! 

Now you can basically do anything here. You can safely take Honey from all Hives, Honeycombs, and Honey Slimes. You can walk through Cell Maze without Wrath of the Hive, you can go into the Throne Pillar without Mining Fatigue, and you can walk over Ancient Wax without the horrible Effects. And when you enter Fluid Honey or Royal Jelly you'll get amazing Effects. 

The best part is that it sticks with you even after Death! Now you can enter the endgame!

quests.title: Yellow Sempiternal Sanctum
White Sempiternal Sanctum
Red Sempiternal Sanctum
Purple Sempiternal Sanctum
Green Sempiternal Sanctum
Blue Sempiternal Sanctum
Essence of Radiance
quests.description:
To use this 1. Have it in your Offhand 2. Have it being Daytime 3. Be exposed to the sky. 

Then you will get Regeneration, Saturation, Speed, Haste, and Resistance. It will also repair your Armor Durability. 

Once used up it will have a 10 Minute cooldown.

quests.title: Essence of Continuity
quests.description:
Think of the Totem of Undying, now think of how it can be super over powered. That's the Essence of Continuity. 

When you're about to take a fatal hit you will be teleported to your Respawn Point with full Health, Hunger, and bad Effects taken away. Saving your life obviously. 

It will also give you a journal describing how and where you would have died. 

After it saved your life it will get a 40 Minute cooldown and will give cooldowns to every other Essence you might have.

quests.title: Essence of Raging
quests.description:
The Essence of Raging when in your Offhand will act like a bounty system. 

It will highlight 4 Mobs and when they are killed you'll get Strength and the more you kill the higher it goes! 

To a max of 16. 

Once used it will have a cooldown of 30 Minutes though.

quests.title: Essence of Knowledge
quests.description:
When in your Offhand you will learn so much knowledge! 

The bottom left will tell you the structure you're in, if you are in one. 

All entities will also be highlighted when it's in use. That includes block entities like Chests or Armor Stands. 

After all of its uses it'll have a 15 Minute cooldown. It has a lot of uses though so you'll be fine!

quests.title: Essence of Life
quests.description:
A very peaceful and helpful Item, hold it in your Offhand to use it. When in your Offhand it will fertilize Crops and Saplings. 

It will also heal Tamed Mobs and Players nearby. 

And will get rid of Poison and Wither from Players and Tamed Mobs. I don't know how your Mobs are getting Withered but we can fix it now! 

After enough Healing or Fertilizing it will have a 10 Minute cooldown.

quests.title: Essence of Calming
quests.description:
When held in your Offhand all Mobs nearby will stop being hostile toward you. 

Whether you're the one who pissed them off or they are just inherently angry, they won't be anymore. 

It has 600 uses at a time and after being used up or interrupted it'll need to wait 10 Minutes in your Inventory to recharge. 

It can be interrupted if you take damage with it active or if you hit a Mob.

quests.title: Potion Candle
quests.description: By crafting a Super Candle with Royal Jelly and a Potion you will make a Potion Candle! \n\nWhen the Candle is lit it will give the Potion Effect to all nearby.

quests.title: Crystalline Flower
quests.description:
A very unique and helpful Block added from Bumblezone which can rarely be found in some Structures, easiest being the Overgrown Flower! 

It's a complicated Block so listen carefully. The Flower is used for Enchanting Books, it has Tiers which will be needed to unlock and use Enchantments. 

To get higher Tiers you will need to Feed the Flower Items or XP. Then you can put a Book or Enchanted Book and select an Enchantment to put on it.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/bumblezone/bumble_flower.png width:175 height:200 align:center}

quests.title: Eye of Abyss
