quests.description: The Eye of Abyss will take you to the Sunken City to fight the Leviathan.

quests.title: Eye of Void
quests.description: The Eye of Void will take you to the Ruined Citadel to fight the Ender Guardian.

quests.title: Eye of Curse
quests.description: The Eye of Curse will lead you to the Frosted Prison to fight the Maledictus.

quests.title: Eye of Flame
quests.description: The Eye of Flame will take you to the Burning Arena to fight the Ignis.

quests.title: Eye see you!
quests.description:
Not all Cataclysm Dungeons are as easy to find as the Cursed Pyramids are. 

So, a specific Eye might help you find them! 

Each of the different Eyes will lead you to its set structure; and don't worry, the Eyes rarely break.

quests.title: Eye of Desert
quests.description: The Eye of Desert will take you to the Cursed Pyramid to fight the Ancient Remnant.

quests.title: Eye of Monstrous
quests.description: The Eye of Monstrous will take you to the Soul BlackSmith to fight the Netherite Monstrousity.

quests.title: Eye of Storm
quests.description: The Eye of Storm will take you to the Acropolis to fight Scylla.

quests.title: Eye of Mech
quests.description: The Eye of Mech will take you to the Ancient Factory to fight The Harbinger.

quests.title: Astrape
quests.description:
With 2 Essence of the Storm and 3 Lacrima we can make Astrape. 

Astrape is a combination of the Weapons used by the Hippocamtus and Cindaria. 

It can stab like a Trident, just with more Damage and Range. Plus you can Hold Right Click to send Lightning Spears, just like Cindaria! 

The Lightning Spears still bounce off Walls! Just now with a Cooldown...

quests.title: Chitin Claw
quests.description:
Here's your Crab Claw from the Mob Vote! 

Just the Crab you need to kill is much bigger... and meaner... 

The Chitin Claw is a Drop from the Clawdian. 

When worn you will get increased Block Reach and Entity Reach. So you can place Blocks farther and smack Mobs farther as well!

quests.title: Ceraunus
quests.description:
Ceraunus is the Anchor Weapon Scylla herself uses! 

With just 2 Essence of the Storm and 3 Lacrima we can Craft it! Just in a different order than you would for Astrape. 

You can swing the Anchor around like a Mace, with a very long delay. Or use it for special attacks! 

Hold Right Click to toss the Anchor in front of you. When it hits a Mob, it will Damage them and hit them back. 

You can also Hold Shift Right Click to instead of throwing the Anchor, you throw Waves in an array in front of you!

quests.title: Scylla
quests.description:
The tippy top of the massive Acropolis is where the Scylla will spawn. Like the Ender Guardian you just need to be near to Spawn here. 

She is one of the smallest Bosses in Cataclsym only being around 3 Blocks Tall. As well as right now, she has 390 Hearts and 12 Armor Points. Don't worry, she'll be Buffed very soon! 

Don't let her Size or lack of ATM10 Buffs let you underestimate her, she has some of the most Attacks of all Bosses here. 

She can use her Anchor, Ceranus, to pull you closer to her from far away, or simply swing it at you to deal a ton of Damage! 

She can toss Lightning Spears at you from her Back or from Clouds. Even leaping into the Air and Jumping back down to bring Lightning Strikes all around where she Hit. 

That's not even it! She also has control over Water allowing her to send Waves at you or even summon Water Snakes to Bite you! 

When slayed, she will Drop the usual Boss Gear, as well as Lacrima and Essence of the Storm.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_scylla.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Void Core
quests.description:
Void Cores are drops from the Ender Golem! 

They are weapons, when you Right Click with them, Void Runes will spawn from the ground. 

Void Runes act like Evoker Fangs, they go in a line for about 10 Blocks in the direction you are using it toward. 

They do about 3 and a half Hearts of damage for each time they hit a Mob. They also knockback Mobs which Evoker Fangs do not. 

This can be used in Crafts for even more Cataclysm Weapons!

quests.title: Tidal Claws
quests.description:
Tidal Claws are a confirmed drop from The Leviathan. 

It has two modes, attack and grapple. Attack is with Left Click, Grapple is with Right Click. 

When you use its attack it will launch the claw and go through max of 5 mobs. Dealing damage and giving Abyssal Curse which will continue to damage them. 

The grapple instead will latch on to whatever is in range and pull you toward it. 

There's no durability so enjoy it forever!

quests.title: Cindaria
quests.description:
Cindaria are Jellyfish/Human Mobs that protect Acropolis. They are Greenish/Purple-ish and transparent. 

They have 60 Hearts with no Armor. 

They also wield what looks like an Umbrella but is actually a deadly Weaon! 

If you are too close, they'll swing their Weapon to Hit you with it. If you are farther, they will Shoot a Lightning Spear at you. 

Lightning Spears bounce off Walls, thankfully the Acropolis doesn't have many of those! 

On Death, the Cindaria will Drop Lacrima.

quests.title: Octohost
quests.description:
The Octohost is actually 2 Mobs working together! To Kill you! 

It has the Symbiocto which controls the Drowned Host. 

Symbiocto has 8 Hearts and no Armor. When on its own, it will just Shoot Ink at you. On Death they will Drop Ink Sacs. 

The Drowned Host acts like a normal Drowned. They have 10 Hearts as well as 2 Armor Points. Drowned Host can Spawn with Armor and Weapons which they can use. 

When together, they will use their Attacks on you at the same time. The Symbiocto will Shoot you with Ink while the Drowned Host will use Weapons or Fists to Hit you.

quests.title: Clawdian
quests.description:
The Clawdian is the miniboss of Acropolis. 

They are huge lobsters who hold an even bigger Axe! 

They have 225 Hearts and 12 Armor Points. 

They like to use their Axe and Feet to Attack you. From swinging their Axe at you to do moderate Damage. To smashing the ground with an Axe to unleash a Shockwave. To stomping on the ground to unleash an even bigger Shockwave and Waves at you! 

If you get too far they'll charge after you, Breaking Blocks in their way! 

If you can Kill one, they'll Drop their Claw! Kinda graphic but thankfully it's just fantasy violence!

quests.title: Gauntlet of Guard
quests.description:
The Gauntlet of the Guard is the drop from the Ender Guardian. 

When you hold it in either Hand, you can Hold Right Click to bring all Mobs near you, even closer! 

You can also smack Mobs with it in your Main Hand to deal Damage. 

Try using the pull mechanic with flying to drop Mobs!

quests.title: Abyssal Egg
quests.description:
The Abyssal Egg is also a drop from The Leviathan, because apparently you killed a pregnant one. 

Place the Egg down, then wait awhile and you'll have your own baby Leviathan. 

Once its hatched you can feed it a ton of Tropical Fish to tame it. 

The baby has 1200 Hearts and can heal by feeding it Tropical Fish. 

Once tamed, like the Modern Remnant it can be set with Shift Right Click to follow or stay or wander.

quests.title: Hippocamtus
quests.description:
Hippocamtus are powerful Sea Horse warriors who guard Acropolis. 

They wear lots of Armor and hold a Spear and Shield. 

They have 85 Hearts and 18 Armor Points. 

Their Shield will protect from Damage and their Spear will be used to Kill you. They can swing, stab, and even do a special move on you. This move will lock you into place where the Hippocamtus will repeatedly stab you. 

Like the Cindaria, these will Drop Lacrima.

quests.title: Urchinkin
quests.description:
Urchinkin are small pests who for some reason live in Acropolis. 

They have 6 Hearts with no Armor. Thankfully pretty weak. 

They have a few Attacks, if they are near you they will Hit you. If there is some distance they will roll at you. When they roll, tons of their Spikes will be shot out, doing Damage to anyone they hit! 

On death they won't Drop anything unique. Besides more Spikes to Damage you, that's all.

quests.title: Void Scatter Arrows
quests.description:
Void Scatter Arrows are Crafted with a Spectral Arrow and a Void Jaw. 

They can be shot by any Bow or Crossbow. When they hit any Mob or Block they will break apart. 

When they break apart, many parts will be thrown around the area, damaging whatever they hit!

quests.title: The Leviathan
quests.description:
The Leviathan is the reason people fear the Ocean. 

She has 6,400 Hearts, sharp teeth, and strong tentacles and is invincible outside of Water. 

She has a huge array of powers she will use against you. She can summon underwater Mines, shoot a Godzilla like Atomic Beam, and even just chomp on you. 

The worst comes from the vortexs though! And I don't mean the ATM Dev! 

She can use her tentacles to break open a Water Vortex which will suck in all Entities nearby as bait for her. She can also summon Lasers from vortexs on the Ocean floor which will shoot upward. 

Once you bring her beneath half Health she will become enraged! When enraged she will use her Lasers much more than before and attack relentlessly until the Oceans only have one being swimming in them.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_leviathan.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Deeplings
quests.description:
The Deeplings are an ancient race of sea monsters who live and guard the Sunken City. They have their own rankings: Anglers, Brutes, Priests, and Warlocks. 

Deeplings are the most basic, only having 13 Hearts and a Coral Spear. 

Deepling Anglers are the next ones, they have 15 Hearts and hold a Fishing Rod with a Lionfish attached. The Lionfish will attack you and give you Poison, they have 6 Hearts. 

Deepling Brutes have 60 Hearts and hold a Coral Bardiche, which they will use to charge at you in the Water. 

Deepling Warlocks and Priests both have 45 Hearts and both hold Athame. The Priests have a ranged attack they can use, while Warlocks do not!

quests.title: Acropolis: Home of Scylla
quests.description:
The Acropolis is a giant city in the Clouds above the vast Oceans. (Yet I somehow didn't see it the first time). 

It is made of Azure Seastone, Prismarine, and Water! Yes, lots and lots and lots of Water! 

It is based off Greek Architecture, with lots of different floors and gardens and even arenas. 

All around it will spawn Octohosts, Urchinkin, Cindaria, Hippotamus, and Clawdian! As well as a few very unfortunate Ocean Mobs. 

Hidden throughout the Architecture you'll find Chests and rare Blocks like Diamond Blocks and Sponges!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_acropolis.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ender Golem
quests.description:
The Ender Golem keeps guard of the Ruined Citadel, well multiple of them do. 

Technically you don't need to fight them to fight the Ender Guardian but you definitely should to get the Void Core. 

The Ender Golem has 3000 Hearts and will regenerate them when left alone. 

He has a few attacks like being able to punch you and smashing the ground. When he smashing the ground, Void Runes will spawn, hurting any Player or Mob that touches them.

quests.title: Ender Guardian
quests.description:
The Ender Guardian is a hulking beast of Endstone, Purpur, and Obsidian that waits within the Void Altar. 
It has 6,660 Hearts and careful not to get too close or you might be sucked closer to him! 

He has a ton of attacks and abilities, one being a very simple punch for those who are too close to his personal space, or a slam which will knock you back. 

If you are farther from him, he might close the gap by charging and knocking into you. Or he might stomp and produce Void Runes to hit you! He can also send Shulker Balls in a row. 

Also remember when I said he can suck you closer to him? Yeah he does that with a thing called a Void Typhon, which he can also summon at your Feet to get you stuck. After you are there for too long, it will explode, most likely damaging you in the process. 

When you get him to half Health, his Mask will break revealing his true Head! In anger he will destroy the floor of the arena taking you both to the lower level. 

Now he will suck you in more, send more Void Runes after you, and attack faster and stronger!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_guardiuan.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Abyssal Sacrifice
quests.subtitle: Waking up The Leviathan
quests.description:
In order to fight The Leviathan you'll need a sacrifice. The Abyssal Sacrifice to be specific. 

The most basic Items needed is the Blocks of Ingots and Amethyst which are just Vanilla Items. 

Then, you'll need a Nautilus Shell and a Heart of the Sea. These are Vanilla Items which are rare to get... unless you kill Deeplings which can drop them! 

You'll also need an Athame which is a weapon used by Deepling Warlocks and Priests and dropped by them on death. 
The last part gives us a choice, either Crystallized Coral or Coral Chunk. Both are drops from Coral Golem and Coralssus.

quests.title: Coralssus
quests.description:
The Coralssus works as a Guard and Steed for the Sunken City. 

They can be ridden by Deeplings to move quicker and attack together! 

They have 160 Hearts and basic attacks . Its attacks are just smacking and throwing you. 

When killed it'll drop Coral Chunks which can be used to make the Abyssal Sacrifice.

quests.title: Endermaptera
quests.subtitle: End Cockroaches
quests.description:
Endermaptera live around the Ruined Citadel. 

They have 8 Hearts and only a basic attack of gnawing at you. 

If they gnaw at you too much they might break their jaws, to which they won't drop on death anymore. 

So make sure to kill them quickly if you want those Void Jaws!

quests.title: Coral Golem
quests.description:
Coral Golems spawn within the Sunken City and in oceans after you have defeated The Leviathan. 

They are similar to their bigger counterparts: Coralssus but have less Hearts at 110 and can't be ridden by Deeplings. 

They have more attacks than their counterparts though! Like jumping at you and smashing the ground next to you. And it can smack you. 

On death they will drop Crystallized Coral Fragments, which can be crafted into Crystallized Coral. Those can be made into the Abyssal Sacrifice.

quests.title: Sunken City: Home of The Leviathan
quests.description:
Who knows what happened to bring this City under the Water, but clearly it is! You'll easily notice it by the Stone Bricks sticking out of the Water. 

The first and biggest room is the City Center, the giant dome! This is where the Altar of the Abyss is. 

Off of the rooms you'll find hallways which lead to other buildings in the City. Prisons holding Coralussus and even Treasure Rooms holding tons of precious Loot! 

All around the City you will find its inhabitants, the Deeplings.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_city.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ruined Citadel: Home of the Ender Guardian
quests.description:
Another structure to cover the barreness of The End, the Ruined Citadel. 

The Ruined Citadel is a Palace of Obsidian, Endstone, and Purpur. 

In the palace you'll find Chests, Shulker Boxes, Shulkers, and even the unique Void Stone! 

Just be careful of the afformentioned Shulkers, Endermaptera, and Ender Golems.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_citadel.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Here hold this!
quests.description:
There's 3 Pets from Cataclysm the Modern Remnant, Baby Leviathan, and Netherite Ministrosity! 

Both the Modern Remnant and Netherite Ministrosity can be placed in Buckets. 

The Baby Leviathan will need a Water Bucket.

quests.title: Draugrs
quests.description:
Draugrs are similar to Deeplings as they have rankings. The Draugr rankings are: Draugr, Royal Draugr, and Elite Draugr. 

Normal Draugr have 14 Hearts and carry Black Steel Swords and Axes. These drop Rotten Flesh, Bones, and rarely Black Steel Nuggets. 

Next in line are Royal Draugr. These have 15 Hearts and carry Black Steel Targes along with the Swords and Axes. They drop the same Items as normal Draugrs. 

Last is the Elite Draugr. These switch between Black Steel Swords and Crossbows, depending on how far you are from them. They have 16 Hearts and drop, of course, the same loot!

quests.title: Amethyst Crab
quests.description:
The Amethyst Crab lives in the Lush Caves with the Axolotls. 

It has 1200 Hearts and is initially neutral. That means it won't attack first but it will hit you back. 

It has a few attacks one being just smacking you with its claws. It can also throw Amethysts at you and burrow under the ground. 

On death it'll drop its meat and shells. Its meat can be blessed in an Altar of Amethyst to be better. The Shells can be crafted together to make Bloom Stone Pauldrons which have similar stats to Netherite Chestplate but can do similar abilities as the Crab itself.

quests.title: End: Land of 1 lonely boss
quests.description: The Barren Wasteland of the End now has 1 more resident. \n\nThe other being the Ender Dragon of course!

quests.title: Ignited Revenant
quests.description:
The Ignited Revenant stands in our way to kill the Ignis. 

The Revenant looks and acts like a Blaze, but instead of being Rods, he has Shields! 

These Shields make him invunerable to all attacks, you'll need to wait for him to lift them, to attack him! 

He has 640 Hearts and has 2 attacks: one where he lifts in the air and throws Blaze Rods all around him, and the other where he spins his Shields around as if he was doing Spinjitzu. 

On death he will drop the Burning Ashes.

quests.title: Soul Render
quests.description:
The Soul Render is crafted from Cursium and Black Steel. 

It being a massive weapon (as most in Cataclysm are) it has big Range and a ton of Damage... but its special effects are even better! 

You can use Right Click to be sent charging forward with the Soul Render. When you do, Phantom Halberds will drop from the sky where you went! You can also Shift Right Click to spawn Phantom Halberds all around you.

quests.title: The Incinerator
quests.description:
My personal favorite and one of the most powerful. 

The Incinerator can be used just like a normal Sword and Enchanted like one! 
But when Holding Right Click it does something no normal Sword does. When you Hold and let go of Right Click for a few seconds, massive flames will strike out of the ground in the direction you are looking at, then they will explode. 

It is also massive, which not just looks cool, but also gives better Range!

quests.title: Cursed Armor
quests.description:
Cursium Armor is an upgrade to Netherite Armor. Combine Netherite Gear, with a Cursium Ingot, and a Cursium Upgrade Template. You can Craft those don't worry! 

The Cursium Helmet can be used with the Key: C to see Mobs through Blocks! Like the Spectral Eye. 

The Cursium Chestplate works as a built in Totem of Undying. After you die you will be saved. It has a 6 minute Cooldown though... 

The Cursium Leggings are working with propability... not sure how that works in Minecraft though! 

The Cursium Boots allow you to get sent backwards in a leap with the Key: V. They also reduce Fall Damage but a lot (but not completely!)

quests.title: The Annihilator
quests.description:
The Annihilator is a very fun weapon made from Cursium and Black Steel. 

You can smack enemies around with it all day! But you know what's more fun than one Annihilator? 

Two Annihilators! 

If you have an Annihilator in each Hand, then you can Hold Right Click to do a powerful ground pound, damaging all around you!

quests.title: Maledictus
quests.description:
The Maledictus can be brought back from Valhalla or whatever the Norse version of Hell is, by Right Clicking the Cursed Tombstone. 

He has 8,400 Hearts and massive Wings.

He will swing at you with his 2 Annihilators and can even ground pound you with them, making a Shockwave of course! 

His Wings allow him to manevure and do many more attacks. He can charge at you, breaking all Blocks in his way or even dodge attacks! 

He can fly into the air and from there can either shoot at you with his Cursed Bow or drop down with his Soul Render. The Cursed Bow will shoot 4 Arrows at you. With his Soul Render he will bring a shower of Phantom Halberds down on you.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_maledictus.png width:125 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Strange Key
quests.subtitle: Unlocking access to the Maledictus
quests.description:
I guess the Draugrs really wanted to keep the Cursed Tombstone safe because they Locked it! 

The Door of Seal, yeah a really creative name, blocks us from getting to it. We'll need a Strange Key to open it. 

Again, they really want it locked up because they gave the Strange Key to the Aptrgangr. Only the toughest guys in the Frosted Prison who are still alive!

quests.title: Frosted Prison: Home of the Maledictus
quests.description:
The Frosted Prison is a massive Castle like structure on top and within the Snowy Mountains. 

Within you will find dozens of cells, armories, and a great room which the Cursed Tombstone lies. 

You can find plenty of Chests full of Loot, including Black Steel. There's Decorated Pots everywhere for the taking! 

And of course Mobs enemies to stand in your way: Draugrs and Aptrgangr.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_prison.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Cataclysm
quests.description:
Cataclsym is a mod which adds new bosses, dungeons, and of course loot! 

There is no certain pattern of which bosses to kill first, but some are stronger than others, and some give loot that will help against the others. 

Check out the Eyes to find the specific Structures you'll need to locate!

quests.title: Burning Arena: Home of the Ignis
quests.description:
The Burning Arena is a giant Colosseum-esque Arena within the Nether. 
You'll arrive at the peaceful but hot 1st floor, on the 2nd floor you'll find |gnited Revenants which you'll need to kill for Burning Ashes. 

Which can then be used on the 3rd floor, in the Altar to summon the Ignis! 

Oh yeah and if you're looking for Loot, check above the 3rd floor!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_arena.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Burning Ashes
quests.subtitle: Relighting the Ignis
quests.description: Because just fighting the Ignis isn't hard enough, you'll have to fight the Ignited Revenant first to get Burning Ashes. \n\nOnce you have them, use them on the Altar of Fire to summon the Ignis.

quests.title: Ignis
quests.description:
Once you use the Burning Ashes on the Alter of Flame you'll get the Ignis. 
He has 7,200 Hearts and has a massive Sword and Shield. 

The Shield will block damage you give and the Sword can be used to slice and stab you. Once stabbed, you can't move, you can only attack. 

He can also pounce on you, when he does, he will slam his Shield down, making a Shockwave which will toss Blocks and you into the Air. He can do the same with his Sword just without the need to pounce. 

Another attack he has is Fireballs. He will throw 3 Fireballs into the Air, then they will be sent flying toward you! Hit them back at him as if they were a Ghast Fireball. 

Once you beat his Health to around 7,500 Hearts he will change colors to a Light Blue color. Now he will Attack quicker, deal more Damage, and get Lifesteal. 

His Fireballs will also not be able to be reflected and he can now make different types of Shockwaves!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_ignis.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ignitium
quests.subtitle: Better than Netherite?
quests.description:
Ignitium is like Netherite but it takes actual skill to get. 

The Ignis will only drop 1 so get good use of it! 

You can use it to upgrade your Netherite Armor or use it to make the Weapons.

quests.title: Blazing Grips
quests.description:
Blazing Grips are another Item we can make with Ignitium! 

It is a Curios Item that goes on your Hands. 

When worn, all attacks have a chance of giving the recipient Blazing Brand. 

This decreases Armor and Armor Toughness, and it sucks to get from the Ignis.

quests.title: Ignitium Armor
quests.description:
Ignitium is an upgrade for Netherite. You'll need an Ignitium Upgrade which is Crafted, and an Ignitium Ingot which is dropped from the Ignis. 

The Ignitium Helmet allows you to see clearly under Lava. 

The Ignitium Chestplate can combined with an Elytra. 

The Ignitium Leggings don't make us flame-proof, rather the Fires that are covering our bodies will go out quicker! 
The Ignitium Boots allow us to walk over Lava. Like Leather Boots over Powdered Snow, you can Hold Shift to lower into the Lava.

quests.title: Cursed Bow
quests.description:
The Cursed Bow works similar to a Bow with the Multishot Enchantment! 

With normal Arrows, it will shoot 3 at a time! With special Arrows it will only shoot 2. 

I wonder if you can Enchant it with Multishot as well?

quests.title: Bulwark of the Flame
quests.description:
You like the Ignis' shield? Well you can make 1 of your own with Ignitium. 

The Bulwark of the Flame can be used like a normal Shield but also has a special effect. 

When Holding Right Click and Shift, letting go will let you charge at whatever is infront of you, like how goats do. 

Whatever gets hit will take Damage and if pinched against a wall will also get stunned. 

Definitely nice to have around!

quests.title: Aptrgangr
quests.description:
The Aptrgangr is the mini boss within the Frosted Prison. 

They have 480 Hearts and will attack you with their giant Axe. 

They can swing their Axe like normal, or they might smash it on the ground near you. When they do that, lasers will spawn damaging all in their path. They also have a charge attack similar to the Kobolediator! 

On death they will drop Black Steel Ingots and Nuggets, and Rotten Flesh and Bones.

quests.title: Overworld: Land of 3 4 5 bosses
quests.description: Do I really need to explain the Overworld to you?

quests.title: Nether: Land of 2 bosses
quests.description: The Dimension known for housing the piglins and blazes and wither skeletons, now houses 2 more bosses to fight!

quests.title: Ignited Berserker
quests.description:
This one is quite unique in its spawning! After you kill the Ignis, there's a chance Ignited Berserkers will spawn in Nether Fortresses. 

They are just like Revenants just instead of Shields they have Swords! Their Swords won't protect against damage like the Shields do, instead they deal more damage. 

They have much less health, at 65 Hearts and will drop Dying Embers when killed. 4 Dying Embers can be Crafted into 1 Burning Ashes.

quests.title: 00307A898A639191
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Kobolediator
quests.description:
Kobolediators are one of the two mini-bosses within the Cursed Pyramid. 

They will remain dormant until a Player (in Survival, took me awhile to figure that out) walks near them and they will wake up. 

They have 540 Hearts and will inflict Mining Fatigue on you. 

They will swing their Sword at you if you get too close! If you gain some distance from them, they will charge at you as if you were holding a Football and running for the endzone! 

On death they will drop Koboleton Bones, Ancient Metal Ingots, and their Skull!

quests.title: Cursed Pyramid: Home of Ancient Remnant
quests.description:
The Cursed Pyramid spawns in deserts and it's very hard to miss. A massive pyramid with huge pillars by the entrance. 

Enter within and you will find traps all around, Koboletons, and mini-bosses! 

Don't worry there's also Chests, Pots, and even Suspicious Sand which you will need for the...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_pyramid.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Soul BlackSmith: Home of the Netherite Monstrosity
quests.description:
The Soul BlackSmith resides in the Nether. Don't overlook it thinking it is a Bastion, it's much worse. 

You can find Gold, Blackstone, and Netherite here. 

The only hostile Mobs that spawn here is the boss... the Netherite Monstrosity!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_blacksmith.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Koboletons
quests.subtitle: Mini Dinos!
quests.description:
Koboletons are mini Dino Skeletons who serve the Ancient Remnant. 

They only have 12 and a half Hearts and attack you with their Khopesh. 

They can drop their weapon, along with their Bones, and Ancient Metal Nuggets.

quests.title: Necklace of the desert
quests.subtitle: Resurrecting an Ancient Remnant
quests.description:
To find these we'll need a little archeology! 

In the giant shaft you'll take to get to the Ancient Remnant, there are 3 rooms on the sides of it. 

2 of these rooms have Suspicious Sand which you can use a Brush on to get Loot! Including the Necklace of Desert. 
Then, Right Click the Ancient Remnant with the Necklace of Desert to resurrect it!

quests.title: Ancient Remnant
quests.description:
The Ancient Remnant is master of his domain, of Sand. 

He has 2,700 Hearts and is aided with a Wadjet and a Kobolediator. 

He has a few moves and attacks! He can swing his bony tail at you, bite you, or he might stomp on the ground, producing Shockwaves. 

He can also summon Sandstorms with a mighty ROAR and even drop Sand Traps on your head. 

Another attack he may use to get closer to you is his charge. His charge will hurt you and your FPS as it destroys every Block in his path. 

He does have a weakness, the very thing that resurrected him! If you hit his Necklace he will be knocked down for a little bit, giving you the perfect chance to strike him down and return him to the grave!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_remnant.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Wadjet
quests.description:
The Wadjet is similar to the Kobolediator as it lies within the Cursed Pyramid waiting for a Player to come near. 

The Wadjet has 450 Hearts and thankfully won't give you Mining Fatigue! 
She has many attacks, the most basic is when you are close she will swing her weapon at you. If you get farther she might throw a Sandstorm at you or drop Sand Blocks from the roof on top of you. 

I'm going to be honest, I don't know which attack is worse! 

On death they will only drop Ancient Metal Ingots.

quests.title: Ancient Factory: Home of The Harbinger
quests.description:
The Ancient Factory lies deep underground in the Overworld. 

You'll find many Redstone Items like Levers, Powered Rails, and EMPs... I wonder if those will be useful soon? 

You'll also find some Redstone Machines trying to kill you! Like the Watchers and Prowlers! 

Even with the danger there's still tons of Loot and Blocks you can steal from here, especially Redstone.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_factory.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Netherite Monstrosity
quests.description:
The Netherite Monstrosity lives up to his name, he's a beast of Netherite and Lava. 

He can have up to 9,600 Hearts but when I first met him he was only at around 1,100 Hearts. He will regenerate Hearts when no Player is nearby.

He has a few Melee attacks like smacking you with his massive arms and ground pounding on you. He can also throw blocks in the Air causing a Shockwave. 

If you get farther from him he might charge at you or leap at you. Honestly he looks like he weighs 100 Tons, I wouldn't want him doing either to me! 

The worst of his attacks are definitely the Ranged ones though... he can shoot Magma Balls at you and where they drop, Lava will spawn. He can also shoot Fireballs from his hands, these will cause Fire Spouts to come out of the ground.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_monstrosity.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ancient Metal
quests.description:
Ancient Metal is a Drop from pretty much everything within the Cursed Pyramid! 

Like other Ingots it can be Crafted from Nuggets or Blocks and vice versa. 

You can use it to make Bone Reptile Armor or the Ancient Spear.

quests.title: Monstrous Helm
quests.description: You can combine a Netherite Upgrade Template, a Netherite Helmet, and a Monstrous Horn to make the Monstrous Helm. \n\nIt has the same stats but when you're at half health it'll Knockback everything close to you and increase defense stats.

quests.title: Nether Star
quests.subtitle: Powering The Harbinger
quests.description:
To power up The Harbinger you'll need a Nether Star, which you get from killing the Wither. 

It's a Vanilla mechanic I shouldn't have to explain. 

Plus it's in Chapter 1.

quests.title: Khopesh
quests.description:
The Khopesh is the Weapon and Drop of Koboletons. 

It does the same damage as an Iron Sword but can't be Enchanted or Repaired. 

Guess they didn't plan on you using them that much...

quests.title: What shall not be named for my crashing reasons
quests.description:
Want another pet from Cataclysm? Then the Remnant Skull is what you need! 

It's a confirmed drop from the Ancient Remnant and when used will spawn a Modern Revenant. 

This one is much smaller and nicer than the Ancient one. You can tame it by feeding it a Sniffer Egg then it will act like a dog. 

Attacking what attacks you or what you attack. It also has 3 modes: follow, wander, and stay. Follow it will... well follow you. Wander will have it walking around a certain area. And stay will have it lay down in one spot. 

They have 1500 Hearts and I've learned you can feed them Koboleton Bones to heal them! 

Enjoy your new dino!

quests.title: The Watchers
quests.description:
The Watchers... well they watch the Ancient Factory. They'll attack anything they see (Player wise) with their 'fricken laser beams!' and Blades if they are close enough. 

They have 12 and a half Hearts, can fly, and are weak to EMP attacks as well. 

Like The Prowler they drop redstone and iron on death.

quests.title: The Prowler
quests.description:
Looks like someone flipped the ON switch this time! 

The Prowler is a miniboss guarding the Ancient Factory. He has 640 Hearts. 

He has 3 attacks. The Saw for close up Enemies. And for farther Enemies he has Shoulder Missiles, similar to the WASW, and a Laser from his eye. 

On death he'll drop Redstone and Iron. 
(Tip he's also weak to the EMP attacks)

quests.title: Netherite Ministrosity
quests.description:
The Netherite Ministrosity is a Pet given to us by Cataclysm! 

First, you'll need to Craft a Netherite Effigy. 

Then, we can kill the Netherite Monstrosity for the Lava Power Cells. 

Finally, place down the Effigy and feed it a Power Cell to tame him! 

Once tamed he can be Shift Right Clicked to edit whether he is following, staying, or wandering. 

You can also Right Click him to open his Inventory, aka cracking open his entire head like a Rock Monster from Lego Power Miners. He has an Inventory of 15 Slots. 

He also has 960 Hearts and I can't find a way to heal him...

quests.title: Bottle O' Sandstorm
quests.description:
Sorry, you can't wear these anymore, now they are just Items! 

By Right Clicking with them, 2 Sandstorms will spawn. The Sandstorms will circle you and move with you. 

Whatever is hit by them will be Damaged and Knockbacked.

quests.title: Infernal Forge
quests.description:
The Infernal Forge is a drop from the Netherite Monstrosity and is technically not a weapon, it's a pickaxe! 
It can be used to mine up to Netherite Tier, so it can mine Allthemodium Ore. 

When right clicked it will attack in an AOE mode. Pounding the ground hitting everything close by. 

(It can be enchanted with Sword and Pickaxe enchantments!)

quests.title: Bone Reptile Armor
quests.description: Bone Reptile Armor is made from Koboleton Bones, Ancient Metal, and for the Helmet a Kobolediator Skull. \n\nThese don't appear to do anything special, just give very good stats for cheap Armor!

quests.title: The Harbinger
quests.description:
The Harbinger takes a lot of inspiration from what powers him, the Nether Star. 

He has 4,680 Hearts and will attack every Mob and Player he sees that doesn't spawn in the Ancient Factory. 

He will fly around and even charge at you. Like The Wither, The Harbringer will break almost every Block in its path. 

To attack he can shoot Wither Missiles at you which can give you Wither Effect or shoot Wither Howitzers from his back which will shoot off in every direction. 

He also has Lasers he can shoot you with, Laser Gatlings, and a big mouth beam. 

He has a big weakness, like the other living machines, he is weak to the EMPs! If you use them on him, he will be stun locked, unable to move or fight for a few seconds.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/cataclysm/cataclysm_harbinger.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ancient Spear
quests.description: Wait you're telling me for just a few Ancient Metal we can get a Weapon that does more Damage than a Netherite Sword, has insane Range, and throws Sandstorms!? \n\nYep, that's what you get from the Ancient Spear!

quests.title: Wither plus Netherite = ...?
quests.subtitle: = Witherite
quests.description: Witherite is a drop from The Harbinger, it will always drop 1 block which can be made into 9 ingots. \n\nWitherite is used to craft 3 Weapons and the Mechanical Fusion Anvil which can be used to combine Cataclysm Items!

quests.title: Laser Gatling
quests.subtitle: Straight outta Fallout
quests.description:
The Laser Gatling is a weapon you can make from Witherite. 

By using Redstone in your inventory, you can shoot Lasers which start fires and do 3 and a half Hearts of damage. 

It shoots 50 Lasers per 1 redstone which I think is a good deal.

quests.title: Meat Shredder
quests.subtitle: Straight outta Fallout 3 DLC The Pitt
quests.description:
The Meat Shredder is a Melee weapon you can make from Witherite. 

It has two attacks, either using Left Click or Right Click. 

When you Left Click it'll use the Meat Shredder like an Axe, hitting them once from a decent range. 

When you hit Right Click it will repeatedly shred them with it's Saw, doing much quicker Damage from closer.

quests.title: W.A.S.W. (Wither Assault Shoulder Weapon)
quests.description:
The Wither Assault Shoulder Weapon (W.A.S.W.) is the last weapon you can make from Witherite. 

It has 2 different projectiles it can shoot: Wither Missiles and Wither Howitzers. 

The Wither Missiles shoot from just Holding Right Click, and will Damage whatever gets hit by them, with low cooldown. 

The Wither Howitzers are fired when you Shift Hold Right Click, they damage a bigger area and leave an area of Wither Effect, that damages whatever walks in it. They have much longer cooldown though.

quests.title: Mechanical Fusion Anvil
quests.description:
The Mechanical Fusion Anvil will be needed to make combinations of Cataclysm Items. 

You can place it down like a normal Anvil, but this one doesn't have Durability... thankfully! 

Check JEI for Recipes, you place 1 Item in the Left Slot and the other in the Middle Slot to get the final product in the Right Slot.

quests.title: V.A.S.W. (Void Assault Shoulder Weapon)
quests.description:
The Void Assault Shoulder Weapon (V.A.S.W.) is just like the Wither version but better! 

Now it only shoots Void Howitzers which will do more Damage and cause Void Runes to come out of the ground, in the area the Howitzer hit. 

Just at the cost of the long cooldown, but we've got time to wait. 

It can crafted by combining the W.A.S.W. and a Void Core in the Mechanical Infusion Anvil.

quests.title: Gauntlet of Bulwark
quests.description:
The Gauntlet of Bulwark acts different from what you'd assume. 

Instead of bringing mobs closer it pushes them away, when Holding Right Click, and gives them Blazing Brand. 

Then when you release Right Click you'll charge in the direction you are looking. 

It's made by fusing the Gauntlet of Guard with a Bulwark of Flame in the Mechanical Fusion Anvil.

quests.title: Void Forge
quests.description:
Combine an Infernal Forge with a Void Core to make the Void Forge! 

It is still a Pickaxe, with same Mining Tier and Speed. 

Just now we can Right Click with it, on the ground to summon Void Runes in a fan shape, to hurt all Mobs with it. 

They really don't focus much on the Pickaxe part do they?

quests.title: The Immolator
quests.description:
The Immolator is an Annihilator upgraded with an Ignitium Ingot within the Mechanical Fusion Anvil. 

These do more Damage to Mobs with Blazing Brand afflicted on them, so Blazing Grips work pretty well with it! 

If you have The Immolator in each Hand, you can Hold right Click to summon a Flame Strike beneath you. This will Damage all Mobs in it and explode when done as a final farewell!

quests.title: Ignitium Elytra Chestplate
quests.description: Just combine an Ignitium Chestplate with an Elytra... that simple!

quests.title: Wrath of the Desert
quests.description:
The Wrath of the Desert is a combination of the Cursed Bow and Sandstorm in a Bottle. 

This Bow doesn't shoot Arrows like normal, instead it will shoot Cursed Sandstorms! 

Three of them to be exact! 

It also doesn't need Arrows to shoot, which is also nice.

quests.title: Gauntlet of Maelstorm
quests.description:
The Gauntlet of Maelstorm is made with the Gauntlet of Guard and Sandstorm in a Bottle in a Mechanical Fusion Anvil. 

This one is unique from all Weapons I've seen from Cataclysm. 

When you Hold Right Click, a Void Vortex will spawn where you are aiming. 

The Void Vortex will suck in all Entities nearby, then after a few seconds, it will close and explode! Dealing Damage to all near it.

quests.title: Visit an Ancient City
quests.description:
The Ancient City is only the most dangerous Structure in Vanilla Minecraft. So of course that is just the start to Deeper and Darker! 

Here we can find Sculk galore, along with Loot and the Warden. We'll also find the Portal Frame made of Reinforced Deepslate. 

But until then, Loot all you can! And be careful of the...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/allthemodium/all_city.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Kill the Warden
quests.description:
The Warden. The most difficult boss in Minecraft, of course being within the most difficult Structure. 

He's spawned from a Sculk Shrieker being activated 3 times, or any amount after the first Warden. 

He has 500 Hearts and does a ton of Damage from either hitting you with his fists or his Sonic Blast! 

He does have a weakness though, that being that he is Blind. He can only find you with Sound, or Smell if you are close enough! Keep your distance, like 23 Blocks up.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/gettingstarted/warden_roar.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Heart of the Deep
quests.description:
The Warden will drop quite a few Items but the Heart of the Deep is most important. 

We can use the Heart of the Deep on a frame of Reinforced Deepslate to get our Portal to the Otherside. There can't be any Blocks blocking the Portal Frame or else it won't work. 

He also drops Warden Carapace and Echo Shards, both will be useful for Crafting other Items!

quests.title: Blooming Wood
quests.description:
Blooming Stems aren't like Trees, they're more like if Chorus and Bamboo had a baby. 

They spawn within the Blooming Caverns and need other Blooming Stems to keep up! This is the only way to find them. 

You can still Strip them or make Planks out of them. The Planks have a Light Blue color to them, and so will whatever you make out of them!

quests.title: Echo Trees
quests.description:
Echo Logs are made from Echo Trees which spawn in the Echoing Forest... is there an echo in here, why do I hear it so much? 

Echo Trees have Purple Leaves and Sculk Gleam within them. While their Logs have a Light Grey Bark and a very Light Green Log color. 

All the Planks and Wood Items made from it are all the Light Green Color, almost Mint like. 

The Trapdoors and Doors even have cool unique patterns!

quests.title: Blooming Moss
quests.description:
Blooming Moss comes from the... you guessed it! Blooming Caverns! 

It will spawn on the ground just waiting for you to collect it. 

They don't spread like normal Moss nor do they have any Recipes.

quests.title: Echo Soil
quests.description:
Echo Soil covers the floor of the Echoing Forests. 

They do not act like normal Grass or Dirt besides allowing Echoing Saplings to grow on them. 

No normal Saplings.

quests.title: Gloomy Geyser
quests.description:
Gloomy Geysers are Blocks you can find within Overcast Columns. 

When you Walk over them they will shoot you high up into the Air! Be careful though, you'll still take Fall Damage. 

You can pick them up with Silk Touch.

quests.title: Sculk Grime
quests.description:
Sculk Grime is Deeper and Darker's version of Clay! 

You can find it within a few Biomes and when you mine it you'll get Grime Balls. 

These can then be made back into Sculk Grime or made into Grime Bricks.

quests.title: The Otherside
quests.subtitle: Hello from...
quests.description:
The Otherside is the birthplace of Sculk and Sculk creatures, including the Warden. 

Here you'll find many of his distant cousins, but don't worry there's also a few plus-sides to the Otherside! 

There's plenty of new Building Blocks and Items we can find and Sculk everywhere for tons of XP! 

So get your Hoe ready and adventure into the Otherside!

quests.title: Soundproof Glass
quests.description:
Soundproof Glass is made by combining Soul Dust and Glass. 

These work at dampening Sound just like Wool! If a Sculk Sensor or Shrieker has one covering them, they won't hear Sounds. 

Just these you can see through!

quests.title: Sculk Jaw
quests.description:
Sculk Jaws are Blocks we can find within the Deeplands. 

When you accidentally walk over them they'll bite you, this drags you down and deals Damage when you are stuck in them. 

You can take them by using Silk Touch.

quests.title: Sculk Stone
quests.description:
Sculk Stone spawns pretty much everywhere but Overcast Columns. 

It works like normal Stone, like in every single way. You can smelt Cobbled versions to get Sculk Stone which can then be made into many other Building Blocks. 

Unfortunately it can't be used to make Stone Tools though... wait what do you care you killed the Warden! Why do you need Stone Tools?!?!?!

quests.title: Gloomslate
quests.description: Gloomslate replaces Sculk Stone in the Overcast Columns. \n\nIt works just like Sculk Stone, just more Brown.

quests.title: 1BFE6745F49B4AB0
quests.description: Sculk Gleam has properties of Shroomlights. They don't need a Tool to collect, but break fastest with a Hoe. \n\nThey spawn within Echoing Trees and rarely underground.

quests.title: Crystallized Amber
quests.description:
Crystallized Amber spawns within Overcast Columns. 

You'll need Silk Touch to grab them. 

They don't do much, but they look pretty!

quests.title: Blooming Caverns
quests.description:
The Blooming Caverns are more like Lush Caves than normal Caves. I say that because of the abundance of PLANTS! 

You'll find Plants growing from the ceiling to the floor, Plants growing from the floor to the ceiling, Plants growing from the Water, and Plants not even Growing at all! 

The floor is covered in Blooming Sculk Stone and even Blooming Moss. 

There's even Water Ponds here, the only place you can find Water in this Dimension.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_cave.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Deeplands
quests.description:
The Deeplands are most similar to the Deep Dark. 

They are full of Sculk along with Shriekers and Sensors, which yes can still spawn the Warden. 

Here you'll also find more Sculk Creatures and Plants, and even the one Structure the Otherside has!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_land.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Soul Elytra
quests.description:
The Soul Elytra works just like a normal Elytra, just now with more Durability and Armor Points! 

They can't be repaired with Phantom Membranes like normal Elytras... but Enchantments can still repair them! 

To Craft one you'll need an Elytra, 4 Sculk Bones which drop from Shattered, 2 Soul Dust which drop from Sculk Snappers or Sculk Leeches, and a Soul Crystal which drops from the Stalker.

quests.title: Warden Upgrade Template
quests.description:
To upgrade from Netherite to Warden Gear, you'll need a Smithing Template! 

These are found in Chests in Ancient Cities. 

They can then be duplicated with 7 Diamonds and a Sculk Block!

quests.title: Reinforced Echo Shard
quests.description:
Reinforced Echo Shard is a Crafted Item that requires a few Items. 

First, and easiest to obtain are Phantom Membrane! Phantoms will spawn after the Player hasn't slept in a few days. The more restless nights, the more Phantoms! 

Second, is the Echo Shard. These can be found in quite a few ways but easiest is Looting in Ancient Cities. 

The last is the Warden Carapaces. These are Drops from the Warden on death. Don't worry he usually drops more than one!

quests.title: Shattered
quests.description:
Shattered spawn in quite a few Biomes in the Otherside. 

They act like mini Wardens, being Blind relying on Sculk to find Enemies. They also attack all non-Sculk Mobs. 

Shattereds have 50 Hearts and pack quite a punch! So careful to not attract too many. 

If you can kill them, they'll drop Sculk Bones. These will be needed for a few Recipes.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_shattered.png width:100 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Sculk Centipede
quests.description:
Sculk Centipedes are long neutral Mobs that spawn in the Otherside. 

They have 10 Hearts and will attack in a group if Hit, like Wolves. 

They only drop XP and maybe String, so best to leave them be!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_centipede.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Shriek Worm
quests.description:
Shriek Worms spawn from stepping on Infested Sculk in Deeplands. 

They are Mini bosses with 100 Hearts. 

If you get too close they'll bite you, causing a ton of Damage! But if you go too far they'll retreat back down into the ground. 

They don't drop anything but a bit of XP, which I don't think is worth the trouble.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_worm.png width:100 height:200 align:center}

quests.title: Sonorous Staff
quests.description:
You ever wish you, yourself can use the Wardens Sonic Blast? 

Well with the Sonorous Staff you can! Just simply Hold Right Click to charge it up, then release to send a Sonic Blast. 
There is a slight cooldown to it and it does have Durability, so use with risk! 

To Craft one you'll need a Heart of the Deep from the Warden, 2 Soul Crystals from the Stalker, and 2 Sculk Bones from Shattereds.

quests.title: AllRightsReserved
quests.description:

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Sculk Leech
quests.description:
Sculk Leeches can sometimes spawn from broken Ancient Vases. 

It acts as a little surprise for you when 2 spawn out! 

They only have 2 Hearts and will attack you despise that. 

On death they will drop Soul Dust.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_leech.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Warden Armor
quests.description:
Warden Armor is direct upgrade to Netherite. Just use a Warden Upgrade Template, a Reinforced Echo Shard, and a piece of Netherite Armor to make it. 

Each piece has 1 more Armor Point and 1 more Armor Protection compared to its Netherite counterpart. 

No more Knockback Resistance though. 

They atleast look much cooler than Netherite though! The Helmet has giant horns like the Warden and the Chestplate has a heart spot.

quests.title: Warden Weapons
quests.description:
No, the Warden doesn't use Swords and Axes. But we can! 

Both the Warden Sword and Axe are upgrades of their Netherite versions with a Reinforced Echo Shard and Warden Upgrade Template. 

They each have 1 Heart of Damage more and even more Durability! 

Yes, the Axe can still efficiently chop down Trees.

quests.title: Warden Tools
quests.description:
Not much change from Netherite to Warden for these Tools. 

The Pickaxe is same Tier and same Speed. Shovels can still make Pathways and again same Speed. Hoes can still make Farmland and also same Speed. 

Only real change is higher Attack Damage for all of them. 

Funny enough that means Warden Hoes have higher Damage than all Vanilla Hoes!

quests.title: Sculk Snapper
quests.description:
Sculk Snappers are tiny but angry Mobs! 

I've seen them spawn in Deeplands and Blooming Caverns. 

They have 6 Hearts and will drop Soul Dust on Death.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_snapper.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Angler Fish
quests.description:
Angler Fish spawn in Water Ponds within Blooming Caverns. 

They act like normal Fish, obviously needing Water to breathe. 

They have 3 Hearts and will attack you when you are near. 

They don't drop anything on death unfortunately... sorry Fishies!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_fish.png width:100 height:120 align:center}

quests.title: Sludge
quests.description:
Sludges spawn in Blooming Caverns and act like Slimes! 

Their largest form has 8 Hearts and does a ton of Damage. On death they will spawn 2-4 Medium Sludges. 

Their medium forms have 2 Hearts and do much less Damage. On death they'll spawn 2-4 small Sludges. 

The small form has only a half a Heart of Health and won't do any Damage.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_sludge.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Echoing Forest
quests.description:
The Echoing Forest is a little plain but it also houses the Echoing Trees! 

The Echoing Trees act like normal Trees, you can Mine their Logs for Crafting and their Leaves will drop Saplings. You can also find Sculk Gleam within the Leaves. 

Around it you will find Echoing Soil all over the surface. These unfortunately can not be made into Farmland or Dirt, they're just Blocks.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_forest.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Overcast Columns
quests.description:
The Overcast Columns are much more Hot and Orange than any other Biome here. 

Here Sculk is replaced with Gloomy Sculk and Sculk Stone is replaced with Gloomslate. 

You'll also find Soul Sand/Soil plus Magma with Lava beneath them. 

With the temperatures being so Hot, Mobs won't normally spawn here, but there is a few Plant life!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_column.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ancient Temples
quests.subtitle: The only structure
quests.description:
The Ancient Temple is the important and necessary Structure found within the Deeplands. 

It looks like a Mayan Pyramid made of Deepslate and Sculk. There's tons of Sculk Sensors and Shriekers as well as Chests and Ancient Vases. 

Within the higher floors you'll find mostly just Chests and Ancient Vases but within the Pyramid we'll find even Blocks of Gold and other Materials.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_temple.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Sculk Vines
quests.description: Sculk Vines are the Sculk version of Weeping Vines. \n\nThey can spawn within Blooming Caverns and Deeplands.

quests.title: Glowing Roots
quests.description: Glowing Roots spawn in Blooming Caverns. \n\nThey can't be Climbed and don't drop Food... I think they are just for decor.

quests.title: Sculk Tendrils
quests.description: Sculk Tendrils are like Twisting Vines... just Sculky. \n\nThey spawn rarely in Deeplands.

quests.title: Sculk Transmitter
quests.description:
The Sculk Transmitter is a very rare Item we can find within Chests of the Ancient Temple. 

Once you do find one, it'll be your Bestfriend! 

To use it, simply Shift Right Click a Block that has a GUI, think of: Chests, Crafting Tables, and Furnaces. Then, the Transmitter will be bound to that Item. 

After that, we can use the Transmitter to remotely access that Block from wherever! 

To unbind the Block, Shift Right Click the Air with the Transmitter.

quests.title: Stalker
quests.description:
The Stalker is a Boss that can be spawned by breaking Ancient Vases. 

He has 200 Hearts and a Boss Bar to keep track. We'll need to kill him to get Soul Crystals. 

He is very fast and does a ton of Damage if he Hits you. Thankfully he is Blind, like the Warden. But he also has an amazing sense of hearing which allows him to hear everything nearby. 

He has a few attacks, normally he will just Hit you. Sometimes he might cause an AOE attack and can summon Sculk Leeches to attack you! 

He'll also attack every non-Sculk Mob.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/deepndark/dnd_stalker.png width:100 height:200 align:center}

quests.title: Gloomy Cacti
quests.description:
Gloomy Cacti are just like normal Cacti, just these spawn within Overcast Columns. 

I mean they like the Heat, they don't need Water to grow, they hurt to touch, are there even any differences? 

Oh yeah, these can be Smelted into Orange Dye instead of Green!

quests.title: Ice Lilies
quests.description:
Ice Lilies are Plants that grow on the Water Ponds within the Blooming Caverns (I told you it has a lot of Plants). 

There's 2 parts to the Plant, the Lily and the Ice Flower. The Lily Pad is what floats on Water and allows you to walk on it. The Ice Flower lies on top of the Lily Pad and looks pretty!

You'll need Shears to nab them.

quests.title: Bloom Berries
quests.description:
Bloom Berries grow from Glowing Vines on the roof of the Blooming Caverns. 

Within the Glowing Vines, Bloom Berries might spawn and will wait for you to pick them off the Vine with Right Click! 

This is the only Food Source in the Otherside.

quests.title: Home, Sweet Home!
quests.description:
To get back to the Overworld, we can leave the same way we came! 

Use the Heart of the Deep on a Frame of Reinforced Deepslate. 

Luckily we get one of those within the bottom of the Ancient Temple.
