quests.title: 770C0975CA61CE46
quests.description: Glacite can be found deep underground in the Permafrost Forests. \n\nIt can be used to craft Armor and Tools which help against Freezing damage!

quests.title: Aurora Deer
quests.description:
Aurora Deers are friendly hooved animals who also live in the cold. 

These Deers won't try to harm you but if you get in their way when you run you might feel some Antlers. 

Antlers which can also be dropped by them on death which can be used as either a weapon or a hoe! 

They might also drop Leather or Aurora Deer Steak.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_deer.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Permafrost Forest
quests.description:
Highest points in the Starlight is the Permafrost Forests which lie upon Mountains. 

Being so far up makes them much colder making them covered in Snow and Ice! 

Atleast the friendly Mobs seem to enjoy the Cold!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_permafrost.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Yetis
quests.description:
The Yeti is a name that strikes fear into all those who explore the Cold! An abominable furry creature that lives in the harshest coldest climate eating anything that dare venture there! 

Well not this Yeti, these ones are cute and friendly! They'd rather roll around than eat you. 

Heck they don't even fight back and only have 10 Hearts. 

On death they will drop their Fur and String, the former which can be used as a replacement for Wool.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_yeti.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 7E90138B0A2C3210
quests.description:
The Northland Trees are big sturdy Trees up in the Permafrost Forests. 

They look like Spruce but much lighter! Maybe they're an albino Spruce. 

Their saplings need to be placed on Dirt, not Grass, and in a 2x2 formation.

quests.title: Starlight Forest
quests.description:
A Forest as blue as the Ocean. 

The Starlight Forest is by far the most common biome in the Starlight. 

It has dozens of Lunar Trees covering it entirely with plenty of Mobs, passive and hostile, below it.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_forest.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Dense Starlight Forest
quests.description:
Just like the normal Starlight Forest just with much less spacing within Trees!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_dense.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 4D53D9BBD8279282
quests.description: Lunar Trees can range from massive towering Trees, to itty bitty ones. They adapt to take as much room as they can! (That would explain Dense Forests). \n\nThey plant like normal Saplings and can have Lunar Berries spawn from their leaves!

quests.title: 3C74DAE7EC844A98
quests.description:
The Lunar Berries are an excellent Food Source, plus very easy to get! 

They spawn growing down from Lunar Tree Leaves, you can pluck the Berries off the Vines like Glow Berries. 
Just these give much more Food Points and Saturation!

quests.title: 7D7BD1458CF12021
quests.description: It is a Desert of course there's Cacti! \n\nThe Cacti when fully grown can grow Fruit on top of them!

quests.title: 2DA8CE213AC3869B
quests.description: Starlight Crystals can be found all over and even under the Crystallized Deserts. \n\nThey work similar to Amethyst and even sound like it!

quests.title: 15195F456D8AD4C8
quests.description: When Ether touches Water Thioquartz will form. This can happen naturally with random generation or you can make it happen! \n\nThese aren't how we get Shards though, those are from Budding Thioquartz!

quests.title: Ether River
quests.description:
Ether River is something you'll know when you see it. \n\nIt's bright, very bright and might appear red in your Map, that's a bug ignore that.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_ether.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 362F4CFD1B8B12B1
quests.description:
All living things will die in Ether as if it were Lava. Funny enough you can put it in a Bucket though! 

The only way to get it is finding it in the Ether River. 

When Water touches Ether it will form Thioquartz Blocks!

quests.title: The Gatekeeper and The Gate
quests.description:
In order to get to the Starlight Dimension you'll need to find Portal Ruins in the Overworld. 

There you will find a Gatekeeper, Right Click to initiate a conversation and challenge them to a duel! Careful, they are very tough. 

Once you win the duel you'll be gifted a few Items, the Orb of Prophecy being one. Right Click the Portal with the Orb to activate it! Then, walk in to get to the...

quests.title: 41C70F0873E14307
quests.description: There is Trees in the Desert! \n\nNo, wait, there was Trees...

quests.title: Crystallized Desert
quests.description:
Crystallized Desert looks like a normal Desert but shaded Purple. \n\nAlso with added giant crystals, I don't think normal Deserts have that...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_desert.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Gleech
quests.description:
Gleeches are tiny little mobs that spawn in the Crystallized Desert. 

They relentlessly want your blood and that means even through violent ways. Thankfully they only have 4 Hearts! 

On death they might drop their Eggs which can be thrown as a projectile.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_gleech.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Lunar Monstrosity
quests.description:
The Lunar Monstrosity has 200 Hearts and will only take 1 damage from each hit unless you use Fire. 

It has a few attacks including Ground Spikes, Projectiles, and Exploding Tangled Heads! 

When you kill it, it will drop Arrows, Ingots, Tangled Skulls, Tenacious Petals, Trapped Souls, and a chance at a rare Weapon!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_lunar.png width:100 height:125 align:center}

quests.title: Burn it!
quests.description:
In order to kill the Lunar Monstrosity you'll need to set it on Fire! 

You can use Flint and Steel or a Saltpeter Matchbox. 

Personally I think the Matchbox is more fitting!

quests.title: Cursed Garden
quests.description:
Let's see how do I describe the Cursed Garden... it's a big freakin' maze! 

There's entrances on each side and you must find your way to the middle where the Lunar Monstrosity is!

All around the maze you can find chests full of Loot and Tangled!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_maze.png width:150 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Monstrosity Items
quests.description: Vines, Red and Blue Crystal Moss Carpets, Lunar Berries, Cave Moss, and Red and Blue Crystal Roots. \n\nThese can be used in your Offhand with the Seeking Eye to find the Cursed Garden.

quests.title: Finding the Bosses
quests.description:
The Bosses in the Starlight live in their structures. These aren't common (thankfully) so you might need assistance aka the Seeking Eyes. 

Seaking Eyes work like Ender Eyes, Right Click with them to throw them and follow them to get to the structures. 

To set the structure you'll need a certain Item in your Offhand, items like...

quests.title: Golem Items
quests.description: Redstone, Golem Steel, and Oxidized Golem Steel are Items used for finding the Golem Forge. \n\nHold one of these (most likely Redstone which does spawn in the Starlight underground) in your Offhand and use the Seeking Eye to find the Golem Forge which btw is underground!

quests.title: Golem Forge
quests.description:
Using your Seeking Eyes you might become confused why they've suddenly gone underground. That's probably because the Golem Forge is deep underground, like in the negative Y levels. \n\nThere's many winding rooms each full of Loot, Lava, and Freezes! The room we are looking for holds the Starlight Golem!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_golemforge.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Powering down
quests.description:
In order to damage the Golem you'll need to turn off his power supply! 

To do so you'll need to Right Click the Energy Blocks when they turn blue. 

You can usually find 2 in the corners of the boss room and 2 above him!

quests.title: Starlight Golem
quests.description:
The Starlight Golem has 220 Hearts and 2 Modes. 

1st mode is his attack mode, here he can't be damaged instead you'll have to wait for his attacks to go before hitting him. He attacks with Fireballs, Ground Pound, or a devastating Laser Beam! 

His 2nd mode is his charging mode; in this one he'll begin taking power from the Energy Blocks which will need to be turned off in order to damage him. 

On death he will drop plenty of Ingots and Arrows, Golem Steel, Forge Armor Trim, and maybe even the Energy Sword!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_golem.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Tangled
quests.description:
Tangled are enemies that spawn within the Cursed Garden. 

They have 10 Hearts and will attack by smacking you. If you get hit, you'll get a small amount of poison. 

On death they will drop Vines and Bones but also will spawn a Tangled Skull! 

Tangled Skulls act similar to Vexes, they will fly around through blocks and hit you. They only have 5 Hearts and on death will give you them as an Item.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_tangled.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Freeze
quests.description:
Freezes work similar to Blazes, they'll fly up and shoot a ball at you. 

Just Freezes only throw 1 ball and it will make you cold instead of warm. 

They have 16 Hearts and will drop Frozen Tubes on death.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_freeze.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Thirst Walker
quests.description:
Thirst Walkers are neutral Mobs that spawn on the surface of the Crystallized Deserts. 

When aggro-ed they will hit you and give you Hunger. 

They have 20 Hearts and can drop Tooth of Hunger on death.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_thirst.png width:100 height:125 align:center}

quests.title: Crystallized Moth
quests.description:
Crystallized Moths spawn deep below the Crystallized Deserts. 

They are neutral and I recommend not hitting them because they do a ton of damage! 

They also have 10 Hearts and can drop Starlight Crystals or Shivering Gel on death.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_moth.png width:125 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ratlins
quests.description:
Ratlins are peaceful Mobs that can spawn on the Surface. 

On death they will drop Ratlin Meat, Leather, and Cave Moss. 

The latter which can be used to Breed them together!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_rat.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ents
quests.description:
Ents are another peaceful Mob spawning on the Surface of the Starlight. These spawning in the forests! 

These little trees can drop Sticks, Lunar Berries, and Lunar Leaves on death. 

You can use Lunar Berries to Breed them!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_ent.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 0F4783FA019C4567
quests.description: Amaraber is found rarely by stripping Torreya Logs. \n\nIt can be crafted into Ingots to make Armor and Tools or used in other recipes like a campfire which will you give you regen!

quests.title: 0F0D41F29386333A
quests.description: Scarlet Trees range in size and shape and even sometimes fallen down! \n\nBut all have pink leaves! Including the ones on the ground.

quests.title: 1BE8F864AB9147C0
quests.description: Atalphaite Ore can be found when Mining anywhere underground in the Starlight. \n\nIt can't be made into Tools or Armor but it can make different types of Lights!

quests.title: 5424A0E1292B13EE
quests.description:
Around the Starlight you might find Hot Ponds. 

(These aren't a biome or structure so you'll need to just look around to find them!) 

Within them you can find Thermal Springstone.

quests.title: 47CB136D7764B86D
quests.description:
Torreya Vines are found hanging from Torreya Trees. 

They are hanging because they can't be placed any other way... 

The bulb at the bottom of them will emit Light!

quests.title: Torreya Forest
quests.description:
A bright and beautiful Forest, full of Torreya Trees and Vines.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_torreya.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Eternal Starlight
quests.description:
The Starlight! 

A Dimension where it is constantly Dusk, and no you can't change that. 

There is dozens of Biomes, Mobs, Bosses, and even just Blocks to find! Can you discover them all?

quests.title: Scarlet Forest
quests.description:
IT'S PINK! \n\nHere you will find Scarlet Trees with their dropped leaves piled below them. You can also find Glowing Mushrooms here!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_scarlet.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 7AB2FECE47F558F8
quests.description:
Stellagmite can be found underground in the Starlight. 

It works as a normal Stone being able to be made into other Blocks. 

Its Molten version works as a normal Magma Block!

quests.title: 7B5D34650BBD97D9
quests.description:
Very rarely in the Starlight Dimension a Meteor Shower might occur. 

Most times the Meteors are tiny and disappear before hitting the ground. 

But some are bigger and survive, there you will find Aethersent Ore!

quests.title: 1ECD4331DDFBBB52
quests.description: Torreya Trees are huge purple/pink Trees that stand around 40 Blocks tall. \n\nThe leaves will sprout out in every direction and the Torreya Vines hang from them.

quests.title: 144ECED643031A9A
quests.description:
Glowing Mushrooms are huge Mushroom plants you can find in the Scarlet Forests! 

They function just like Brown or Red Mushrooms just these ones Glow much brighter! 

(If you didn't know Brown and Red Mushrooms actually emit a Light Source level of 1).

quests.title: 4D0B50731FED3CEE
quests.description: To get the Cresant Spear you will need to either craft it from Items dropped by the Lunar Monstrosity and the Tangled Hatred, or have it dropped from the Lunar Monstrosity. (You'll have to kill him regardless basically). \n\nYou can use the Spear like a Trident and just smack Mobs or you can hold Right Click to be sent flying forward with it. If you hit any Mobs with the second attack, any Mobs nearby will also take damage.

quests.title: 713548E540B18E07
quests.description: The Moonring Bow can only drop from the Lunar Monstrosity. \n\nIt shoots Arrows like a normal Bow but Ground Spikes will come the same direction the Arrow went!

quests.title: 0C096EE635645E43
quests.description: The Crystal Crossbow is a crafted like a Mechanical Crossbow just with Crystals instead of sticks. \n\nIt shoots Arrows and does same damage as a normal Crossbow but this one gives Crystal Infection. Crystal Infection does 1 damage every second with the Crystals that spawn on them! And yes it will kill them.

quests.title: 29283BF1B6ED3634
quests.description: The Mechanical Crossbow is made like a normal Crossbow just with Golem Steel. \n\nIt works like a normal Crossbow just much stronger! And can be enchanted to do even more!

quests.title: Nightfall Spiders
quests.description:
Nightfall Spiders, like Lonestar Skeletons, are Hostile and spawn anywhere. 

They have 5 Hearts and attack by hitting you. After hitting you they will give you the Glowing effect for a few seconds. 

On death they will drop String and their eyes!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_spider.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Lonestar Skeletons
quests.description:
Lonestar Skeletons are hostile Mobs that can spawn anywhere. 

They have 10 Hearts and will throw their Sword at you to attack you. 

On death they can drop Bones, Swamp Silver Nuggets, Shattered Swords, and the drops added by Corail for Undead Mobs.

quests.title: Shimmer Lacewing
quests.description:
Shimmer Lacewings don't do or drop anything, they just add atmosphere. \n\nThey also resemble the only bug I tolerate!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_shimmer.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 4A5EA948F5DCEB73
quests.description: Swamp Silver can be rarely found within the Nightfall Mud. \n\nIt can be used to craft Armor and Tools!

quests.title: 54DE8AAAE2181F18
quests.description: The Moonring Greatsword needs to be crafted from drops by both Bosses! Obviously making it the hardest to get and the most powerful! \n\nIt works like a normal Sword, just before 1.9. It can block attacks like a shield, but it can't be spammed for full damage.

quests.title: 62F33BBE7BDFE404
quests.description:
Wand of Teleportation is another drop from the Lunar Monstrosity, and only that! 

You can hold Right Click with the Wand to start it, then when you release it will teleport you to the Block you were looking at last! 

There is a range but it's pretty far. And there is a cooldown after use!

quests.title: 713EF442D59501BA
quests.description:
The Chain of Souls can only be crafted from drops by the Tangled Hatred and Lunar Monstrosity. 

It's a grappling hook! Tap Right Click to send it and once it hits something it will start reeling you in. Then, you have to Right Click again to detach it. 

Also needed for the ATM Star!

quests.title: 70A82A5D17D558FB
quests.description: The Energy Sword can only be dropped from the Starlight Golem. \n\nIt works like a normal Sword but with Right Click you can dash at them while swinging it, like Genji from Overwatch!

quests.title: 49D1EA8E812A12F6
quests.description:
It's just a neat plant. 

You'll need a Swamp Silver Sickle to collect it! 

I don't know why I've never cared about plants but Reeds are cool to me. Maybe it's the being by Water, or Cattails looking like Corndogs. I don't know but I like them.

quests.title: Dark Swamp
quests.description:
Dark Swamps litter the world of the Starlight. \n\nHere you can find plenty of plants, animals, and of course Mud.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_swamp.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 7FF77463F2A0E210
quests.description: Nightfall Mud can only be found within the Dark Swamps. \n\nYou can make more Blocks out of it!

quests.title: Warm Shore
quests.description:
The Warm Shore is a pretty boring Biome and is mostly for connecting the Starlit Sea and land. \n\nIt has Twilight Sand with Stone beneath it. I also found, more than usual, Saltpeter here.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_shore.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 5DFE3CB5B0130A7A
quests.description: There's plenty of plant life on top of the Shimmer River, some you can stand on!

quests.title: Shimmer River
quests.description:
Shimmer Rivers are friendly rivers. These won't go out of their way to kill you. 

They sometimes connect Seas together and go through Forests. 

Clearly they have Water but within the Water is plenty of goods!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_river.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 5466CB622A637DCD
quests.description: Abyssal Fruit technically can spawn in any body of water but its the only one that lives within the Shimmer Rivers. \n\nIt grows like Kelp from the floor up, but also works like Glowberries as in Fruit grows and can be collected from it.

quests.title: 271A112ABDD923A6
quests.description: Like normal Mangrove but these aren't ugly.

quests.title: 127D085D6C9DB690
quests.description:
Saltpeter can be found anywhere Underground but very common in the Warm Shore Biome. 

It needs a Stone Pickaxe to mine it and when mined it will drop a couple Saltpeter Powder. Yes, Fortune works on it! 

The Powder can be used as a replacement for other Niters.

quests.title: 01F322AEFCC6109E
quests.description:
Tangled Skulls can be dropped from... well Tangled Skulls. 

They can be used as a projectile like a Wither Head thrown from a Wither. 

It will be used up when you do that though.

quests.title: 516AC1F0E0BCAE55
quests.description: Frozen Tubes are dropped from Freezes in the Golem Forge. \n\nThey can be thrown like Potions to hurt whoever it hits.

quests.title: 37355F60E45777FE
quests.description: The Orb of Prophecy can be crafted or obtained through beating the Gatekeeper! \n\nIt's main use is activating the Portal, but there will be more uses for it!

quests.title: 29EC143D7E0347DE
quests.description:
The Dagger of Hunger is made with the Teeth of Hunger. No, I am not saying Tooths. 

The Dagger has a Hunger Value. When you hit Mobs it will go up, when it's inactive it will decrease. When it gets to 100% you'll get boosts. And if it goes to 0% it will start killing you. 

When you hit Mobs (or Players) it will also give the Hunger effect. 

I don't blame it, I get angry when hungry too.

quests.title: 1533D98B3B2A758E
quests.description: Shattered Swords can either be dropped from Lonestar Skeletons or crafted using the dropped Blades. \n\nThe Shattered Sword is used more like a Trident than a Sword, instead of hitting you'll throw it. Then, you can Right Click to bring back the Blade like a Loyalty Trident, and Right Click again to reload it if needed.

quests.title: 17D82EEA20D02EC8
quests.description: Lining the Sea floor is Dusted Gravel. \n\nIt can be used as a replacement for normal Gravel and can rarely drop Dusted Shards which can make other Blocks!

quests.title: 4D8C9960BB675221
quests.description: It has a funny name!

quests.title: Starlit Sea
quests.description:
Starlit Seas are huge bodies of Water sitting neatly between the Warm Shores and land. 

They hold many wonders within them and growing in them! 

Hope you brought your goggles!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_starlitsea.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 25E782DB4309A1B8
quests.description: Aurora Deer Antlers are dropped by Aurora Deers on death. \n\nIt can be used as a Sword or a Hoe.

quests.title: 71C58666D4BC2508
quests.description: Works like Flint and Steel!

quests.title: 3D4032E7119AF8B7
quests.description:
Sonar Bombs are made with Shivering Gel which is dropped from Crystallized Moths. 

They can be thrown to damage any Mob (and Player) in a huge area! It will also shake the players screen and play a loud sound effect. 

It is disorienting so only use it on your friends!

quests.title: 7FBB431AC055FE93
quests.description:
The Soulit Spectator is crafted with a Trapped Soul and a Nightfal Spider Eye. 

It works similar to a Sticky Camera from Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell. You can Right Click to send the Spectator and after a bit you will be able to see out of it. You can even see yourself with it! 

It can't be ended early so careful when you use it. It also has durability and a cooldown.

quests.title: 484ABFF266C8791E
quests.description:
Orbflora are plants that grow from the Sea floor. 

They can be harvested anytime but if you want the Orbflora Lights you'll need to wait! 

When they grow to the Sea Level they will flower. After flowering they will grow the Light!

quests.title: 298963543B99734E
quests.description: The Starlit Seas spawn their own versions of Coral! \n\nJust don't be like me and forget Silk Touch to pick them up...

quests.title: 4A54288FD22C903D
quests.description:
Velvetumoss spawns within The Abyss. 

You can mine green ones to get Velvetumoss Balls which can either be eaten or made into a Slimeball! 

The Red ones will spawn pretty plants!

quests.title: The Abyss
quests.description: The Abyss are deep trenches within Starlit Seas. These going as far down as -50! \n\nThey have multiple colored layers of Stone lining them and hold many different Blocks, Mosses, and Fish!

quests.title: 342EEB042DEC2B8C
quests.description:
Magma and Geysers both spawn on the bottom of The Abyss. 

Magma will help you get down below and help keep your breath. 

Geysers just look cool!

quests.title: Twilight Gaze
quests.description:
Twilight Gaze are a neutral Fish located in The Abyss. 

If you hit one, all will attack you, similar to Wolves or Zombified Piglins. If you get too far from The Abyss they will stop following you and swim back to the depths. 

They don't drop anything on death so maybe don't hit them...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_gaze.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Luminaris
quests.description:
Acts exactly like a Luminofish just these have a horn on their head!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_fish2.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Luminofish
quests.description:
The Luminofish is a glowing fish that lives within The Abyss.\n\nThey act just like normal Fish. You can fish for them, put them in a Bucket, you can even cook them!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/eternal/starlight_fish1.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 4C7E006502E30C20
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: The Undergarden
quests.subtitle: Making the Portal
quests.description:
Getting to the Undergarden is similar to getting to The Nether. You'll need to craft a Portal. 

It is the same shape and size as Nether Portals but instead of Obsidian you'll need a varient of Stone Bricks. Stone Bricks, Mossy Stone Bricks, or Deepslate Bricks. 

Once formed, you can activate it by using the Catalyst on it.

quests.title: Ancient Sea
quests.description:
Ancient Seas are wide open Seas in the Undergarden. 

Somehow even with the amount of pollutants the Water is safe to drink. 

The Water also holds Gwibs and Gwiblings. And can't forget Glitterkelp!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_ancient.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Barren Abyss
quests.description:
The Barren Abyss is as the name suggests, barren... It holds nothing but Hostile Mobs and Pebbles. \n\nPersonally I'd rather find Pebbles anywhere else...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_barren.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Blood Mushroom Bog
quests.description:
The Blood Mushroom Bog is home to the giant Blood Mushrooms. \n\nBlood makes me uneasy so I think I'll keep this description short.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_blood.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Dead Sea
quests.description:
Picture the Ancient Sea. Okay now remove all Kelp from it and remove all Gwibs and Gwiblings. \n\nThat is the Dead Sea for you!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_dead.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 2C5A7E4CD8B57E08
quests.description: Grongle Trees are tall Jungle like Trees that only spawn in Gronglegrowth Biomes! \n\nThese Trees are also where Gronglets spawn on.

quests.title: 6D4FB6291CA8D1A6
quests.description:
Smogstem Trees are much thicker on their bottom halves, similar to Baobab Trees in real life! 

They have Blue Leaves with Grey Logs. 
You can find them in multiple Biomes: Smogstem Forests, Dense Forests, and even in Indigo Mushroom Bogs!

quests.title: 51C59FDF0BD11FDF
quests.description:
I'm pretty sure the only definition of what a Wigglewood Tree is that it has Wigglewood Logs and Leaves. They seem to grow in any direction, size, and shape. 

You can find them in Wigglewood Forests and Dense Forests. 

They have pretty pink Leaves and brown Logs similar to Spruce!

quests.title: Dense Forest
quests.description:
Some people hate exploring many different Biomes to get all the different Tree Saplings. \n\nClearly the Undergarden Dev did, so he put most of them in the Dense Forest!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_dense.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Forgotten Fields
quests.description:
Forgotten Fields are the Plains of the Undergarden. 

They don't have Trees but they have plenty of Rocks, Flowers, and Mobs! 

They do not spawn Forgottens though, yeah sorry to ruin your enthusiasm.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_field.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Frostfields
quests.description:
Frostfields are one of the cold Biomes in the Undergarden. You can tell it is cold by the massive icesicles, Powdered Snow, and Frozen Deepturf! 

Also here instead of the usual Depthrock underground you will find Shiverstone. 

Shiverstone acts more like Ice than real Stone. Well atleast when standing on it!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_frosty.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Frosty Smogstem Forest
quests.description:
Near Frostfields you may find Frosty Smogstem Forests. \n\nThese are just like Frostfields just with Smogstem Trees!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_frostytrees.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 6751F2651063B3A5
quests.description: Blood Mushrooms can be found within their Bogs. \n\nThey are shaped like Dark Oak Trees and are mostly White with only some blocks having Blood spots on them!

quests.title: 4C5CFA45D9B4F6D3
quests.description: Indigo Mushrooms are apparently bestfriends with Smogstem and will spawn mainly with them!

quests.title: 739601B0C43B239B
quests.description: Yes they can make Black Dye!

quests.title: 0FA77C28A57E06F1
quests.description: Veiled Mushrooms can only be found in their Bog. \n\nThey have Brown Caps which if there is Air below it, it will spawn Mushroom Veils. Hence the name!

quests.title: Welcome to the Undergarden!
quests.description: The Undergarden Dimension is full of diverse and disgusting Biomes full of plenty of Vegetation, Mobs: friendly and unfriendly, and of course Ores and Items. \n\nHope you're ready for a fight!

quests.title: Gronglegrowth
quests.description:
My favorite Biome by far! 

A giant Green Jungle with huge Gronglegrowth Trees. 

On those Trees you can find Gronglets!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_grongle.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Icy Sea
quests.description:
Another Sea, just this one is much colder.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_icy.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Indigo Mushroom Bog
quests.description:
Indigo Mushroom Bog is much more filled Bog than the Blood Mushroom Bog. \n\nOf course it has Indigo Mushrooms but also Mini Smogstem Trees and ponds of Virulent Mix. I wonder what it does...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_indigo.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Ink Mushroom Bog
quests.description:
A purple Bog! \n\nThese have Ink Mushrooms and Virulent Mix all over!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_ink.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 6F416275B6F6D8F0
quests.description:
Blisterberries spawn in Smog Spires. 

Because they grow in such a disgusting area some will come Rotten. 

I don't recommend eating those, maybe they can be useful for something else!

quests.title: 4568C2F465EDB960
quests.description: Droopfruit can spawn pretty much in any Biome just look up! \n\nThey spawn on the roof of most Biomes and will grow similar to Glowberries.

quests.title: 08D9C809CF4062E8
quests.description: Eat em raw, roast them, put them on a Stick. \n\nWhat can't you do with Underbeans!

quests.title: Smog Spires
quests.description:
The Smog Spires are... yep you guessed it! Where all the Smog comes from! Well not all, we can't discredit the Mogs and S'mogs. \n\nHere you will find Blisterberries, Coarse Deepsoil, and Smog Vents. I wouldn't recommend going near them though...
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_smogspires.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Smogstem Forest
quests.description:
Smogstem Forest is a neighboring Biome to Indigo Mushroom Bogs. \n\nOf course it is also Blue and has Indigo Mushrooms in it! Just has bigger Smogstem Trees!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_smogstem.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Veil Mushroom Bog
quests.description:
I promise this is the last Mushroom Bog! 
These Mushrooms look pretty normal, their gimmick though is what comes from them! 

The Veils! Definitely a useful decoration Block.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_veil.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Wigglewood Forest
quests.description:
Wigglewood Forests are forests like all others. \n\nJust these Trees like to go as they please.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_wiggle.png width:200 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: 43A1BC20BB054A14
quests.description: Glitterkelp grows in Ancient and Icy Seas. \n\nThey don't do much but Glow and can be crafted into Pie!

quests.title: 22739522F0D33D7B
quests.description:
Gloomgourds spawn and farm like Pumpkins. 

Also like Pumpkins they can be made into Pie or even Jack-O-Lanterns! 

Unlike Pumpkins they can be made into explosives...

quests.title: Warning
quests.description: In The Undergarden, Rot Mobs can infect you with Utherium. In lower doses, this infection will decay over time. In high enough doses, it won't decay, and will have to be cured with Rogdorium, which is only found deep in the Dreadrock regions. You can either consume it, or infuse your armor with it to ward off this infection. I'll even give you some Rogdorium on the house!

quests.title: Forgotten Minions
quests.description:
Forgotten Minions aren't spawned like normal Mobs, they need to be created. They are created by placing a Carved Gloomgourd over a Block of Forgotten Ingots. 

They act similar to Snow Golems, they won't ever attack you and instead shoot at Hostile Mobs. 

They have 10 Hearts and don't drop anything on death... but like why would you kill them?
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_minion.png width:125 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Gronglets
quests.description:
Gronglets are technically Blocks not Mobs. But I love them too much to not include them! \n\nThey spawn on Grongle Trees and emit Noise and Light! Definitely perfect for decoration.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_gronglet.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Sploogie
quests.description:
Sploogies can rarely spawn but when they do they are destined to annoy you. 

They will shoot spit at you (and make disgusting sucking noises) but if you hit them they will run away; similar to a baby Piglin. 

They only drop Depthrock Pebbles on death.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_sploogie.png width:125 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Nargoyle
quests.description:
Nargoyles are nasty and hostile Mobs that spawn underground. 

They have 7 and a half Hearts and will relentlessly try to kill you. 

They drop nothing and just serve as an obstacle for those trying to peacefully mine.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_nargoyle.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Muncher
quests.description:
Munchers are similar to any other Hostile Mobs in the Undergarden, but this ones drops makes it much more useful! \n\nThe Muncher can drop Cloggrum and Froststeel Nuggets on death.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_muncher.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Dweller
quests.description:
Dwellers are the Cows of Undergarden. 
They are Passive and will drop Leather and Dweller Meat on death. 

Thank God they can't be milked, I don't want any milk these Dwellers make.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_dweller.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Gwibling
quests.description: Gwiblings are friendly fish in the Seas. \n\nThey are smaller than Gwibs and act like Vanilla Fish!

quests.title: Scintling
quests.description:
Scintlings are little innocent Slugs found everywhere in the Undergarden. 

They act like Snow Golems as in they leave a trail wherever they walk. Just this one is more Gooey... 

On death they drop Scintling Goo, but you can just farm it from their trails, so why kill them!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_scintling.png width:150 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Gloomper
quests.description:
Gloompers are technically Passive but they have a defense mechanism against you so I consider them Neutral! 

When hit they will drop an Effect similar to a Lingering Potion. 

On death they will drop their Legs (which are very tasty) and possibly Leather. 

They can also be bred with Gloomgourds!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_gloomper.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Stoneborn
quests.description:
Stoneborns are the perfect mix of Villagers and Iron Golems. 

You can trade with them by Right Clicking them. 

And they will fight off Hostile Mobs (or Players who hit them).
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_stoneborn.png width:100 height:150 align:center}

quests.title: Brutes
quests.description:
Brutes spawn in a few Biomes and are Neutral. 

If hit, all in the area will attack you. Similar to Wolves or Zombified Piglins. 

On death they might drop their Tusks, which can act as a replacement for Bones!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_brute.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Gwib
quests.description:
Gwibs are larger and angrier versions of Gwiblings. \n\nThey don't have any Drops nor can they be placed in Buckets. All they offer is pain!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_gwib.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Forgotten
quests.description:
Forgottens are warriors that spawn within the Catacomb Structure. 

They wear Ancient Armor and hold Cloggrum Tools, all which can be dropped upon death. 

They will also target and kill Rot Mobs.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_forgotten.png width:100 height:200 align:center}

quests.title: Forgotten Guardian
quests.description:
The Forgotten Guardian is a massive Golem made of Forgotten Ingots. 

It'll target the Player and will do whatever needed to kill them. 

They have 80 Hearts and if you can kill them they will drop Forgotten Nuggets.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_guardian.png width:100 height:200 align:center}

quests.title: Catacombs
quests.description:
Catacombs are massive underground structures made of Depthrock Bricks. They might have a part sticking out of the ground you can find. 

Within the huge maze lies Forgottens, hidden Chests, and the boss: Forgotten Guardian. 

Hope you're prepared for it!

quests.title: S'Mog
quests.description:
Is that Smogvent moving? No wait it's just a S'Mog! The close cousin of the Mog! \n\nThey act exactly like Mogs just these might drop Blue Mogmoss.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_smog.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Mog
quests.description:
Is that rock moving? Oh wait that isn't a rock, it's a Mog! 

Mogs can be bred together with Depthrock Pebbles and on death might drop more Pebbles or Mogmoss! 

Mogmoss can be used in many different recipes!
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_mog.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Rotling
quests.description:
The smallest and weakest of the Rot Mobs. 

These have 5 Hearts. 

Like all Rot Mobs they will target Stoneborns and Forgottens and will drop Utheric Shards.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_rotling.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Rotwalker
quests.description:
The medium sized Rot Mob, the Rotwalker. 

They have 20 Hearts. 

Like all Rot Mobs they will target Stoneborns and Forgottens and will drop Utheric Shards.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_rotwalker.png width:100 height:200 align:center}

quests.title: Rotbeast
quests.description:
The largest and most dangerous Rot Mob. 

They have 80 Hearts, which I think qualifies as a Miniboss. 

Like all Rot Mobs they will target Stoneborns and Forgottens and will drop Utheric Shards.
{image:atm:textures/questpics/undergarden/undergarden_rotbeast.png width:100 height:100 align:center}

quests.title: Cloggrum Tools
quests.description: Cloggrum Tools act just like Iron Tools, these just look more like Mud than Iron does! \n\nThe Sword does more damage than an Iron Sword though.

quests.title: Cloggrum Weapons
quests.description:
Normal Tools just won't suffice especially when handling the dangerous Mobs in the Undergarden. 

We can craft the Cloggrum Shield which acts like a normal Shield. 

But we will need to get the Battleaxe as a rare drop from Forgottens.

quests.title: Froststeel Tools
quests.description: Similar to Iron Tools just all of these slow down whoever is hit by them. \n\nWell besides the Hoe, but do you really care about a simple hoe?

quests.title: Ultimate Weapon!
quests.description: Upgrade your Cloggrum Battleaxe to make the greatest weapon Undergarden can give!

quests.title: Forgotten Tools
quests.description:
Upgrade Cloggrum Tools with Forgotten Ingots and a Smithing Template. 

These are the best Tools you can get, they come with Efficiency on them already just for Undergarden Blocks. 

And the Sword and Axe will deal more damage to all Undergarden Mobs but the Rot Beast and Forgotten Guardian!

quests.title: Utheric Tools
quests.description: Utherium Tools are similar to Diamond Tools but the weapons are more effective to Rot Mobs! \n\nYou use what they make to do more damage to them! There's probably a dozen of pop culture references I can make with that but I can't think of any...

quests.title: 1190BB433EFA3945
quests.description:
Slingshot is a very fun weapon added by Undergarden. It has 4 Ammo that can be shot: 

Scintling Goo can be fired and when it hits a Mob it'll give them the Gooey Effect. 

Depthrocks are just normal projectiles. 

Rotten Blisterberries will blow up on impact. 

And Gronglets don't do any damage they just make noise and get shot!

quests.title: Explosives!!!
quests.description: Rotten Blisterberries can't be thrown but when made into Blisterbombs they can be! \n\nYou can even go farther and make Boomgourds which will act like TNT that throws Blisterberries everywhere.

quests.title: Cloggrum
quests.description:
Cloggrum is the Iron of the Undergarden. 

It is found everywhere and is used in a dozen different recipes. 

Heck even some Mobs drop it!

quests.title: Froststeel
quests.description:
Froststeel spawns in the Frozen Biomes: Frostfields, Frosty Smogstem Forests, and probably Icy Seas. 

It spawns in Shiverstone which replaces Depthrock in these Biomes. The Shiverstone will act similar to Ice as in it is slippery and slows you down a little. 

You might also find some Nuggets in Munchers bellies!

quests.title: Forgotten
quests.description: Forgotten Ingots need to be obtained through the Catacombs; whether it be looting the Chests or killing the Forgotten Guardian. \n\nYou'll also need a Smithing Template which is found in Catacomb Chests.

quests.title: Utheric
quests.description: Utherium can either be Mined or dropped from Rot Mobs.

quests.title: Regalium
quests.description: Regalium is the Emerald equivalent in Undergarden. \n\nIt can't be made into Armor or Tools but it can be used to trade with Stoneborns for other Items.

quests.title: Cloggrum Armor
quests.description: Cloggrum has stats a little worse than Iron Armor, but it pratically grows on Trees so I think that's fair. \n\nThe Boots also help with going through Scintling Goo!

quests.title: Froststeel Armor
quests.description: Froststeel Armor is slightly worse than Diamond Armor but it also gives big Knockback Resistance. \n\nIt also gives Speed debuff though, looks like we ain't moving much!

quests.title: Utherium Armor
quests.description: Utherium Armor has same stats as Netherite Armor! \n\nWithout needing a Smithing Template!

quests.title: Ancient Armor
quests.description: Ancient Armor is what's worn by Forgottens, and is where you can get it from. \n\nThere isn't any Ancient Boots though, apparently Forgottens don't have feet.

quests.title: Creating a Team
quests.description: If you want to create a team for you and your friends, use the command /ftbteams party create (name of team) to create the team!

quests.title: Useful Commands
quests.description:
There are plenty of helpful commands within ATM. Here are a few:

/sethome (name of home) | Let's you set a home that you can teleport back to using /home (name). Example: /sethome farm - then teleport with /home farm.

/spawn | This will teleport you to the spawn of your overworld.

/rtp | 'Random Teleport' will teleport you to a random location in the world.

Note: These commands have cooldowns and limits. If you'd like to change them, you can edit the config file which can be found here:

 - For Singleplayer | saves/(name of save)/serverconfig/ftbessentials.snbt

 - For Servers | world/serverconfig/ftbessentials.snbt

quests.title: Quests
quests.description: In this modpack, quests are optional. Mods are not gated behind completing any quests!\n\nA lot of the individual questlines outside of the Main questline are meant to serve as mod guides. If you want to follow the progression, make sure to check out the Main Questline!

quests.title: Claiming Chunks
quests.description:
To claim chunks, open up your map using M, then click the Claimed Chunks icon in the top left.

To claim a chunk, left click and drag to claim.

To force load a chunk, shift-left click the chunk. If done properly, you'll see lines across the chunk.

quests.title: Welcome to All the Mons!
quests.description:
All the Mons is a kitchensink pack that includes Cobblemon.

The pack uses All the Mods - 10 as a base, but changes some stuff around in order to work with Cobblemon.

If you have any questions or issues, feel free to join the ATM Discord!

quests.title: 49EDAA2F57D3BF1D
quests.description:

quests.title: 08B60D8A25008CCC
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Zombie Variants
quests.description:
Zombies have different varients that spawn in other Biomes. 

Husks- spawn in Deserts. 
Drowned- spawn Underwater. 
Gelid- spawn in Cold Biomes. 
Thickets- spawn in Jungles.

quests.title: Skeleton Variants
quests.description:
Skeletons have different varients, like Zombies do! 

Strays- spawn in Cold Biomes. 
Bogged- spawn in Swamps and Trial Chambers. 
Murks- spawn underwater in Coral Reefs. 
Verdants- spawn in Jungles.

quests.title: Overhauled Creepers
quests.description:
Overhauled Creepers gives us many different varients of Creepers for different Biomes. 

Each have different drops and even some are friendly! 

All are afraid of cats though...

quests.title: Overhauled Endermen
quests.description: Overhauled Endermen is a similar Mod to Overhauled Creepers! Just with Endermen of course! \n\nYou'll find all these Endermen in all different Biomes and each are unique in their own ways! Some have different attacks, some drop different Pearls, and they all look different!

quests.title: Bounty Board
quests.subtitle: Killing All The Things
quests.description: Here you'll find all of the rewards you can get by slaying enemies.

quests.title: Kill The Ender Dragon
quests.description:
The Ender Dragon is the Boss that guards The End. 

When you enter an End Portal you'll arrive at the End Island where she spawns. 

She has 200 Hearts and can attack with Fireballs or ramming into you. 

You'll have to break the End Crystals on the pillars as they heal her, in order to kill her! 

Once you do kill her, she'll drop: Arcane Essence, Epic Shaderbags, Dragonskin, Dragon Scales from two different mods, and a bunch of experience! 

Then the Portal will open up so you can return to the Overworld, or you can find an End Gateway to explore the outer islands. You'll also find a Dragon Egg on the Portal.

quests.title: Kill The Wither
quests.description:
The Wither is the second Minecraft Boss, this one being more elective. 

You'll have to build the Wither to spawn him in. Using 4 Soul Sand in a T shape and placing 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls on top will spawn him in! 

He has 300 Hearts and will fly around shooting Wither Skulls at Players or Mobs. 

When taken to half Health he will gain a shield against Projectiles and will need to be killed with a Sword or Axe. 

Once you kill him he'll drop: Nether Star, chance at a Withering Soul, and a ton of Corail Items.

quests.title: Kill The Warden
quests.description:
The Warden is a boss added in 1.20. 

He spawns by having 3 naturally spawning Sculk Shriekers going off in a row, or any Shriekers going off after a first Warden has spawned. 

He is the most powerful Mob added by Minecraft, with 500 Hearts and over 20 Hearts damage with his attacks. 

His attacks include hitting you and Sonar Blasts for those farther. 

His only weakness is being blind, but like daredevil it just made his other senses much stronger! If you are close he can smell you and careful with making noise! 

If you somehow kill him he will drop: Sculk Catalysts, Warden Carapace, and Heart of the Deep.

quests.title: Kill The Lunar Monstrosity
quests.description: The Lunar Monstrosity is the first Boss added in Eternal Starlight. \n\nThis one lives in the middle of the Cursed Garden, good luck finding and fighting him!

quests.title: Kill The Starlight Golem
quests.description: The Starlight Golem is the second Boss in the Eternal Starlight. \n\nHe is charging in the Golem Forge awaiting for a Player to come fight him!

quests.title: Kill The Wilden Chimera
quests.description: The Wilden Chimera is a Boss added by Ars Nouveau and is needed for progressing through it. \n\nHe needs to be summoned through a ritual then fought!

quests.title: Kill The Forgotten Guardian
quests.description: The Forgotten Guardian is the Boss of the Undergarden. \n\nHe rests in the Catacomb Structure.

quests.title: Kill A Ravager
quests.description:
The Ravager is a Miniboss that only spawns in harder Raids. 

If you don't know what Raids are or don't understand the updated way, that's perfectly fine, that's what Quests are for! 

By killing Pillager Captains (ones that are holding Banners) you can get Ominous Potions, when you drink them you'll get Bad Omen Effect. Then, you can walk near a Village and start a Raid. 

Raids will spawn Pillagers, Vindicators, Evokers, Witches, and Ravagers to fight!

quests.title: Kill A Elder Guardian
quests.description:
The Elder Guardian was considered a third Boss for Minecraft before the Warden, but I consider him a Miniboss. 

The Elder Guardians spawn in Ocean Monuments. Three of them spawn there and will inflict Mining Fatigue on anyone nearby. 

If you want the treasures of the OCean Monument, you'll need to find and kill them! (Tip: I've always found 1 in the top Room, 1 on the far left, and 1 on the far right!) 

They have 80 Hearts and attack like normal Guardians, Lasers and Thorns! 

On death they will drop: Sponges, Prismarine, and their lunch...

quests.title: Kill A Piglin Brute
quests.description:
Piglin Brutes being here might cause controversey but I consider them Minibosses. 

They spawn in Bastions with regular Piglins but these are Hostile not Neutral. Personally I hate that, especially since if you hit them all Piglins will turn Hostile on you. 

They have 50 Hearts and a Golden Axe to hit you. Usually Golden Axes barely do any damage, but when they use it, it is god somehow! 

They drop nothing and act more like an obstacle for Bastions!

quests.title: Kill A Rotbeast
quests.description: Rotbeasts are Minibosses that spawn all over the Undergarden.

quests.title: Kill The Trader Villager and His Annoying Llamas
quests.subtitle: "This is Personal" - AlfredGG
quests.description:
While making a lot of the questlines for ATM7, the Trader Villager thought it'd be funny to constantly push me around in the quest screen.

"Take them out. All of them."

- AlfredGG 

"I second this!" 

- Toshiba

quests.title: Builds from our friends
quests.description:
All the beautiful Builds you see on this Quest Page are from people in the ATM Discord! 

Don't worry all have given consent to sharing their Builds and have been credited! 

If you wish to share your Builds as well, check out the artwork-builds-showoff Channel in the Discord! 

(I can not assure that all Builds were made in ATMons only that they were made by fellow Minecraft Players. Same ways that some might use Shaders, so if your Builds aren't exactly the same that could be why!)

quests.title: Construction Sticks
quests.description:
Ever miss Construction Wands? 

Well I did, and so did Mrbysco! So he made Construction Sticks! 

There's a few different Tier of Construction Stick. The more expensive they are, the more Durability they have and the more Blocks they can place. 

They will start by just placing Blocks to fill a space, but their options can be changed by opening their GUI. You'll need to set a Keybind yourself to do it. 

Once you open it, you can change everything about them. Where they place Blocks, in what pattern, and even what Blocks to place down! 

They also have their own Upgrades you can Craft. To use them, combine the Upgrade with your Construction Stick in a Smithing Table.

quests.title: Building Gadgets
quests.description:
Building Gadgets 2 is a Mod that adds a few very helpful Items. 

All for of course, building! 

Each requires Energy to work and has a Menu which is pulled up by default G.

quests.title: Chisel Reborn
quests.description:
Chisel Reborn is another Mod based off of Chiseled. 

The essence of the Mod is using the Chisel Tool to change the designs of some Blocks. 

You can Right Click with the Chisel to open its GUI, there you can put up to a stack of Blocks into it, then choose a design you want, and take it out. Or you can keep it in the Chisel, I don't see why you would want to though. 

You can also Left Click a Block with the Chisel to change its design without opening the Chisel GUI! 

Don't worry this one doesn't have Durability.

quests.title: 51E77B9CD3FB6DEA
quests.description:
This isn't necessary but I find it very helpful. 

The Digging Claws increases your Pickaxe Tier, for your Hands. So you can Mine up to Iron Ore with just your Fists! 

That also includes mining things like Stone, Terracotta, and Concrete. And you can even mine those with the Blocks in your Hands. 

Honestly it basically is needed.

quests.title: Rechiseled
quests.description:
A continuation of Chiseled, Rechiseled! 

All of this Mod works within the Chisel Tool, Right Click with it to pull up its GUI. 
On the Left is where you choose the design and the Bottom Right is where you put the Blocks. 

Above it you can view the design in set patterns: just the 1 Block, 3x1 Blocks, or 3x3 Wall of that Block. You can also set the image to either spin or not spin by clicking the button! 

Next to where the Blocks go, you can click the Chisel, doing this will set the selected design, to every Block in your Inventory that can be changed. 

Also does not have Durability!

quests.title: Paxel
quests.description:
Tools are very important in Minecraft but so is inventory space. So why not clear some space up by making a Paxel! 
Paxels are a combination of Pickaxes (P), Axes (axe), and Shovels (els). 

They can strip wood, make paths, and mine any blocks that same pickaxe/axe/shovel tier can!

quests.title: Changing Blocks
quests.description: Minecraft already adds hundreds of Blocks, and Mods add hundreds more! But sometimes it is still not enough. \n\nWith some Mods we can change the Blocks we already have into ones with different shapes, designs, and even into entirely new Blocks!

quests.title: Tools!
quests.description:
To build you will need Tools. And you will want Tools. 

Tools that can help you get Blocks, Tools to help you get different versions of those Blocks, and Tools to help you place Blocks! 

You'll need to start with a Stick!

quests.title: Compact Machines
quests.description:
Compact Machines allow you to enter a compacted dimension. After placing a Compact Machine, you can enter it using the Personal Shrinking Device.

The size of the Compact Machine is dependent on the recipe, ranging from 5x5x5 to 45x45x45!

You can't break the Compact Machine's walls, and you can exit by Right Clicking the Personal Shrinking Device.

quests.title: Framed Blocks
quests.description:
Framed Blocks is the single most important Building Mod. Infact if you give me a Modpack and Framed Blocks is not in it, I won't play. It is that important! 

Framed Blocks gives us mock Blocks that can be filled in with any Block that isn't a Block Entity (Block Entities are Blocks like Crafting Table, Furnace, or Enrichment Chamber). 

These Frames can be just about any shape or anything! From vertical Slabs, to slopes, even quarter blocks! 

You want Netherite Stairs? Then use Framed Blocks! You want a Haybale Crafting Table? You can get it! You want perfect angles in your build? Then start making Framed Blocks!

quests.title: Productive Trees
quests.description:
Productive Trees is all about Trees and Breeding Trees to make more Trees. 

So you are safe to guess it brings more Wood types to Minecraft! 

Heck even some specialty Wood!

quests.title: Quarries and Mines
quests.description:
Terraforming is an important part to even the simplest of Builds. But we Minecraft Players just simply don't have the time or effort to do so. 

So why not let Machines do it for us? 

Quarries are very easy ways of doing so but they all start with Block Breakers. The Simple Block Breaker will only break what is in front of it, not the most helpful... 

But the Advanced Block Breaker will Mine a set Area! Much better for Terraforming!

quests.title: Chipped
quests.description:
Chipped is similar to Chisels Mods as it changes the designs of Blocks, but Chipped has their own way of doing so! 

Chipped instead uses Stations you'll need to go to, to change Blocks. 

There's 7 different Stations each change different Blocks: Carpenters Table changes Wood, Glassblower changes Glass. 

And 6 of those Stations can be changed into a handheld Item for easier access. 

There's even Backpack Upgrades for them!

quests.title: Chipped Logs
quests.description: The 10 Vanilla Logs are wonderful, but they only have so many designs! \n\nSo of course Chipped, chipped in by adding dozens of new designs for those Logs!

quests.title: Eternal Starlight Trees
quests.description:
The Eternal Starlight is home to plenty of unique Items, Mobs, and Blocks. 

Trees aswell! 

You can find these Trees all over the Dimension in almost every Biome.

quests.title: Vanilla Logs
quests.description: The Logs from Vanilla Minecraft, found in the different Vanilla Biomes! \n\nI shouldn't have to explain anymore than that!

quests.title: Ars Nouveau Logs
quests.description: Ars Nouveau is a very fun magic Mod and with it brings its own set of Wood! \n\nArchwood comes in 5 different colors of trees that spawn in most Biomes but mostly in their Archwood Biome!

quests.title: Torchmaster
quests.description:
Now these are super helpful, you should definitely check them out! 

The actual Light Source is the Feral Flare Lantern. It will place invisible Light Sources around 20 Blocks or more around it. 

The Mega Torch is different: it doesn't emit Light but it does Block all Hostile Mob spawns with 64 Blocks of it! Useful for those using Night Vision. 

The Dread Lamp does the opposite, it blocks Passive Mob spawns in the same area.

quests.title: Logs
quests.description:
What rolls down stairs 
Alone or in pairs... 
Rolls over your neighbor's dog 
What's great for a snack 
And fits on your back? 
It's Log! Log! Log!

quests.title: Wall Lamps
quests.description: Works similar to the Simply Lights, Inverted will Light when no Redstone is applied to it while normal will only work with Redstone. \n\nThese need to be attached to a Wall to be placed though.

quests.title: Chipped Lights
quests.description: Man some Light Sources are just so butt ugly! \n\nLets change that!

quests.title: Simply Light
quests.description:
Simply Lights adds very simple to make and easy to use lights.

When inverted they will work without Redstone and will turn off when the Redstone signal goes activates it.

There are plenty of different colors and shapes of it!

quests.title: Light Sources
quests.description:
Light is a very important part of any Base. 

It keeps Monsters from Spawning, helps to see, and even adds more Color and life to your Builds! 

Or you can just use Night Vision but where's the fun in that!

quests.title: Ars Nouveau Lights
quests.description: The magical realm of Ars Nouveau brings us Magelights! Light Sources of pure magic! \n\nThey can either be placed normally using Spells or you can craft a Magelight Lantern and place that instead.

quests.title: Glassential
quests.description:
Glassential is very important Mod for building, even for builds with purposes! 
It's not just normal Glass, these have abilities which can be read while hovering over the Item! 

Like Ethereal Glass which you can walk through but Mobs can't. (I used that for my Bee Dome in 9sky!)

quests.title: Vanilla Stones
quests.description: Remember when it was just Stone and Cobblestone?

quests.title: Railcraft Stones
quests.description:
Railcraft, along with Trains, adds some Stones for Decoration! 

Quarried and Abyssal Stone can be crafted together to make Polished, Chiseled, or Brick versions! 

Also don't forget Stairs and Slabs!

quests.title: Chipped Glass
quests.description: From normal Glass, to Glass with Panes, to even Mosaics!

quests.title: Building Tips!
Crystalix
quests.description:
What does Crystalix give us you ask? 
It gives Glass! All different types of Glass! There is Normal, Clear, and Bordered. 

Bordered is the normal Minecraft Glass pattern. It has borders and pixels near corner to let you know it is Glass. Clear has the borders but no pixels near the corners, so the inside is all clear. Normal has no borders or pixels, it is entirely 100% clear and one color. 

Each Crystalix Glass has its own properties as well: Shadeless, Reinforced, Light, and Ghost. 

Shadeless will affect how it reacts to Shaders and even Minecraft lighting. Reinforced will affect Blast Resistance. Light will affect whether it gives Light, ignores Light, or acts like normal Glass, letting Light in. Ghost will be able to change who can walk through the Glass, this one has the most settings.

quests.title: 0FE30548F25FEDB1
quests.description:
If you're like me and don't like living in a Box (it reminds me too much of School), then you'll like to have Glass in your Builds to see outside. 

While the normal Vanilla ones are nice of course we can do much better! 

We can even get some use out of it!

quests.title: Stone Blocks
quests.description: You'll get this eventually, it's quite literally the most abundant Block in Minecraft.

quests.title: Reactor Glass
quests.description:
While protecting our Nuclear Reactors are important and viewing the contents of them relate to the safety of it. 

The Glass can also be used to make our bases look better! 

And really what's more important: safety and protection of our nuclear reactors? Or making our bases look better!

quests.title: Blocks!
quests.description: Get a Block. Literally any Block. \n\nEvery Player should know Blocks are the building Blocks of building. To actually build something you will need Blocks.

quests.title: Railcraft Glass
quests.description: New types of Glass that can be used with your Trains! Or bases, \n\nI can't make you use it for anything specific.

quests.title: Chipped Stones
quests.description: Only some of theses stones are chipped though.

quests.title: Eternal Starlight Stones
quests.description:
Eternal Starlight is a whole new dimension to explore! 

And to those strictly looking for Building in Minecraft, you can find a bunch of new Stones in it! 

To get to the Dimension you'll need to find its Portal!

quests.title: Decoration!
quests.description:
The original Minecraft Chair, the stairs. 

Welcome to Modded Minecraft, we have much more than just stairs for decoration. 

There are dozens of mods that add decoration and even more that add items that can be used for decoration!

quests.title: 01516BC726013B7C
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Undergarden Metals
quests.description:
Froststeel, Cloggrum, and Regalium can be Mined for. 
Utheric and Forgotten you need to kill for. 

Any other questions?

quests.title: Eternal Starlight Metals
quests.description: Oh did you think Eternal Starlight will have you get all these Metals the easy way? \n\nHA! don't be stupid. You'll have to fight Bosses, dig through Mud, and look for Meteor Showers!

quests.title: Chipped Concrete
quests.description: I've always hated how boring Concrete is, especially in real life. \n\nWell atleast in Minecraft with the Chipped Mod we can get different designs with it!

quests.title: Chipped Wool
quests.description: Don't worry, these won't set on fire!

quests.title: Mystical Agriculture Blocks
quests.description: While they can be expensive they're also plenty stylish!

quests.title: AllTheOres Blocks
quests.description:
AllTheOres is a built in-house mod made to help unify ores.

With that comes a ton of very useful decorative blocks!

Fluorite and Sapphire both look very cool!

quests.title: Metal and Gem Blocks
quests.description: While being the most expensive, they also are the prettiest! \n\nAnd that is what matters for Builds!

quests.title: Chipped Terracotta
quests.description: Even Glazed versions!

quests.title: Colored Blocks
quests.description:
Color is one of the most important parts of making a Build more lively! 

It gives it life, personality, and color! 

Start with the Dyes!

quests.title: Luminax
quests.description:
Luminax is a very simple Mod. You like Colored Lights? You can have Colored Lights. 

They are all one color with no Texturing and can come in different Shapes like Stairs or Slabs or even Pressure Plates! 

They even work with Dyenamics!

quests.title: Dyenamics
quests.description:
The 16 Colors Minecraft gives you isn't enough? 

Well I guess you could have 18 more! 

Dyenamics gives us 18 more Dyes all which can be used for the exact same Items and Blocks Minecraft's Dyes do! 

You want a Peach Candle? You can get one! You want a Bumblegum Shulker? Why not! You want a Fluorscent Bed? Of course!

quests.title: Handcrafted
quests.description:
Handcrafted is for everything Decoration wise. 

There's Beds (that look good enough to sleep in, and I'm a picky sleeper!) and Nightstands for the Bedrooms. 

There's Chairs and Tables for Living Room. 

There's an Oven, Plates, and Bowls for the Kitchen. 

Heck there's even Statues just for showing off!

quests.title: Decor Mods!
quests.description: These are Mods that I've found perfect for decorating your house or base! \n\nFeel free to check out even more than what's shown here!

quests.title: Farmer's Delight
quests.description:
Farmer's Delight is all about Farming and Cooking Food Items! We can also use those same Items for Decoration and usage! 

The Stove, Pots, and Pans are perfect for a Kitchen. 

The Food Barrels are great for a Pantry. 

The Farm stuff is great for outdoor decor and the Cabinets are perfect for anywhere!

quests.title: Now you're just showing off
quests.description: Is this necessary?

quests.title: Chipped Metals
quests.description:
Don't even complain about this one. 

There are dozens of ways of getting Iron and it's needed for even just normal progression. 

You will get Iron, you will make it into a Block, and you will make it pretty!

quests.title: Plastic Construction Bricks
quests.description:
Plastic Construction Bricks are Blocks made through PneumaticCraft: Repressurized. 

Just like their real life counter parts they hurt to step on! 

So either wear Shoes or smooth down the Bricks.

quests.title: Chipped Copper
quests.description:
Copper is the most abundant Ore in Minecraft and its main use is for decoration. 

There's already plenty of different variants added by Minecraft but Chipped didn't think it was good enough! So we got more! 

Even variants for the oxidized versions. 

You can make faux Emerald Blocks.

quests.title: Chipped Gem Blocks
quests.description: Redstone, Lapis, Quartz, Amethyst, Emerald, and Diamonds are all precious Gems. \n\nSo of course we are turning them into Blocks, very pretty precious Blocks to be exact!

quests.title: Railcraft Colored Blocks
quests.description: More Blocks added by Railcraft? I'm starting to doubt if it's even about Trains!

quests.title: Cooking for Blockheads
quests.description: Cooking for Blockheads is all about making the Kitchen your home. \n\nI recommend using everything it gives as every Item has a use and looks amazing!

quests.title: Tips and Tricks!
quests.subtitle: And Other Useful Items!
quests.description: On this page, you'll find some useful items and info to help you on your journey!

quests.title: 0152938EE5651409
quests.description:
This Quest has been authored by AllTheMods Staff, or a Community contributor for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all AllTheMods packs are licensed under All Rights Reserved, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by AllTheMods Team without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.

quests.title: Crafting... on a Stick!
quests.subtitle: Less Placing, more Crafting
quests.description:
Need a portable Crafting Table? How about a portable Smithing Table?
Crafting On A Stick adds portable versions of some of your favorite crafting stations! This is a must have in the early game.

quests.title: Charging Gadgets
quests.description:
The Charging Station is a very helpful Early Game Block. 

It is clearly used for charging Items. Either Pipe in Energy or use Furnace Fuel to make Energy in the form of FE. 

Then, you can put any Item that needs charging into the Right most Slot.

quests.title: Transmutation Orb
quests.description:
Sometimes we just can't find that one Female Pokemon in order to Breed. 

So why not just magically turn one of our Males into a Female! Or vice versa! 
Just Right Click a Pokemon with the Transmutation Orb and they'll switch Genders. 

I wonder if you can use it on Ditto to make a Ditta?

quests.title: Ball Synchronizer
quests.description:
The Ball Synchronizer can be used to switch the Ball a Pokemon is in. 

Let a Pokemon Hold the desired Ball, then use the Ball Synchronizer on them to switch it. The Ball they were in will be Voided... 

I can't see this helping too much unless you use Balls that give benefits after Catching a Pokemon!

quests.title: Simple Magnets
quests.description:
Don't you hate when your breaking something and the Blocks fall just out of your reach! 

Well worry no more for we have Magnets! Simply Right Click while holding the Magnet to turn it on. Then, all dropped Items and Blocks in a 5 Block Radius will come to you. 

You can also equip the Magnet in your Curios to keep using it! 

If you don't wish to continue using the Magnet (I find this happens near Mob Farms) then just Right Click with it again to disable it. 

It can also be upgraded to increase the range!

quests.title: Building Gadgets
quests.description: Diamonds also allow us to create some cool gadgets to help us build using the mod Building Gadgets.\n\nThese are great tools to help you build bigger bases, or for clearing out space using the Destruction Gadget.

quests.title: Personal Shrinking Device
quests.subtitle: Honey I Shrunk Myself
quests.description: Use this item to shrink. Helpful for working on automation and also just overall fun.

quests.title: Easy Villagers
quests.subtitle: Villagers, made easy
quests.description:
In Vanilla, Villagers can be really frustrating to deal with. Cycling trades is not easy at all, and professions can sometimes be tough to deal with.

Easy Villagers is a mod to make all of it much easier to deal with! For starters, you can pick up a villager by sneak-right clicking them. They can then be easily placed in the world, or in specific blocks from the Easy Villager mod!

You can search @EasyVillagers in JEI to see blocks the mod offers!

quests.title: Trapped Trader Carpets
quests.subtitle: No more Annoying Traders!
quests.description: Trapped Trader Carpets will kill any Wandering Traders that spawn near it instantly!\n\nThese might be the best items in the entire pack.

quests.title: Functional Storage
quests.subtitle: Storage Drawers?
quests.description: Functional Storage adds Drawers that can hold several stacks of an item. These can be upgraded to hold even more stacks!\n\nThis is great for items you get a lot of, like Cobblestone or Seeds!

quests.title: Ranged Pump
quests.description:
The Ranged Pump is so special it gets its own Mod! 

The Pump will collect Water Sources beneath it and replace them with Stone. 
It does need Energy to work though, but it's worth it, it has a huge range! 

The Water collected in it will need to be Piped out.

quests.title: Trainer Repel Rod
quests.description:
Too many unwanted Trainers? Get rid of them with the Trainer Repel Rod! 

Not sure of the area of Spawns it disables... it doesn't tell me. 

Atleast it doesn't prevent Trainer Spawners from working.

quests.title: Poke Gems
quests.description:
Gems are fun Items found in Pokemon Structures and Suspicious Blocks. 

You can have your Pokemon hold it to Boost their first Move of that Type. 

A Water Gem will make the first Water Move better. Fire Gem Boosts the first Fire Move, and so on.

quests.title: Compasses for Searching
quests.subtitle: Helps Find Biomes/Structures
quests.description:
The Nature's Compass gives you a list of biomes you can search for.

Select a biome, then hit 'Search.' You'll see some info in the top left, and the compass will point in the direction of the biome.

The Explorer's Compass works the same but works for structures, instead of biomes.

quests.title: Infinite Water
quests.subtitle: Can be used as Reactor Coolant
quests.description: Easy item to automate infinite water. \n\nNeed more water? Make another!

quests.title: Balls that help Pokemon
quests.description:
The Friend, Luxury, and Heal PokeBalls all help your Pokemon after being caught! 

The Friend Ball starts your Pokemon at 150 Friend Points (sounds like manipulation, not a real Friendship!). 

The Pokemon in Luxury Balls will gain Friendship twice as fast as Pokemon in other Balls. 

And the Heal Ball will act as if the Pokemon took a nice Healing Machine bath after you Caught them. Yeah, just that one time, not constantly.

quests.title: Balls with a greater Catch rate
quests.description:
I'm not listing all of these PokeBalls. 

All of these PokeBalls will have a better chance at Catching a Pokemon under certain circumstances. 

From the Wild Pokemon's Stats, to time in Battle, to place in the World, to even time of day. All of these PokeBalls are unique in their own ways! 

Most if not under those circumstances, will only have a 1x Chance... UNLESS stated otherwise.
task_titles: Balls with a greater Catch rate

quests.title: Balls that are thrown differently
quests.description:
These 6 PokeBalls are thrown in a different way from every other Ball. 

The Feather, Wing, and Jet Balls will be thrown much farther than the Normal PokeBall. 

The Heavy, Leadon, and Gigaton Balls aren't thrown as far as the Normal PokeBall. 

The 1.5x and 2x aren't related to distance but rather Pokeman Catch Chance!

quests.title: Mo' Professions
quests.description:
Modded Minecraft introduces us to new Villager Professions! 

Forge Hammer: Industrialist 

Charger: Fluix Researcher 

Advanced Beehive: Beekeeper 

Coffee Maker: Engineer 

Arcane Core: Shady Wizard 

Foragers Table: Forager 

Powered Rolling Machine: Cartman 
Manual Rolling Machine: Trackman 

Engineer's Workbench: Gunsmith 
White Banner: Outfitter 
Engineer's Circuit Workbench: Electrician 
Engineer's Crafting Table: Machinist 
Turntable: Structural Engineer 

Charging Station: Pressure Mechanic 

Saw: Carpenter

quests.title: Iron Jetpacks
quests.description:
Jetpacks are a beloved way of getting around. 

To start making them you'll need to start with a Wood Jetpack! This can be upgraded all the way to a Creative Jetpack. 

While it does have many versions each work all the same. They all can be placed in your Chestplate Slot, or Back Curio, or Curio Curio. 

All of them also need FE to work, you can use any Item Charger to charge them! They will use FE to fly and yes you will drop if you run out of Energy. 
To fly you'll need to turn on your Engine (V), then when you hold Space you'll fly up and drop when you let go. 

For those who don't enjoy dropping, then you can turn on Hover (Unbinded), when set on you will Fly at the same altitude; being able to go higher with (Space) and lower with (Shift). 

To adjust how fast you fly, change your Throttle. Decreasing it is (,) by default and increasing it is (.) by default!

quests.title: Dis-Enchanting Table
quests.description:
The Dis-Enchanting Table is a probably the most helpful Tip here. 

Simply put an Enchanted Item in the Left Slot and a Book in the Middle Slot. Then, the Enchants will go to the Right Slot in Book form! 

You can also use Enchanted Books instead of the Item to split up its Enchantments.

quests.title: Can teach a new Pokemon new Tricks!
quests.subtitle: Complete all tricks!
task_titles: Can teach a new Pokemon new Tricks!
